lokele: Nda lokasa loami loa oso, Teofilo, yataka njasɔ bitoti eyakolaka Yesu la ndokelaka la ndoekekesa,
english: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

lokele: konda lise eliailomoko lande nda use, ani ko la Bolimo Botanu asosila ndotela batomomu ebaaka Inde, bikela yokelomo lau.
english: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

lokele: Mbisa ya tokange twa liwa liande, Inde lotambaka bindo yande la liwawi ko la ndembe wike, Inde lɔɛnɛkɛlɛ end’iyo ko bacho kama inɛi ani aonganaka lau njasɔ ya Bɔkɔta wa Mungu. Liinwi lia Yesu nda Use
english: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

lokele: Ayalaka Yesu lau, Inde lotel’iyo ndola mbo batasokweke nda Yelusaleme, kongo ko baumbakeleke lisakä eliatikaka Sango otikel’iyo mbo—
english: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

lokele: Liende liao eliaokak’ino ende Imi, liko mbo Yoane nd’alufiaka la balia, nde ino bolufiomoko la Bolimo Botanu mbisa ani becho wike bitiete.
english: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”

lokele: Asɔngɔmɔkɔ to iyo, batomomu lofel’Inde mbo— ¿Ngɛnɛ, otokɔkɔmɛsɛ isosha sha Bɔkɔta ende Isalaele liasi ko la mbile-ye?
english: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”

lokele: Inde loonga lau mbo— Loti loanu ndoluwa mbile ango ko yaa ebisota Sango ko l’isosha shande angɛnɛ;
english: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

lokele: kongo ko bɔlɔkɔ nde bofoka ani akataliomoko Bolimo Botanu end’ino, limɔ boyalaka nde ebatonangokole tonango twami nda Yelusaleme la nda Yudea yatotina, la nda Samalia, la konda liko lia wenda-bo.
english: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

lokele: Aongak’Inde ongoma, l’ani batotich’Inde, Yesu loilomo nda use, la lifita lois’Inde batɛnɛ la baiso bau.
english: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

lokele: Awɛlɛk’iyo liseme nda use ani atɔkɛ lande, kwaamao bato bambale bemakalaka tina lau la bisinda bifufu,
english: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, 1:10 two men stood by them in white clothing,

lokele: iyo loonga mbo— Bato ba Ngalilai, monito wemesani ani ndowɛlɛ liseme ngo ko nda use? E-Yesu-yo oyasoilelomo ino nda use, eyaka nde liasi ko la bɔfɔɔnɔ-bo ebosɔɛn’ino wɛn’Inde ani atɔkɛ nda use.
english: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”

lokele: Limɔ asokwak’iyo nda löngo elotangomu Elaya, iyo loinwa nda Yelusaleme eyele esika kwa lɔkɛndɛ loengana la lise lia yenga.
english: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

lokele: Ɔtɔk’iyo nda okenge, iyo lolila nda ndakɔ y’olikolo olo ayalakak’iyo, bako Petelo la Yoane, la Yakobo, la Andelo, la Filipo, la Tomasa, la Batolomayo, la Matayo, la Yakobo wana wa Alufayo, la Simona Selote, la Yuda wana wa Yakobo.
english: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

lokele: Batotina bana bayalaka la botema ɔmwito nda lisomboli la bofiili amamwito la batomali bamɔi, simbi to Malia nyango wa Yesu la bitungani ya Yesu lisanga. Matia loaomo nda lifa lia Yudasi
english: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

lokele: Lise limɔi nda bacho bana, Petelo loemala sisi ya beoto (ekuke ya bato loengana loketi loa mia la kama imbale), inde mbo—
english: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

lokele: Beoto, loengani nde mbo baoi ba Lokasa loa Mungu bakɔchɔmɔkɔ, bako ebaongaka Bolimo Botanu ko la bɔnɔkɔ wa Dawidi, loasɔ loa Yudasi oyatolaka oso ebaundesaka Yesu.
english: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

lokele: Yudasi atangomoko ɔmɔi wasu la ayalak’imɔ la likao lia e-likuwa-li.
english: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.

lokele: (Boto-yo losomba köndo ko la bieto eyaɔlɔk’inde la obe ewakelak’inde, limɔ inde lokwa se kpuu la bindo loachacha atiteni la nduka yande bitotina lowɛlɛmɛ se.
english: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.

lokele: Loasɔ-lo loluwana la bato batotina ba Yelusaleme la ani elanga ena lotomo lina nda lioi liau mbo Akeladama, liko mbo, Elanga ya Bakila.)
english: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’

lokele: Loatomoko to nda Lokasa loa Bɛɛlɛ mbo— Bokulu wande boyaleke ko isimo, Angwɛnɛ oto woyalaka nda wao; la mbo— Isosha esiaundak’inde sha bonyafala, wasi ɔsɛkɛ shao.
english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ Psalms 69:25 and, ‘Let another take his office.’ Psalms 109:8

lokele: Eokao loengani nde lasu mbo ɔmɔi wasu w’ebasanganaka lasu ko nda mbile bitotina eyakɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ Yesu lasu,
english: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

lokele: konda liakoli lia lilufi lia Yoane, konda lise eliailomoko Yesu nda use osenyana lasu, mbo boto ona ayaleke oyatonangokola lasu losokwo loa Yesu nda liwa.
english: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

lokele: Iyo loemesa bato ambale, bako Yosefa oyatangomu Balasaba wa ngau ako Yuseto la ɔmɔi ako Matia.
english: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

lokele: Limɔ iyo losombola mbo— Aɛ Mungu, Ngɛnɛ oyaluwi betema ya batotina, ɛnɛsɛk’iso boni oto wa e-bambale-ba oyasoa Aɛ oa’inde,
english: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

lokele: mbo afomoko lifa lia Yudasi nda likuwa-li liosungana la litomomu elisosokwa la Yudasi oyasokakɛ ko elela eyande angɛnɛ.
english: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

lokele: Iyo lota ngongo, la ngongo lokwela ko ende Matia, limɔ inde lotomo isosha amamwito la batomomu liu la ɔmɔi.
english: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

lokele: Limɔ ayaka lise lia Pentekosete, liko lise lioücha buka wa eula, beoto bayalaka amamwito nda elela ɛmɔi.
english: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

lokele: Futuku elundi efi losokwa nda use kwa mbo fömba bitoeta, yao lotumesa ndakɔ etotina olo ayalak’iyo.
english: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

lokele: La iyo lɔɛnɛ ndame kwa eya bösä ebisokaelakana, lɔmɔi lɔmɔi loaa se ende boto la boto wau,
english: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

lokele: la batotina lotumesomoko la Bolimo Botanu, la iyo yaatotina loakola ndoonga la baoi ba kanda yasi kwa afaefaka Inde ofaef’iyo baölo boonga.
english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

lokele: BaYuda to balimelaka nda Yelusaleme, balitesi ba Mungu ebasokwaka nda biese bitotina ya wenda.
english: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

lokele: Okanakä to etondo-ye iyo losɔngɔmɔ etanda efi ya bato, iyo loeyaeya finɛ ani okak’iyo beoto batoonga ngɔlu ya oto la oto,
english: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

lokele: la iyo lowa liena, iyo lɔmwaala, iyo loonga mbo— ¿Tɛnɛ ngo, ebatoonga-ba bati ba Ngalilai?
english: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

lokele: ¿Monito iso totooka boto la boto ngɔlu eyande eyaotomoko lande?
english: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

lokele: Twende BaPalatia, BaMedea, BaElama, la ebayali nda yese ya Mesopotamia, BaYudea, BaKapodokia, l’Eba Ponto la Asia,
english: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

lokele: BaFulugia, la bato ba Pamfulia, ba Ejipeto, ba yese ya Libwe tina la Kulene, la bato ba fɛtɛti ba Loma la BaYuda la eba ndimela,
english: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

lokele: la bamɔi ba Kulete, la BaAlaba, iso yaatotina tosooka iyo batoonga la baoi basu angɛnɛ ko tokesa twa Mungu.
english: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

lokele: Iyo lowa to liena batotina, iyo lowa toloi, iyo lofelakana mbo— ¿Litina moni nda loasɔ-lo?
english: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

lokele: Nde bamɔi lomuchamucha, iyo mbo— Basookanelo la bänä bayai. Inango sha Petelo
english: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”

lokele: Kongo ko Petelo loemesana l’eba liu la ɔmɔi, inde lokusola limiki liande, inde loonga lau baölo mbo— Ino bato ba Yudea la batotina ebaingali Yelusaleme kwani, eloasɔ-lo loluwaneke lanu la ɔtɛsɛkɛ baoi bami ko nda batoi banu,
english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

lokele: eoka ebato-ba batiwe bänä, kwa atoenyel’ino, eoka ele ko bonyanya oku;
english: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day. 2:15

lokele: kongo ko löle ngo ko loao eloatɔndɔlɔkɔ Yoele ewa Bɔtɔndɔli mbo— Mungu asoonga mbo,
english: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

lokele: Nda bacho ba liko, yɛwɛlɛkɛ Bolimo wami ende balomboki batoti; La bana banu batolome la batomali bɛtɔndɔlɔkɔ, La tosenge twanu bɛnɛkɛ baɛni, La biuwa yanu betaka saki;
english: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

lokele: Eingo, yewɛlɛkɛ Bolimo wami la bacho bana Ende bɛkɔwa yami batolome la batomali, la betɔndɔlɔkɔ.
english: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

lokele: Yetambaka tokesa nda use likolo, La ndembe ya bisisho nda nyɛlɛ ose, Bakila la bösä la ngungu ya bölïlya.
english: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

lokele: Liso lia use likinjwaka nde lilima La tengai etufaka kwa bakila, Oso wa loyo loa lise lina lifi lia Ngɛnɛ Mungu elitoɛnɛlɛ swa.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

lokele: Nde oyakasingweke lina lia Ngɛnɛ, inde kouwesomoko.
english: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’ Joel 2:28-32

lokele: Ino BaIsalaele, okaka ebaoi-ba mbo Yesu wa Nasaleta Inde oyalembeelesaka Mungu elembeeles’ino ko la tokesa la befoka ya bisisho la ndembe eyakelaka Mungu ko lande sisi yanu, kwa aluw’ino angɛnɛ,
english: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

lokele: Inde kongo, oyawambomokö la likomyi la loluwo loa Mungu, ino nd’awachak’Inde nda lieka, ososɛɛsɛlɛs’Inde ko la besamba ya bato ebatilitese bikela;
english: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;

lokele: Mungu asotɛmwɛs’Inde nda liwa, asofaikola tokängë twa liwa eoka atikɔkɔlɛ ndokanjomo la liao.
english: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

lokele: Dawidi loonga loasɔ loande mbo— Yɛnɛkɛ̈ Ngɛnɛ oso wa baiso bami bacho batotina, Eoka ayali nda bosamba wa olome wami mbo italɛlɛlɛlɛ;
english: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

lokele: Eokao botema wami bosoomala la lolame loami losoyaimwa la limɛngɔ, La lokomba loami imɔ lotoyalaka l’iyeli sha liwawi,
english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

lokele: Eoka oitomacha bolimo wami nda ewelo, La oitomacha oyasamomu laɛ mbo ɛnɛkɛ liɔli lia liwa.
english: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, 2:27 neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.

lokele: Osɔɛnɛsɛ’mi mboka ya liwawi, Ototumesa botema wami la linɛngina oso wa baiso baɛ.
english: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’ Psalms 16:8-11

lokele: Beoto, isokɔkɔlɔ oonga lanu fololo loasɔ loa Dawidi ngau wasu mbo awaka la aombomoko la losai loande lokoyali ono eyasu konda eweuse.
english: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

lokele: Kongo ko ayalak’inde bɔtɔndɔli la eoka mbo aluwaka mbo Mungu atinyaka ekanɔ yosɛlɛ ɔmɔi wa lioti liande Bɔkɔta,
english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ 2:30 to sit on his throne,

lokele: ongoma Dawidi lotaluwa la atɔndɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ eoka ya losokwo loa Yesu nda liwa, mbo atiamachaka bolimo wande nda ewelo ango mbo bindo yande ndoɛnɛ liɔli lia liwa.
english: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, 2:31 and his flesh didn’t see decay.

lokele: Yesu-yo kongo nd’asokusolomo la Mungu nda liwa ko la liwawi la iso-ba nd’ayali ebɛnɛkɛ̈ loasɔ-lo.
english: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

lokele: Ataliomoko Inde tala ko la bosamba wa Mungu, atikelomöko lisakä lia Bolimo Botanu ko la Sango, eokao asowɛlɛ kwani loao elosɔɛnɛ la elosok’ino.
english: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.

lokele: Dawidi atiakɛndɛkɛ likolo nda use, nde inde angɛnɛ loonga mbo— Bɔkɔta Mungu loonga la Bɔkɔta wami mbo— Yalaka se Nda fangi ya bosamba wami wa olome,
english: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand

lokele: kond’akateke Imi Baiyani laɛ kwa esolo ya batindi baɛ.
english: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’ Psalms 110:1

lokele: Eokao tukela etotina ya BaIsalaele baluweke fololo mbo Mungu asotalia ngo ko Yesu-yo, oyaolak’ino nda lieka mbo Ngɛnɛ la Masiya. Lilufi lia oso lia Etanda
english: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

lokele: Okaka bato ebaoi-ba, iyo lokaka betema wäle finɛ, iyo loonga la Petelo la batomomu ebamɔi mbo— ¿Tokeleke to moni?
english: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

lokele: Petelo loonga lau mbo— Kalanganaka la lufiomoko ino yaatotina nda lina lia Yesu Masiya eoka ya limɛsɛli lia batwanelo banu limɔ bɔɔlɔkɔ lifaefi liko Bolimo Botanu,
english: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

lokele: eoka lisakä lile lianu la elia bana banu la elia batotina ebayali esika ebatotaka Mungu wanu ot’iyo lioi.
english: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”

lokele: Ko la baölo basi wike inde lokambes’iyo la inde lofumbes’iyo mbo— Uwesomoko nda fɛtɔ-ye ya bato ebatiengane.
english: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

lokele: Ongoma ebimelaka inango shande, iyo lolufiomo, la nda lise lina bato bilɛfu isatɔ lowatema lau,
english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

lokele: Iyo lokɔkɔmɔ kɔkɛ ko la liekesi lia Batomomu la lisukani lia beoto la nda liuni lia lituma la nda basomboli.
english: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

lokele: Bato batotina lokwelo bɔwa la ndembe ya bisisho wike yakelomoko ko la Batomomu.
english: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

lokele: Batotina ba liimeli losɔngɔkɔmɔ la iyo lokaana bieto yau bitotina,
english: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

lokele: la bilanga la biengo yau, iyo loungekesa yao, iyo lokaana la basi batotina kwa aenoko oto.
english: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

lokele: Lise la lise iyo lɔɔtɔkɔkɔ nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu amamwito, iyo lounaka lituma la ndakɔ la ndakɔ yau olo alak’iyo bieka la bɔfɔɔmu la limɛngɔ nda betema;
english: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

lokele: iyo loinakela Mungu, la bato batotina loyalana lau la booto. La Ngɛnɛ lowatekemesa lau ko ebatouwesomo lise la lise.
english: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

lokele: Aɛkɛ to Petelo la Yoane nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu nda mbile ya lisomboli lia lilongolongo,
english: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour. 3:1

lokele: boto ɔmɔi oyaaka la ekoti ko nda sɔlɔ ya nyango wande lotolomo la bato bamɔi, iyo losɛlɛ inde se lise la lise tina la bome wa Ndakɔ ya Mungu ewatangomoko mbo Bɔfɛkɔ, mbo ömbakeke sumbu bieto ende ebatɔɔtɔkɔ nda Ndakɔ.
english: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

lokele: Ɛnɛk’inde Petelo la Yoane batɔɔtɔ nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, inde lömbel’iyo sumbu bosombo.
english: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

lokele: Nde Petelo la Yoane lotichak’inde, Petelo mbo— Wɛlɛk’iso baiso!
english: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

lokele: Inde lowɛl’iyo bonono ani atoumbakela mbo atɔɔlɔ bieto end’iyo.
english: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

lokele: Nde Petelo loonga mbo— Iti ango la bieto ebikɛkɛ kwa ebifi, kongo ko yao eyele lami, itofaef’aɛ ngo ko yao; nda lina lia Yesu wa Nasaleta, tangwaka.
english: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

lokele: Petelo lounda bosamba wande wa olome, inde loemes’inde, kwaamao batindi la bakakalaka bande lowangema.
english: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

lokele: Limɔ inde lotondwa likolo, inde loemesana, inde loakola ndɔkɛndɛ, inde lɔɔtɔ nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu amamwito lau ani atokɛndɛkɛndɛ, l’ani atotondwatondwa, l’ani atoinakela Mungu.
english: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

lokele: Bato batotina lɔɛnɛ ani atotangwak’inde l’ani atoinakel’inde Mungu,
english: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

lokele: iyo lolembeel’inde mbo ende boto ona oyayaliki ndömba bosombo nda bome ofi wa Ndakɔ ya Mungu boko Bɔfɛkɔ, iyo lowanga finɛ la limwaali lifi eoka ya loasɔ elosoyel’inde.
english: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

lokele: Boto lokuamela Petelo la Yoane, limɔ bato batotina losɔngɔkɔmɔ bokamu nda lilɛlɛ eliatangomokö mbo Elia Solomo, iyo lomwaala finɛ.
english: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

lokele: La ɛnɛkɛ̈ Petelo ongoma, inde loonga lau mbo— ¿Bato ba Isalaele, monito osomwaala la osowɛl’iso bonono kwa mbo iso angɛnɛ ko la bofoka wasu, ango ko la liengani liasu, tosokɛndɛsɛ inde?
english: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

lokele: Mungu wa Abalayama la wa Yisaka la wa Yakobo, Mungu wa batata banu asotalia Wana wande tala, ako Yesu, oyawambak’ino, la oyafekak’ino oso wa Pilato ani Pilato losanga ofaikol’Inde,
english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

lokele: kongo ko ino nd’afekak’Indë ewa Botanu la Wengani la wafelaka mbo boli wa bato afomoko ino,
english: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

lokele: nde waolaka Bɔkɔta wa Liwawi; kongo ko Mungu nd’atɛmɔlɔk’Inde nda liwa, la iso nd’ale baɛni ba loasɔ-lo.
english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

lokele: Yende ko la liimeli oimela lina liande mbo boto-yo asowangema oyasɔɛnɛ la oyasoluw’ino; la liimeli liande lisouwes’inde la bosasu bototina-bo oso wanu yaatotina.
english: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

lokele: Kwani to beoto, isoluwa mbo ino wakelaka ongoma ko la botutuku, kwa akelaka imɔ ko benyafala yanu.
english: “Now, brothers, 3:17 I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

lokele: Nde ongoma Mungu asokɔcha lona eloaongak’Inde kwala ko la bɛnɔkɔ ya batɔndɔli, loko mbo Masiya wande okaka nde tokange twa liwa.
english: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

lokele: Kalanganaka to la kikwaka, mbo batwanelo banu bafanjakomoko,
english: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

lokele: mbo Ngɛnɛ Mungu afek’ino baɛumɛlɔ, mbo atomek’ino Masiya, Yesu oyatomelomoko ino.
english: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

lokele: Loengani nde mbo Use bonyangelek’Inde konda mbile eyekakɔchɔmɔkɔ bitotina eyaongaka Mungu ko la bɛnɔkɔ ya batɔndɔli bande kwalakwala.
english: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

lokele: Mɔsɛ nd’aongaka mbo— Ngɛnɛ Mungu wanu atotaliel’ino ɔmɔi wa beoto yanu Bɔtɔndɔli, Kwa ataliaka Inde imi angɛnɛ. Bolailaka bitotina ebikaongek’Inde lanu,
english: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

lokele: la batotina ebaitolaila Bɔtɔndɔli ona Belasɛɛsɛlɛsɔmɔkɔ sisi ya bato.
english: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’ Deuteronomy 18:15

lokele: Eingo, batɔndɔli batotina imɔ ko Samwele ko eba mbisa yande, bataka boeki wa e-bacho-ba.
english: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

lokele: Ino wende bana ba batɔndɔli la ba Ngɛla eyatinyaka Mungu la batata banu, ani aongak’Inde la Abalayama mbo— Nda lioti liaɛ befindi bitotina ya wenda bifotesomoko.
english: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’ 3:25 Genesis 22:18

lokele: Ataliaka Mungu otalia Wana wande, Inde lotoma Inde end’ino oso, mbo afotesek’ino ko la likikwi liosokol’ino nda batwanelo banu.
english: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”

lokele: Aongaka Petelo la Yoane la bato, limɔ BaKanga la Komanda wa ba-polisi ba Ndakɔ ya Mungu la BaSadoke, iyo yaatotina loyaosh’iyo,
english: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

lokele: la iyo losoma finɛ eoka batoekesa bato la eoka batokambesa loasɔ loa losokwo nda liwa ko la Yesu.
english: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

lokele: Iyo loundesa batomomu, iyo lokand’iyo bɔnyɔlɔlɔ ko nda lɛlɛngɔ eoka buse bosɔkɛ oko litɛlɛ.
english: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

lokele: Nde wike w’ebokakä inangö, iyo loimela, loketi loa bato loenganaka kwa bilɛfu bɔɔmwi.
english: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ benyafala yau la biange la batikasa losɔngɔkɔmɔ nda Yelusaleme,
english: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

lokele: amamwito la Ana ako Kanga eyeti la Kayafa la Yoanane la Alesandelo la ebamɔi ba bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa kanga eyeti.
english: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

lokele: Limɔ iyo loemesa batomomu atiteni, iyo lofela mbo— ¿Osokela loasɔ-lo ko la boni bofoka la lini lina, bako ino?
english: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”

lokele: Limɔ atumesomoko Petelo la Bolimo Botanu, inde loonga mbo— Benyafala la biange ya bato-ba,
english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,

lokele: eyambo iso tokɔtɔlɔmɔ louse loasɔ loa liuwesi lia boto wa ɛlɛmɛ la ani asouwesomo inde,
english: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

lokele: ino yaatotina la tukela etotina ya Isalaele, luwaka mbo ende ko nda lina lia Yesu Masiya wa Nasaleta, oyaolak’ino nda lieka, la oyakusolaka Mungu nda liwa, ko lande kongo e-boto-yo aemali oso wanu la bosasu.
english: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.

lokele: Inde nd’ale Litalɛ elisofekomo lanu baswi, elisoswomo nda botö wa ndakɔ.
english: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’ Psalms 118:22

lokele: Angwɛnɛ imɔ liuwesi ko la wasi eoka angwɛnɛ to lina liasi ose ya use elifomu ende bato la eliengani lasu mbo tuwesomoko.
english: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

lokele: Ɛnɛkɛ iyo mbo Petelo la Yoane basotendela ndoonga fololo la aluwak’iyo mbo batiaekesomoko la mbo bayalaka ko bato ba okenge, iyo lomwaala; iyo loleembela mbo bayalakaka la Yesu.
english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ̈ iyo boto oyauwesomoko aemali lau, batiayalaka la limutoli lioonga;
english: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

lokele: nde iyo loonga lau mbo baumeke lousa loa ikumbɛ, limɔ iyo lotwana kuko, iyo mbo—
english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

lokele: ¿Tokeleke to iye la bato-ba? Losoɛnɛlɛ to fololo ende bato batotina ebasolimela nda Yelusaleme mbo esisho ya lokuku esokelomo lau la totikɔkɔlɛ ndoanganya.
english: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.

lokele: Kongo ko mbo bitafafana imɔ ende bato, tosishek’iyo la boimo mbo bataonga imɔ la boto angɔmɔi loasɔ loa e-lina-li.
english: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo lota batomomu lioi, iyo loimak’iyo mbo bataonga ango sinyo, bataekesa ango nda lina lia Yesu.
english: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

lokele: Kongo ko Petelo la Yoane lomutoel’iyo mbo— Ango engani nde nda baiso ba Mungu, kwa ndokak’ino, kwa ndokaka Mungu, ino angɛnɛ ataka loao,
english: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

lokele: nde iso totikɔkɔlɛ ndokufa ndoonga bina ebisɔɛnɛ’iso la ebisok’iso.
english: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

lokele: Limɔ asishak’iyo liasi la boimo, iyo lofaikol’iyo eoka batiɛnɛkɛ fofe yokel’iyo loasɔ, eoka ya bato ebainakelaka Mungu eoka ya loao eloakelomoko.
english: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

lokele: Eoka boto oyauwesomoko la esisho ayalaka la miaka yoeta kama binɛi. Petelo la Yoane loinwa ende Beoto
english: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

lokele: Afaikolomoko iyo, iyo lɔkɛ ende bato bau, iyo lokambes’iyo bina eyaongaka kanga ebieti la biange eonga lau.
english: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

lokele: Okakä iyo ongoma, iyo losangana la limiki limɔi ndoinela Mungu, mbo— Ngɛnɛ Mungu, Aɛ wende Bokeli wa use la nyɛlɛ, la balia bafi la bitotina ebiyali nda yao,
english: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

lokele: ako Inde oyaongaka la batata basu la bɔnɔkɔ wa bɔkɔwa waɛ ako Dawidi mbo— ¿Bato ba tukela ya wenda batotaka boulu eoka iye; Batoenyaka ko njasɔ ebile wawa? Bɛkɔta ya wenda basotɔngɔmɔ la olenga,
english: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

lokele: Benyafala besosɔngɔmɔ likwakulu lia bita Mbo bananeke la Ngɛnɛ Mungu la Masiya wande.
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’ 4:26 Psalms 2:1-2

lokele: Wewe, basɔngɔmɔkɔ to nda bokenge-bo ndonana la Wana Botanu waɛ ako Yesu oyüchomoko laɛ, bako Helodi la Pontio Pilato la tukela ya Isalaele la tukela ya wenda,
english: “For truly, 4:27 both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,

lokele: ndokela bina eyasangak’Aɛ la bofoka la likomyi liaɛ oso mbo bikelomoko ko mbisa.
english: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.

lokele: Kwani, Aɛ Ngɛnɛ Mungu tichaka to nganyä yau, lembɛlɛkɛ mbo bɛkɔwa yaɛ baongeke lioi liaɛ la lotendela,
english: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

lokele: l’ani atonanola Aɛ bosamba waɛ ndouwesa bato, ndokela tokesa la bisisho ko la lina lia Wana Botanu waɛ ako Yesu.
english: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”

lokele: Limɔ asombolak’iyo, elela olo asɔngɔmɔk’iyo lotukatukesomoko la iyo yaatotina lotumesomo la Bolimo Botanu, iyo lotendela ndonangola wɛndi wa Mungu la lotendela. Beoto ya Etanda loyala la botema ɔmwito
english: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

lokele: Botukä wa ebaimelaka baaka la botema la bolimo ko ɔmwito la angwɛnɛ boto woonga mbo yeka eyasɛl’inde yende ko eyande angɛnɛ, nde bitotina yau loomana lau batotina.
english: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

lokele: Batomomu lokambekesa bato mboli ya losokwo loa Ngɛnɛ Yesu nda liwa, ko la bofoka finɛ; booto wa likama wayalaka lau batotina.
english: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

lokele: Angwɛnɛ angɔmɔi wau waenoko yeka, eoka batotina ebasɛɛlɛkɛ bilanga kwa ndakɔ, iyo loungesa yao, iyo loesha belïli eyasombak’iyo,
english: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

lokele: iyo loyataka yao se oso wa Batomomu, limɔ likao lokaomo ende boto la boto kwa aenganaka la boeno.
english: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

lokele: Ongoma Yosefa, oyafomokö lina liasi liko Balanaba ko la Batomomu, (litina mbo— Wana wa lifumbesi) oyaaka wa bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Lɛwi, boto wa bosanga wa Kupolio,
english: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

lokele: inde loungesa elanga eyaaka lande, inde loesha bolïli bototina, inde loyata wao oso wa Batomomu.
english: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

lokele: Nde oto ɔmɔi, lina liande liko Anania, iyo la wali wande ako Safila loungesa elanga.
english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

lokele: Inde loisa botüku wa bolïli, ani wali imɔ akulyi nde, inde loesha e-botüku, inde loyata wao oso wa Batomomu.
english: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

lokele: Nde Petelo loonga mbo— ¿Anania, monito Satana asotumesa botema waɛ mbo olimbeke Bolimo Botanu la lolanga la ndoisa botüku wa bolïli wa elanga?
english: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

lokele: ¿Ayaliki yao angotaungesomo, elanga etiyaleke eyaɛ? ¿Aungesomu yao, etiyaleke imɔ nda isosha shaɛ angɛnɛ? ¿Monito osoisa loasɔ-lo nda botema waɛ? Otilimbe bato la lolanga, kangä Mungu.
english: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”

lokele: Okakä Anania ebaoi-ba, inde lokwa se, inde lowa. Limɔ bɔwa wa likama loundesa bato batotina ebokakä loasɔ-lo.
english: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

lokele: Baemba to loemala, iyo lolingela bolyo la bisinda, iyo loömba wao.
english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

lokele: Etaka saa isatɔ, wali wande lɔɔtɔ ina ani atiluweke elokelomu.
english: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

lokele: La Petelo loonga lande mbo— ¿Kambesaka’mi, mbo ino boungesiki elanga ko la bolïli-bo? Otomali mbo— Eingo, la bolïli-bo.
english: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”

lokele: Petelo mbo— ¿Monito osokulyana ndososhela Bolimo Wa Ngɛnɛ Mungu? Toka, batindi ba ebaömbiki olome waɛ bakɔɔtɔ bome la batotola aɛ lousa.
english: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

lokele: Kwaamao otomali lokwa se nda bakolo ba Petelo, inde lowa la ɔtɔkɔ̈ baemba, iyo loosh’inde oko ani asowa, lamao iyo loila bolyo, iyo loömba wao tina la olome wande.
english: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

lokele: Limɔ bɔwa wa likama loundesa batotina ba Etanda la batotina ebokakä loasɔ-lo. Bato wike louwesomo nda bindo la nda botema
english: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

lokele: Ko la Batomomu ndembe ya bisisho wike lokelomo sisi ya bato la iyo losɔngɔkɔmɔ nda lilɛlɛ lia Solomo,
english: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

lokele: nde angwɛnɛ wasi wotendela ndowatema lau, nde bato angɛnɛ loinakel’iyo finɛ,
english: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.

lokele: la bato boeta eba oso lolendelo Ngɛnɛ, la batolome la batomali.
english: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

lokele: Eokao iyo loeshaka eba kambo ango nda mboka, iyo loingekes’iyo nda tange la tokala mbo, aketeke Petelo ango elimi yande ekweke ende bamɔi bau.
english: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

lokele: Ongoma bokamu wa bato ba kenge ebitimbi Yelusaleme, iyo loeshakana l’eba kambo la ebawaka la belimo ya bɔwɛwɛ, la batotina bana louwesomo. Petelo la Yoane nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ liasi
english: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.

lokele: Kongo ko Kanga eyeti losoma finɛ, inde la batotina ebaaka lande, bako botuka wa BaSadoke, iyo lotuma la lisiela, iyo loundesa Batomomu,
english: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy

lokele: iyo lot’iyo nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ wa bokenge.
english: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

lokele: Nde la bocho, bokitomo wa Ngɛnɛ loliola biome ya bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, inde lɔkɛs’iyo lousa,
english: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,

lokele: inde mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ, emalaka nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, kambesaka bato wɛndi bototina wa Liwawi-li.
english: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

lokele: Okak’iyo ongoma, iyo lɔɔtɔ nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu la bonyanya, iyo loekesa bato. Ayaka Kanga eyeti la ebaaka lande ndoyasɔngɔmɛsɛ ikumbɛ la benyafala ya bana ba Isalaele, iyo lotoma wɛndi nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ ndokɔsɔ Batomomu.
english: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

lokele: Kongo ko iyaka ba-polisi omao, batiɛnɛkɛ imɔ iyo nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ; ainwak’iyo, iyo loonga mbo—
english: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

lokele: Tooshiki ndakɔ ya bɔnyɔlɔlɔ eliakami biome ngwi, la betingani bemakali nda biome, kongo ko aliol’iso wao, angoosha boto ina.
english: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”

lokele: Okakä to Komanda wa ba polisi ba Ndako ya Mungu la kanga ebieti ebaoi-ba, iyo lowa toloi nda loasɔ-lo, la mbo loni lokayeke nda loao.
english: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

lokele: Nde ɔmɔi loya oyaluwes’iyo mbo— Tɛnɛ ngo, bato ana ebaɔtɛsɛk’ino nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, iyo ana nda Ndako ya Mungu, bemali ani batoekesa bato.
english: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

lokele: Lamao Komanda la polisi amamwito, iyo lɔkɛ okaesha Batomomu, nde inga to la bolengi, eoka bawangaka mbo bato batakushak’iyo batalɛ.
english: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

lokele: Aeshak’iyo batomomu, iyo loemes’iyo oso wa ikumbɛ, limɔ Kanga eyeti lofel’iyo mbo—
english: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

lokele: ¿Toisoimak’ino la itinjo mbo otaekesa bato nda e-lina-li? Nde, tɛnɛ ngo, osotumesa Yelusaleme la liekesi lianu, la ososanga mbo bakila ba e-boto-yo baomaneke oko end’iso.
english: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”

lokele: Petelo la Batomomu lomutola mbo— Loengani nde ndotalitesa ko Mungu, inga bato.
english: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

lokele: Mungu wa batata basu afaka Yesu isosha, nde ino nd’asɛɛsɛlɛsɛkɛ Inde ko ndokakames’Inde nda isandu.
english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

lokele: Mungu nd’asotalia ko Inde kongo, mbo ayaleke Bokota la Bouwesi nda bosamba wande wa olome mbo afeke BaIsalaele fofe ya likalangani la limɛsɛli lia batwanelo;
english: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

lokele: la iso nd’ale baɛni ba njasɔ-bi, imɔ ko la Bolimo Botanu oyasofomo ko la Mungu ende ebatolites’Inde.
english: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

lokele: Okak’iyo ongoma, iyo lotwaka belengi ya likama la basangaka ndoola Batomomu;
english: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

lokele: kongo ko ɔmɔi wa BaFalusi, ako Ngamaliele, boekesi wa Bikela, oyatɛmyɔmɔkɔ ko la bato batotina, inde loemala nda ikumbɛ, inde loonga mbo Batomomu bumesomoko lousa sumbu.
english: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

lokele: Limɔ inde loonga l’ikumbɛ mbo— Bato ba Isalaele, la wɛlï-o nda yao ebikakelek’ino ende ebato-ba,
english: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

lokele: Eoka sumbu oso wa mbile-ye, oto ɔmɔi ako Teudayo loya, inde lotakema mbo ende wana wa oto la bato kwa mia inɛi lowatema lande. Kongo ko inde loolomo la batotina ebalendeloko inde lomelesomo, angolonga ango sinyo.
english: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

lokele: Mbisa yande Yuda wa Ngalilai loya nda mbile ya lotango loa bato, inde loengokolesa bato mbo batutek’inde, inde imɔ loolomo, la batotina ebalendeloko inde lomelesomo mia.
english: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

lokele: La kwani ko ongoma, imi mbo, sɛnyanaka la ebato-ba, machak’iyo, eoka eyambo e-kuko-ye la bakeli-ba bende ya bato, ani bitiangolonga; nde beyala eya Mungu,
english: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

lokele: ani ino angokɔkɔlɔ ndokwesa yao, ango eyata mbo otooshomo mbo osonana ngo ko la Mungu. Ikumbɛ loimela lioi liande.
english: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

lokele: Limɔ iyo lota Batomomu lioi, iyo lokuchak’iyo, iyo loim’iyo mbo bataong’imɔ liasi nda lina lia Yesu, limɔ iyo lota Batomomu se.
english: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

lokele: Limɔ iyo losokwa nda ikumbɛ, iyo loomala finɛ eoka mbo batangomu mbo baondu ndookesomo sɔni loasɔ loa lina-li.
english: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.

lokele: Kongo ko la lise la lise nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu la nda ndakɔ ya oto la oto, batiamachaka ndoekesa la ndonangola Mboli Ilau ya Yesu Masiya.
english: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

lokele: Nda mbile ena eyaulwaka loketi loa baeki, BaHɛlɛnɛ lokimakimela BaEbele eoka mbo ebawelu balome bau baomelesomökö nda bakaɔ ba lise la lise.
english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists 6:1 against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

lokele: Eokao eba liu la ambale losɔngɔmɛsɛ etunda ya baeki, iyo loonga lau mbo— Lotiengane lasu mbo tomacheke ndonangola Lioi lia Mungu ndokakela likuwa lia mɛsa;
english: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

lokele: eokao, Beoto, aaka bato bosambale banu ba lokuku lolau, ebasotuma la Bolimo Botanu la wɛlï la totof’iyo isosha sha e-likuwa-li.
english: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

lokele: Nde iso nd’atotimbanaka la lisomboli la linangoli lia lioi.
english: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

lokele: Batotina ba etunda looka olau nda baoi-ba; iyo loaa e-bato-ba, bako-Setefano, boto oyatumaka la liimeli la Bolimo Botanu, la Filipo, la Pɔlɔkɔlɔ, la Nikanola, la Timona, la Pamena, la Nikolau ewa ndimela wa Antiokia.
english: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

lokele: Iyo loemesa e-bato-ba oso wa Batomomu, limɔ mbisa ya lisomboli, iyo lotelel’iyo bangasa nda botö.
english: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

lokele: Lamao lioi lia Mungu lɔsɛngɛ finɛ la loketi loa baeki nda Yelusaleme loulwaka likama la bokamu wa kanga lolitesa liimeli-li. Lotendela loa Setefano
english: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

lokele: La Setefano oyatumesomoko la booto la bofoka, inde lokela ndembe ya bisisho wike sisi ya bato.
english: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

lokele: Nde bamɔi ba ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ ya ebatotangomu Libetino la eba Kulɛnɛ la eba Alesandulea, la eba Kilikia la Asia, iyo loemakala ndowalana la Setefano,
english: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

lokele: nde batiakɔkɔlɔkɔ ndolongela wɛlï la bolimo ewaongaka lande.
english: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

lokele: Eokao iyo lofɔlɔ bato ba fɔki mbo baongeke mbo— Tosok’inde atoonga baoi bosɛɔlɔ Mɔsɛ la Mungu imɔ.
english: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

lokele: Ongoma iyo lofumbesa bato la biange la batikasa, limɔ iyo loyaosha Setefano, iyo loundes’inde la shɔngɔlɔ, iyo loesh’inde oso w’ikumbɛ.
english: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

lokele: Limɔ bawanjeli ba nanga loemesana ebaongaka mbo— E-boto-yo angomacha ndoonga totefola loasɔ loa Elela-ye etanu la Bikela imɔ.
english: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

lokele: Tosok’inde atoonga mbo Yesu wa Nasaleta-yo efandolaka elela-ye la ekindolaka biyaelo yasu eyafomoko iso la Mɔsɛ.
english: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

lokele: Batotina ebayalaka se nda ikumbɛ lowɛlɛ inde bonono, iyo lɔɛnɛ bɔmbɔ wande kwa bɔfɔnɔ wa bɔmbɔ wa Bokitomo.
english: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

lokele: Limɔ Kanga eyeti loonga mbo— ¿Loasɔ lole ngo ko ani?
english: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

lokele: Setefano mbo— Beoto la batata, toka kɔni, Mungu Oyalongeli lɔɛnɛlɛ ende tata wasu ako Abalayama ani ayalak’inde nda yese ya Mesopotamia oso ani akalimel’inde nda Halana, Inde loonga lande mbo—
english: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

lokele: Sokwaka nda yese yaɛ la bofindi waɛ, yauku nda yese eyetɔɛnɛs’mi wɛnɛs’aɛ.
english: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’ Genesis 12:1

lokele: Lamao inde losokwa nda yese ya Kaladea, inde lolimela nda Halana, limɔ mbisa ya liwa lia sango wande, Mungu losokol’inde omao konda yese olo ayali ino kwani.
english: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.

lokele: Nde atiafak’inde botiko nda yao, ango litaka limwitɔ lia bakolo; kongo ko atikelak’inde lisakä liof’inde yese ena yoyaela, end’inde la ende lioti liande mbisa yande, ani atiyaleke kɔni ango la wana.
english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

lokele: Mungu loonga ani, mbo lioti lia Abalayama liyalaka nde beenda nda yese ya bato basi ebatoundesa iyo bɛkɔwa la ebatokongol’iyo la obe ko miaka mia inɛi.
english: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

lokele: Mungu loonga imɔ ko mbo— Imi nd’atofa bato ana se ebatoundes’iyo kwa bɛkɔwa, la mbisa iyo belasokolomoko ina la belasemolaka Imi nda elela-ye.
english: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’ Genesis 15:13-14

lokele: Limɔ Mungu lofaef’inde ngɛla ya itombe, ongoma Abalayama loota Isaka la inde lotena inde itombe nda lise lia bonanɛi, Isaka loota Yakobo, Yakobo loota bangau basu liu la ambale.
english: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

lokele: Limɔ bangau basu loungesa Yosefa nda Ejipeto ko l’eoka ya lisiela, kongo ko Mungu loyalaka lande;
english: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

lokele: Inde louwes’inde nda bifembi yande bitotina, Inde lofaef’inde elame la wɛlï oso wa Falao, Bɔkɔta wa Ejipeto, oyataliaka Yosefa Komanda nda Ejipeto la nda bokulu wande bototina.
english: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

lokele: Kongo ko londo lofi lokwa nda yese etotina ya Ejipeto la Kanana la bifembi ya likama, ongoma batata basu batiaoshaka bieka omao.
english: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

lokele: Nde okakä Yakobo mbo befonga yaaka nda Ejipeto, inde lotoma batata basu litoma lia oso.
english: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

lokele: Limɔ nda lɔkɛndɔ loa imbale, Yosefa loluwesa baloo bande mbo ale to inde angɛnɛ, la bofindi wa Yosefa loluwana fololo ende Falao.
english: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.

lokele: Limɔ Yosefa lota sango wande ako Yakobo la eba bofindi wande batotina lioi, baaka bato kama bosambale la bɔɔmwi, mbo baɛkɛ end’inde,
english: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

lokele: la Yakobo lɔkɛ konda yese ya Ejipeto, Inde la batata basu lowela ko omao,
english: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

lokele: iyo lotolomo ko omao nda yese ya Shekeme, iyo loingesomo nda losai eloasombaka Abalayama la bieto ende bana ba Hamola nda Shekeme.
english: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.

lokele: Kongo ko ayaka mbile yokɔkɔmɛsɛ lisakä tina, lisakä lina eliatikaka Mungu ende Abalayama, bato loulwa wike, iyo losɛngɛ nda Ejipeto,
english: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

lokele: konda mbile eyaɔlɔkɔ Bɔkɔta wasi isosha, oyatialuwaka Yosefa.
english: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

lokele: Nde inde lokelaka tukela yasu ko bɔlɔwänɛ, inde lokongola batata basu mbo bakusheke banaoli bau tungi mbo batauwa.
english: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

lokele: Mɔsɛ aotomoko nda mbile ena, inde lɔɛnɛlɛ litutuku ende Mungu; ko la tengai isatɔ inde loongolomo nda ndakɔ ya sango wande.
english: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.

lokele: Nde inde lokushomo tungi, lamao boseka wa Falao loil’inde, la inde lokɔsɔl’inde kwa wana wande angɛnɛ.
english: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

lokele: Ongoma Mɔsɛ loekesomo biɛlï bitotina ya BaEjipeto la ayalaka fɔti ya lioi la elalaka nda likuwa liande.
english: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

lokele: Akondak’inde otowange wa miaka kama inɛi, botema wande losanga ndɔkɛ fɛtɛti ende beoto yande bako bana ba Isalaele.
english: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, 7:23 the children of Israel.

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛk’inde oto ɔmɔi wau atokongolomo, inde losungak’inde, inde lokundela oyakongolomu likundo, inde looma ewa Ejipeto kwu.
english: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

lokele: Mɔsɛ loenyela mbo beoto yande baluwi mbo Mungu asouwes’iyo ko la bosamba wande, kongo ko batialuwaka ongoma.
english: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.

lokele: Limɔ lɛlɛngɔ, inde lɔkɛ liasi end’iyo ani batonana, inde lokota ndɔɔngɛsɛ bolengi wau, inde loonga mbo— Batolome, ino wende beoto; ¿Monito otolukana bɔfi?
english: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’

lokele: Kongo ko inde ona oyalukaka wina lande bɔfi, inde mbo— ¿Ndai asɛli aɛ bɔkɔta la bokomyi wasu?
english: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

lokele: Oisɔlɛmbɛ ndoola’mi kwa oliki aɛ ewa Ejipeto lɛlɛngɔ? Okaka Mɔsɛ e-lioi-li inde lokwa botili, inde lokayala ndimela nda yese ya Midiana, la omao inde loota bana batolome bambale.
english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’ Exodus 2:14

lokele: Asilaka miaka kama inɛi, bokitomo lɔɛnɛlɛ ende Mɔsɛ nda liɔmbɛlɛ lia löngo loa Sinai, nda isasandu esiafyaka la wambe wa bösä.
english: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

lokele: Enɛkɛ̈ Mɔsɛ ongoma, inde lomwaala liɛni lina, la asishanak’inde tina mbo aluweke litina, limiki lia Ngɛnɛ Mungu lookana mbo—
english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,

lokele: Imi yende Mungu wa batata baɛ, Mungu wa Abalayama, la wa Isaka, la wa Yakobo; Mɔsɛ loilima la bɔwa, atitendel’imɔ ndotichaka;
english: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Exodus 3:6 Moses trembled and dared not look.

lokele: Limɔ Mungu loonga lande mbo— Sokolaka tokwaka nda batindi baɛ, eoka elela olo emali aɛ ende nyɛlɛ itanu.
english: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

lokele: Isɔɛnɛ ndwɛnɛ bobe ebosokelakomo bato bami nde Ejipeto la isooka besumo yau la isoya se ndɔɔnɔkɔl’iyo omao. Yauku kwani, itotom’aɛ nda Ejipeto.
english: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’ Exodus 3:5

lokele: E-Mɔsɛ-ao oyafekak’iyo oso mbo— ¿Ndai asɛli aɛ bɔkɔta la bokomyi? Mungu nd’atomaka ko inde ndoyala la bɔkɔta la boendoli ko la isosha sha bokitomo oyɛnɛlɛkɛ end’inde nda isasandu.
english: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

lokele: Ende inde oyatolak’iyo oso, oyakelaka ndembe ya bisisho nda Ejipeto la nda Eliya ya Balia batelu, la nda liɔmbɛlɛ ko la miaka kama inɛi.
english: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

lokele: Ende ko e-Mɔsɛ-yo oyaongaka la bana ba Isalaele mbo— Mungu atotaliela ino Bɔtɔndɔli, ambo ɔmɔi wa beoto yanu kwa ataliaka Inde imi.
english: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’ 7:37 Deuteronomy 18:15

lokele: Ende ko inde oyaaka la etanda nda liɔmbɛlɛ amamwito la bokitomo oyaongaka lande nda löngo loa Sinai amamwito la batata basu; inde lofomo baölo ba loiko bofaef’iso.
english: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

lokele: Batata basu batialɛmbɛkɛ ndok’inde, iyo loiliak’inde, iyo lokikwa nda betema yau kiko nda Ejipeto,
english: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,

lokele: ani batoonga la Alana mbo— Keelak’iso mungu oyatokɛndɛl’iso oso, eoka e-Mɔsɛ-yo oyasokolak’iso nda Ejipeto, totiluwe ani esokelomo lande.
english: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’ Exodus 32:1

lokele: Nda bacho bana, iyo lokela bɔfɔɔnɔ wa efembeli ya mbolo, iyo lotamba nyama yofechomo ende bɔfɔɔnɔ ona, limɔ iyo loomala eoka ya likuwa lia besamba yau angɛnɛ.
english: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.

lokele: Nde Mungu loemboel’iyo bɔmbɔ wande, Inde lomach’iyo ndosemola tolonge twa use, kwa atomoko nda lokasa loa Bɔtɔndɔli mbo— ¿Mbo watambaka’mi nyama yoolomo la yotumbomo kwa lifaefi Ko miaka kama inɛi nda liɔmbɛlɛ, ino bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Isalaele?
english: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, 7:42 as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

lokele: Mba, nde waswaka kumbo ya Moloko la ilonge sha mungu eko Lefana, La tokwelo etwakelak’ino okasemokola twao, Limɔ yeundolak’ino omao okakɛs’ino fangi eyɛmɔi ya Babela.
english: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away Amos 5:25-27 beyond Babylon.’

lokele: Batata basu baaka la hema olo asɔngɔmɔk’iyo ndokambesomo bikela nda liɔmbɛlɛ kwa aongaka inde oyakambesaka Mɔsɛ mbo akeleke yao ko la bɔfɔɔnɔ ewɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ inde.
english: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

lokele: Batata basu loaelakanaka hema ena, iyo lotola yao ani iyo amamwito la Yoshua loyɔsɔ e-yese-ye ani basayaka tukela yasi oso wau. Loaaka ongoma ko nda mbile ya Dawidi,
english: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,

lokele: oyaɔlɔkɔ booto wa Mungu la oyaomba isosha shoswela Mungu eyaelo eoka ya bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Yakobo,
english: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

lokele: nde aaka Solomo oyaswelaka Inde ndakɔ angɛnɛ.
english: But Solomon built him a house.

lokele: Kongo ko Mungu Oyalongeli aitoyala nda ndakɔ eyekelomu la besamba ya bato, kwa aongaka Bɔtɔndɔli mbo—
english: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

lokele: Buse wende këka yami, Wenda bole esolo ya batindi bami; Ngɛnɛ Mungu mbo— ¿Boni bɔfɔɔnɔ wa ndakɔ botokeel’ino Imi; Bosamba wami angɛnɛ boisokela bitotina-bi?
english: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?

lokele: Ino bato ba kingo ya betakwa, la ba betema la batoi ba bɛtɛkɔ, ongoma ko fɛtɔ la fɛtɔ ino nd’atofekaka Bolimo Botanu kwa batata banu, ko ino imɔ ko ongoma.
english: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’ Isaiah 66:1-2

lokele: ¿Boni Bɔtɔndɔli atiakongolomoko la batata banu? Baolaka imɔ ebataka boekï wa loyo loa Wengani, ako Inde oyasowamb’ino la oyasool’ino oko kwanikwani,
english: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.

lokele: ino kongo ebafomoko Bikela ko la bakitomo ba isosha, nde otilitese yao. Loolomo loa Setefano la batälɛ
english: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”

lokele: Okak’iyo e-baoi-ba iyo looka betema wale finɛ, iyo lonyangakelesa Setefano bainyo bau.
english: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

lokele: Nde atumesomoko inde la Bolimo Botanu, inde lotichaka nda use, inde lɔɛnɛ tala ya Mungu la Yesu oyemali nda fangi ya olome ya Mungu,
english: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

lokele: inde loonga mbo— Tɛnɛ ngo, isɔɛnɛ buse boliolomu la Wana wa Boto emali nda fangi ya olome ya Mungu.
english: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

lokele: Nde iyo loamama la limiki lifi, iyo loliaka batoi mbo bataoka la batotina losungamel’inde limbilititi,
english: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

lokele: iyo lokushak’inde lousa loa bokenge, iyo loakola ndokushak’inde batälɛ, la ebawanjel’inde losɛlɛkɛ bisinda yau se nda bakolo ba liɛmba ako Saulo.
english: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

lokele: Akushak’iyo batälɛ, ani Setefano atosombola mbo— Ngɛnɛ Yesu, aelaka bolimo wami.
english: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

lokele: Limɔ inde loswa balui se, inde loamama la limiki lifi mbo— Ngɛnɛ, otangelek’iyo e-likeli-li libe. Aongak’inde ongoma, inde lokwa ilɔ. Nde Saulo lokulya liolomu liande.
english: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

lokele: Likongolomu lifi liakolaka ko lise-ao ndoya ende bato ba Etanda nda Yelusaleme; batotina, sakolo ngo ko Batomomu, lomelesomo nda biese ya Yudea la Samalia.
english: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

lokele: Bato bamɔi ba bɔfɔɔmu loila Setefano okaömb’inde, iyo loleel’inde lileeli lifi lia ewa.
english: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

lokele: Nde Saulo lobebesa Etanda, inde lɔkaɔtɛ ndakɔ la ndakɔ, inde losulyaka iyo okakɛs’iyo nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

lokele: Limɔ bato ebamelesomoko loketeta ndokanangole Mboli Ilau. Filipo nda Samalia
english: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

lokele: Nde Filipo lɔkɛkonda bokenge wa Samalia okatel’iyo boekï wa Masiya.
english: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.

lokele: Bikuke ya bato lolailaka la botema ɔmwito inango sha Filipo ani bokakä iyo l’ani bɛnɛk’iyo ndembe ya bisisho eyakelak’inde.
english: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

lokele: Eoka belimo ya bɔwɛwɛ losokwa end’iyo la beulo ya likama la bato wike ebalɛmbɛtɛkɛ l’eba bikoti losäsolomoko säso,
english: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

lokele: yaaka to linɛngina lifi nda okenge ona.
english: There was great joy in that city.

lokele: Boto ɔmɔi ako Simona ayalaka omao nda bokenge ko oso, oyakelaka bisisho yosisimwesa bato ba Samalia la inde loonga la bato mbo ende boto wa lokuku lofi.
english: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

lokele: Batotina lowɛlɛmɛ end’inde, ko ebafi la ebakɛkɛ, iyo mbo— Boto-yo ende bofoka wa Mungu ebotangomu Wesesi.
english: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

lokele: Iyo lowɛlɛmɛ end’inde eoka ko La mbile yumwa inde losisimwesak’iyo ko la bisisho yande.
english: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

lokele: Kongo ko akambesaka Filipo okambes’iyo Mboli Ilau ya Bɔkɔta wa Mungu l’eya lina lia Masiya Yesu, iyo loimela la iyo lolufiomo batolome la batomali.
english: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

lokele: Limɔ ango Simona angɛnɛ loimela, inde lolufiomo limɔ inde lowatema la Filipo, la ɛnɛkɛ Simona ndembe ya bisisho eyakelomoko inde lomwaala.
english: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

lokele: Okakä Batomomu ebayalaka nda Yelusaleme mbo bato ba Samalia basoaela lioi lia Mungu, iyo lotoma Petelo la Yoane end’iyo.
english: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

lokele: Ongoma iyo loya, iyo losomboel’iyo mbo bɔlɛkɛ Bolimo Botanu,
english: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

lokele: eoka bokakwi ende boto angɔmɔi; balufiomokö kongo nda lina lia Yesu.
english: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

lokele: Lamao Batomomu lotel’iyo besamba nda botö la iyo lɔɔlɔ Bolimo Botanu.
english: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ̈ Simona mbo Bolimo Botanu bosofomo iyo ko la lotalio loa besamba ya Batomomu, inde lotamb’iyo bieto, inde mbo—
english: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

lokele: Faka to imi imɔ isosha-si mbo oyakatalieke’mi otalia inde besamba yami, ona ɔlɛkɛ Bolimo Botanu.
english: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”

lokele: Nde Petelo loonga lande mbo— Bieto yaɛ bisɛɛsɛlɛkɛ amamwito laɛ angɛnɛ, eoka otangi nde mbo otoɔlɔ lifi lia Mungu ko la bieto.
english: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

lokele: Oti la likaɔ, angoko botiko nda loasɔ-lo, eoka botema waɛ botiengane chaa nda baiso ba Mungu.
english: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.

lokele: Eokao kalanganaka nda loasɔ-lo loaɛ lobe, sombolaka Ngɛnɛ Mungu mbo eluwa lisangi lia botema waɛ limɛsɛlɔmɔkɔ,
english: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

lokele: eoka isɔɛnɛ mbo wende la bololo wa shungu nda botema la mbo osokandakomo nda njasɔ ibe.
english: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”

lokele: Simona lomutola mbo— Tasomboelaka Ngɛnɛ Mungu loasɔ loami, mbo ango lɔmɔi loa yao ebisoong’aɛ lotayela’mi.
english: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”

lokele: Asilaka to Batomomu ndokambekesa la ndoongana la bato wɛndi wa Ngɛnɛ Mungu, iyo loinwa nda Yelusaleme la iyo lokanangokole Mboli Ilau nda kenge ya Samalia la mboka. Filipa la Bonyafala wa Etiope
english: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

lokele: Bokitomo wa Mungu loonga to la Filipo mbo— Emalaka, tangwaka la ifitika nda mboka eyesokweli Yelusaleme okakɛ konda Ngasa; ele mboka ya liɔmbɛlɛ.
english: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

lokele: Limɔ inde loemala, inde lotangwa. Omao tɛnɛ ngo, boto wa Etiope, Bonyafala wa Bɔkɔta Otomali ako Kandakɛ wa Etiope, aaka bɔfɛnja la ayalaka botingani wa lifoka litotina liande. Ayaka nde ndosemola Mungu nda Yelusaleme,
english: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

lokele: la kwani atoinwa eyande ani ayali se nda elutelo ya punda ani atotanga lokasa loa Yesaya ako Bɔtɔndɔli.
english: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

lokele: La Bolimo loonga la Filipo mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ okawatema la elutelo-ye.
english: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”

lokele: Filipo lokwa mangu la inde lok’inde atotanga lokasa loa Yesaya ako Bɔtɔndɔli. Filipo mbo— Otiluwe litina lia loao elokotang’aɛ?
english: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

lokele: Limɔ inde lomutola mbo— ¿Itokɔkɔlɔ to moni sakolo ko boto atosanoela’mi litina? Inde lofela to Filipo mbo akweke ina okayala se amamwito lande.
english: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

lokele: Botüku wa lokasa ewatangak’inde waaka mbo— Kwa bɔkɔkɔ ebotokɛsɔmɔ okaolomo, La kwa efembeli ya bɔkɔkɔ atoyalaka tau ani atotenakomo fuu, Ko ongoma inde atialiolaka bɔnɔkɔ wande;
english: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.

lokele: Ayalak’inde mbuwa, lokomyomo losofekelomo inde; Ndai kota mboli ya fɛtɔ yande Ani liwawi liande lisosokolomo nda wenda-bo?
english: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.” Isaiah 53:7

lokele: Limɔ ewa bɔfɛnja loonga la Filipo mbo— Kambesaka’mi sumbu, ¿Bɔtɔndɔli aongaka ongoma eoka ya ndai; eoka yande angɛnɛ, kwa eoka ya boto wasi?
english: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

lokele: Limɔ Filipo loakola ndoonga ko loasɔ elosɔnɔmu nda Lokasa loa Yesaya, la inde lokambes’inde Mboli Ilau ya Yesu,
english: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.

lokele: la aɛk’iyo nda mboka, iyo loiyela balia, limɔ ewa bɔfɛnja loonga mbo— Tɛnɛ, balia eya! ¿Loni lotokufesa mbo italufiomo?
english: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

lokele: Filipo mbo Boimela la botema waɛ bototina, aɛ kolufiomo; inde lomutola mbo— Isoimela mbo Yesu Masiya ende Wana wa Mungu.
english: 8:37 Philip said, “If you believe with all your heart, you may.” He answered, “I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.”

lokele: Limɔ inde loonga mbo elutelo esikameke, la iyo yaambale lɔkɛsɛnɛ nda balia, la Filipo la ewa bɔfɛnja; inde lolufya inde.
english: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

lokele: Asaɔwak’iyo nda balia, Bolimo wa Ngɛnɛ lɔɔnɔkɔlɔ Filipo la ewa bɔfɛnja atiɛnɛk’inde imɔ liasi, nde inde lotangwa eyande la limɛngɔ finɛ.
english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

lokele: Filipo nde lɔɛnɛnɛ nda Asedodo, inde loetaka okanangole Mboli Ilau nda okenge la okenge konda aiyak’inde nda Kaisalia.
english: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

lokele: Kongo ko Saulo loyowayowaka nganyä yosingesa baeki ba Ngɛnɛ, inde lɔkɛ ende Kanga eyeti,
english: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

lokele: okafel’inde kasa ende eba bisɔngɔmɛlɔ nda Damaseke mbo eosha ebimeli Mboka ya Liuwesi, kwa batolome ango batomali imɔ, inde koesh’iyo nda bɛnyɔlɔlɔ konda Yelusaleme.
english: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

lokele: Nda lɔkɛndɔ loande, iyak’inde tina la Damaseke, futuku liangangi lia ibalibali sha use loangangel’inde la inde lokwa se kwu nda nyɛlɛ,
english: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

lokele: la inde looka limiki elitoonga lande mbo— ¿Saulo, Saulo, otokongolaka’mi monito?
english: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

lokele: Inde mbo— ¿Bwana, wende to ndai? Inde mbo— Imi yende Yesu oyatokongolomo laɛ.
english: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting. 9:5

lokele: nde emalaka, ɔtɔkɔ nda okenge, limɔ lona elokakeleke aɛ kokambesomo aɛ.
english: But 9:6 rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

lokele: Kongo ko ebakɛndɛni lande loemakala ko tau; bokakä nde limiki, batiɛnɛkɛ nde boto.
english: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

lokele: Saulo loemala ani ayalaka nda nyɛlɛ, nde aliolak’inde baiso, atiɛnɛkɛ yeka, limɔ iyo lounda inde la osamba okakɛs’inde nda Damaseke.
english: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

lokele: La ko la becho esatɔ atiɛnɛkɛ, atialaka la atiamwaka yeka.
english: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

lokele: Boeki ɔmɔi ayalaka nda Damaseke, lina liande liko Anania; la Ngɛnɛ loonga lande nda liɛni mbo— Anania! Inde mbo— Imi-yo, Ngɛnɛ.
english: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”

lokele: Limɔ Ngɛnɛ mbo— Emalaka, kɛndɛkɛ nda mboka eyetangomu mbo Mboka ya fii la felaka nda ndakɔ ya Yudasi loasɔ loa boto ako Saulo wa Talusu, akosombola ko kwani,
english: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah 9:11 for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

lokele: la asɔɛnɛ nda liɛni mbo boto ako Anania asoya oyatel’inde besamba mbo ɛnɛkɛ liasi.
english: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”

lokele: Anania lomutola mbo— Ngɛnɛ, isoka ko ende bato wike, njasɔ ya eboto-yo, njasɔ ibe finɛ eyakelaka’inde ende bato baɛ nda Yelusaleme;
english: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

lokele: la eyamaya ale la isosha sha Kanga eyeti shokandaka batotina ebatosingwaka lina liaɛ.
english: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

lokele: Ngɛnɛ loonga lande mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ, eoka ale ɛɛngɔ yami eyesoaa’mi yotolaka lina liami ende tukela ya wenda, la ende bɛkɔta la bana ba Isalaele.
english: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

lokele: Eoka Imi nd’atoluwes’inde biale bifi ebikokek’inde ko l’eoka ya lina liami.
english: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
