lokele: Anania lɔkɛ, inde lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ, inde lotalia besamba ende Saulo inde mbo— Saulo etungani yami, Ngɛnɛ Yesu oyɛnɛliki ende aɛ nda mboka ani ayiki aɛ, asotoma’mi mbo wɛnɛkɛ liasi la mbo otumesomoko la Bolimo Botanu.
english: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

lokele: Kwaamao yeka kwa mboso losokwa nda baiso bande, limɔ inde lɔɛnɛ liasi; inde loemala, inde lolufiomo.
english: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

lokele: Limɔ alak’inde bieka, inde lowangema bindo.
english: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

lokele: Saulo loyala bacho bamɔi amamwito la baeki ba Damaseke la inde lonangoela Yesu nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ ko la mbile-ao, mbo Inde nd’ale Wana wa Mungu.
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

lokele: Batotina ebokak’inde lomwaala, iyo mbo— Oyo ati inde oyabebesaka bato ebatosingwaka e-lina-li? ¿Atiyeke eya mbo akɛsɛkɛ iyo ende Kanga ebieti ani basokandakomo bɔnyɔlɔlɔ?
english: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

lokele: Kongo ko Saulo lokɔkɔmɔ la bofoka, Inde lolonga BaYuda ebayalaka nda Dameseke la tonango twande, ani aesak’inde batina se mbo Oyo ako Yesu ende Masiya.
english: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

lokele: Mbisa ya bacho sumbu wike, BaYude lɔɔtɔ ikumbɛ shool’inde,
english: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

lokele: Kongo ko Saulo lokambesomo kuko yau; iyo lolamba biome ya okenge iyɔlɛ, la löwa la ocho, mbo bolek’inde.
english: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

lokele: Nde baeki bande lɔɔs’inde la ocho, iyo losulol’inde se k’olikolo lia likula nda bofalo.
english: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

lokele: Iyak’inde nda Yelusaleme, inde lokota ndowatema la baeki, nde iyo batotina lowang’inde, eoka batiimelaka mbo ale boeki wewe.
english: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

lokele: Nde Balanaba loesh’inde ende Batomomu, inde lokambes’iyo ani ɛnɛkɛ Saulo wɛnɛ Yesu nda mboka la ani aongaka Yesu lande, l’ani anangolaka inde la lotendela nda lina lia Yesu nda Damaseke.
english: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

lokele: Limɔ Saulo loyalaka lau, inde lɔkɛ lau l’olo l’olo ani atonangokole fololo nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ,
english: He was with them entering into 9:28 Jerusalem,

lokele: la inde lowalana la BaHela, nde iyo lokota ndool’inde.
english: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. 9:29 He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, 9:29 but they were seeking to kill him.

lokele: Nde aluwaka beoto ongoma, iyo loesh’inde konda Kaisalia, limɔ iyo lotom’inde nda Talusu. Etanda lolatema la likɔkɔmɛlɛ
english: When the brothers 9:30 knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

lokele: Ongoma Etanda nda Yudea la Ngalilai, la nda Samalia, nda biese bitotina-bi, yao loyala la lilatɛmi, yao lokɔkɔmɔ kɔkɛ, yao lɔkɛ la oso yowanga Mungu nda lilitesi la ko la lisungi lia Bolimo Botanu yao loulwaka. Tomo bimɔi ya Petelo nda linangoli
english: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

lokele: Akɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ Petelo inde loiya ende beoto ya Etanda nda Luda,
english: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

lokele: la omao inde loosha boto ɔmɔi lina liande liko Ainea oyaingaelaka tange ko miaka bonanɛi la loo loa lonyango.
english: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

lokele: Petelo loonga lande mbo— Ainea, Yesu Masiya asosäsol’aɛ, emalaka, komiaka tange!
english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

lokele: Inde loemala lisasaya. Batotina ebayalaka nda Luda la Shalona, iyo lɔɛnɛ inde la iyo lokikwa ende Ngɛnɛ.
english: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

lokele: Nda Yopa botomali ɔmɔi oyaaka boeki, lina liko Tabita (litina mbo Dokase ako Kenge) la aaka botomali wa bofiimbi wokelaka tomo ya booto la bolau.
english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. 9:36 This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

lokele: Nda bacho ana inde loaelo loo, limɔ inde lowa. Asoolak’iyo bolyo, iyo loingesa wao nda litenya olikolo lia ndakɔ.
english: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

lokele: Kwa ayalaka bokenge wa Luda tina la Yopo, okakä baeki mbo Petelo ale nda Luda, iyo lotoma bato ambale end’inde okat’inde lioi mbo— Olenjëke oya end’iso mangu.
english: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men 9:38 to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

lokele: La Petelo loemala okakɛ amamwito lau. Iyak’inde nda ndakɔ, iyo lɔkɛs’inde nda litenya olikolo lia ndakɔ, la eba tika ya olome batotina loemakala ndolingela bolyo ani batolela, iyo lotambaka kanjo la bisinda eyakelaka Dokase ani ayali inde oko amamwito lau.
english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

lokele: Kongo ko Petelo lokusola batotina lousa, limɔ inde loswa balui se ndosombola. Limɔ inde lokikwa ende bolyo, inde loonga mbo— Tabita, emalaka! Otomali loliola baiso, limɔ ɛnɛkɛ̈ inde Petelo, inde loemesa bɔkɔngɔ.
english: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

lokele: Petelo lof’inde bosamba la inde loemes’inde fii. Limɔ ani asota ebaimeli la eba tika ya olome lioi, inde loemes’inde oso wau oko la liwawi.
english: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

lokele: E-loasɔ-lo loluwana nda bokenge bototina wa Yopa la bato wike loimela Ngɛnɛ.
english: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

lokele: La Petelo lotikala bacho wike nda Yopa la boto ako Simona oyaaka wömesi wa kofo ya nyama.
english: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

lokele: Aaka nda Kaisalia boto ɔmɔi lina liande liko Kolenelio, ako Komanda wa botükä wa basilikani ewatangomoko mbo Botükä wa Italia.
english: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

lokele: Ayalaka boto wa liengani la bolitesi wa Mungu, inde la eba bofindi wande batotina; boto wa lifafu liofaefa bato bakaɔ la oyasombokolaka Mungu la bofiili.
english: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

lokele: La lilongolongo, inde lɔɛnɛ liɛni ko swa mbo Bokitomo wa Mungu atɔɔtɔ ndakɔ l’ani atoonga lande mbo— Kolenelio.
english: At about the ninth hour of the day, 10:3 he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”

lokele: Nde inde lowɛlɛ inde liseme la bɔwa finɛ, inde mbo— Bwana, end’iye to? Bokitomo mbo— Basombokoli baɛ la lifafu liaɛ wike basoiya oso wa Mungu ndoenyelomo lande.
english: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

lokele: Tomaka to kwani wɛndi nda Yopa ndokɔsɔ Simona, boto oyatangomu imɔ mbo Petelo;
english: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

lokele: akoyali bɔɛnda ende Simona wömesi wa kofo ya nyama, ndakɔ yande ele tina la balia ba bokwa.
english: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside. 10:6

lokele: Asokwaka bokitomo oyaongaka lande, limɔ inde lota bɛkɔwa imbale ya ndakɔ la bosilikani ɔmɔi wa liengani oyatinganaka lande lise la lise,
english: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

lokele: limɔ inde losanoel’iyo loasɔ lototina, la inde lotom’iyo yaatotina nda Yopa. Liɛni eliɛnɛkɛ Petelo nda Yopa
english: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ aɛk’iyo nda lɔkɛndɔ, l’ani iyak’iyo tina la okenge, nda ifitika Petelo lolila olikolo lia ndakɔ okasombola omao.
english: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

lokele: Limɔ inde lowa l’isiye la inde loka yɛmɛ yola, nde akolamb’iyo olambel’inde bieka, inde lowa itɔɔ,
english: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

lokele: la inde lɔɛnɛ liɛni, buse loliolomo la yeka kwa lündü lofi loa esinda losulwa se, eloakandomoko bekulu nda tokululu tɔnɛi.
english: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

lokele: Bɛfɔnɔ bitotina ya nyama la ebitolandalanda la nɔli imɔ yayalaka omao atiteni ya loao.
english: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

lokele: Limɔ limiki lookomo mbo— Petelo, emalaka, olaka, laka!
english: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”

lokele: Nde Petelo loonga mbo— Mbayo, Ngɛnɛ, eoka itileke yeka ango sinyo, ani ekasaesomu bokili, l’ani ekatanesomu.
english: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

lokele: La limiki lookomo lande liasi, mbo— E-yeka-ena eyesotanesa Mungu, aɛ angotanga mbo ende bokili.
english: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”

lokele: Bitotina-bi lokelakomo bakela basatɔ la mbisa yeka ena losuliomo futuku nda use.
english: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.

lokele: Awaka Petelo toloi toluwa litina lia liɛni eliɛnɛk’inde, kwaamao bato ebatomomoko la Kolenelio la ebafeliki ndakɔ ya Simona, iyo loemala oko nda biome.
english: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

lokele: Iyo loamama ndofela kwa mbo Simona oyatangomo Petelo aingali bɔɛnda onomono.
english: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

lokele: Limɔ aenyalaka Petelo e-liɛni-li, Bolimo loonga lande mbo—
english: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three 10:19 men seek you.

lokele: Tɛnɛ, bato bambale bakoluk’aɛ; emalaka, sulwaka se la kɛndɛkɛ lau, angwɛnɛ ifɔki eoka Imi nd’atomak’iyo ende aɛ.
english: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

lokele: Ongoma Petelo losulwa se okaonga la bato mbo— Tɛnɛ, imi yende boto oyatoluk’ino! ¿Lini litina elisoy’ino?
english: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

lokele: Iyo loonga nde mbo— Kulenelio, Komanda wa botükä wa basilikani, oto wa liengani la oyatolitesa Mungu, oyatotangomo boto bolau ko la tukela etotina ya BaYuda, oyaongelomu la bokitomu botanu mbo atomeke wɛndi end’aɛ mbo ɔɛkɛ nda ndakɔ yande mbo inde okeke inango shaɛ.
english: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”

lokele: Ongoma Petelo lofel’iyo mbo bɔtɛkɛ okaingala nda ndakɔ. Petelo nda ndakɔ ya Kulenelio ewa Loma Lɛlɛngɔ Petelo loemala okakɛ amamwito lau la bamɔi ba beoto ya Yopa lokɛsɛnɛ lande;
english: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

lokele: limɔ lɛlɛngɔ eyemɔi iyo loiya nda Kaisalia. Omao Kulenelio lɔwɛlɛ loyo loau baiso ani asosɔngɔmɛsɛ eba bofindi wande la baina bande ba losamɔ.
english: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

lokele: Limɔ aɔtɔkɔ Petelo nda ndakɔ Kulenelio loyatowana lande, inde lotulama se nda bakolo bande ndosemol’inde.
english: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

lokele: Kongo ko Petelo loilak’inde likolo, inde mbo— Emalaka, imi imɔ yende ko boto kongo.
english: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

lokele: Limɔ aonganak’iyo, Petelo lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ, limɔ inde loosha bato wike basɔngɔmu;
english: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

lokele: inde loonga lau mbo-Ino angɛnɛ nd’aluwi la wɛlï mbo boto wa BaYuda asotomo liti mbo angowatema la bato ba tukela yasi, angokɛ fɛtɛti end’iyo. Nde Mungu asoluwesa ambo imi mbo angotanga boto angɔmɔi bokili kwa mbo atitane.
english: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.

lokele: Eokao, atomoko’mi lioi, iyi nde angofeka ango sinyo. Kwani isofela to mbo— ¿Oti nde’mi lioi litina moni?
english: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”

lokele: Kolenelio loonga mbo— Nda lise lia anɛi elisoeta la mbile-ye ya löwa aaka’mi atosombola nda ndakɔ yami la lilongolongo, limɔ futuku boto oyawatiki bisinda ya tongɛlingɛli loemala oso wami, inde loonga mbo—
english: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, 10:30 I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing

lokele: Kolenelio, lisomboli liaɛ la lifafu liaɛ wike, basoenyakelomo la Mungu.
english: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

lokele: Tomaka to wɛndi nda Yopa, okata Simona oyatangomu imɔ Petelo lioi, akoyali nda ndakɔ ya Simona wömesi wa kofo ya nyama, tina la balia ba bokwa.
english: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’

lokele: Lisasaya to, itomiki wɛndi end’aɛ la kwani ko la booto waɛ osoya to. Ongoma to, iso yaatotina tososɔngɔmɔ eya kwani nda baiso ba Mungu, ndolaila bitotina ebisokambesa Mungu okambes’aɛ mbo oongeke yao. Wɛndi wa Mungu lonangolomo ende ebati BaYuda
english: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

lokele: Limɔ Petelo loakola ndoonga lau mbo— Isɔɛnɛ wewe mbo Mungu aitokwelakwela biɔmbɔ ya bato,
english: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

lokele: kongo ko nda tukela bitotina boto oyatolitesa Mungu la oyatokelaka eyengani, Mungu kokulya inde.
english: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

lokele: Ino nd’aluwi lioi eliatomaka Mungu ende BaIsalaele, liko wɛndi wa lilatɛmi ko la Yesu Masiya (ende Ngɛnɛ wa yaatotina),
english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—

lokele: wɛndi-bo wanangolomoko ko la yese etotina ya Yudea, liakoli ko nda Ngalilai la mbisa ya lilufi elianangolaka Yoane,
english: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

lokele: mbo Yesu wa Nasaleta loüchomo la Mungu ko la Bolimo Botanu la bofoka, la mbo Yesu lokakɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ okakele bolau la booto okuwese bato batotina ebakakalesomoko la Satana, eoka Mungu nd’ayalaka lande.
english: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

lokele: Iso nd’ale ebaɛni bitotina eyakelak’Inde la nda yese ya Yudea la nda Yelusaleme. Nde iyo lokakames’Inde nda isandu mbo bolek’Inde.
english: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also 10:39 killed, hanging him on a tree.

lokele: Mungu atɛmɔlɔkɔ ko E-Yesu-yo la liwawi nda lise lia asatɔ mbisa ya liwa la asɔɛnɛs’Inde fololo ende bato,
english: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,

lokele: inga ende batotina, kangä ende ebaɛni ebaaomu la Mungu oso, ambo iso ebasola la ebasomwa amamwito lande mbisa ya litɛmwi liande nda liwa.
english: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

lokele: La akambesak’iso mbo toteke boekï la tosanoeleke bato mbo ende ko Inde oyasɛlɔmu la Mungu Bokomyi wa ebakoyala la liwawi la ebasowa imɔ.
english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

lokele: Batɔndɔli batotina batɔndɔlɔkɔ loasɔ loande mbo boto oyakaimelek’Inde, eɔlɔkɔ limɛsɛli lia batwanelo bande ko la lina liande.
english: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

lokele: Ani Petelo angotasila ndoonga, Bolimo Botanu lokwa end’iyo yaatotina ebokaka wɛndi.
english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

lokele: Limɔ BaYuda ebimelaka ebayaka amamwito la Petelo, iyo lotwaka liena liomwaala mbo Bolimo Botanu bosowɛlɛmɛ imɔ ko ende ebati BaYuda.
english: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

lokele: Eoka bokak’iyo batoongana la baoi basi la batoinekela Mungu. Limɔ Petelo loonga liasi, inde mbo—
english: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

lokele: ¿Ndai to atokɔkɔlɔ ofeka balia bolufia e-bato-ba ebasofomo Bolimo Botanu kwa asofomo imɔ ko iso?
english: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

lokele: La inde loonga lau mbo balufiomoko nda lina lia Yesu Masiya. Limɔ iyo lofela Petelo mbo atatikalaka lau bacho bamɔi sumbu.
english: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

lokele: Okakä to Batomomu la beoto ebayalaka nda Yudea mbo bato ebati BaYuda imɔ basoimela wɛndi wa Mungu,
english: Now the apostles and the brothers 11:1 who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

lokele: la ainwaka Petelo nda Yelusaleme, ebalitesaka iongo sha itombe, iyo lofenyana lande, mbo—
english: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

lokele: Waɛkɛ ende eba losunga la walaka lau bieka.
english: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”

lokele: Nde Petelo loakola ndosanoel’iyo loasɔ la wɛlï, inde mbo—
english: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

lokele: Imi loyala nda okenge wa Yopa nda lisomboli, awaka’mi itɔɔ, imi lɔɛnɛ liɛni, yeka kwa lündü lofi loa esinda losulwa se, eloakandomoko bekulu nda tokululu tɔnɛi, yao loya ko tina lami.
english: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

lokele: Atichaka’mi yao la wɛlï mbo iluweke yao, limɔ yɛnɛkɛ nyama ya okenge la eya lokonda la ebitolandalanda la nɔli imɔ.
english: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.

lokele: Limɔ imi looka limiki elitoonga lami mbo— Petelo, emalaka, okaka, laka!
english: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’

lokele: Limɔ imi mbo— Mbayɔ, Ngɛnɛ, eoka angwɛnɛ yeka eyekasaesomu bokili la eyekatanesomu ekaɔti nda bɔnɔkɔ wami.
english: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’

lokele: Kongo ko limiki lomutola nda use ko liasi mbo— Yeka ena eyesotanesa Mungu, aɛ angotanga mbo ende bokili.
english: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’

lokele: Bitotina-bi lokelakomo bakela basatɔ, limɔ bitotina losuliomo liasi konda use.
english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

lokele: Tɛnɛ, kola mbile-ao bato basatɔ loiyela ndakɔ eyeyael’iso, ebatomomoko ko nda Kaisalia oyaluka’mi nda Yopa,
english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

lokele: la Bolimo loonga lami mbo ikɛkɛ lau, angwɛnɛ ifɔki; e-beoto-bi liambɛ imɔ lɔkɛsɛnɛ lami, la iso atotina lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya Komanda,
english: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.

lokele: limɔ inde lokambes’iso ani ɛnɛk’inde wɛnɛ bokitomo emali nda ndakɔ yande oyaongaka lande mbo— Tomaka wɛndi nda Yopa ndokɔsɔ Simona oyatangomu imɔ mbo Petelo;
english: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

lokele: inde atoonga laɛ inango shouwes’aɛ la bofindi waɛ bototina.
english: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’

lokele: Anangolaka’mi, Bolimo Botanu lokwa end’iyo kwa imɔ ko end’iso nda baakoelo.
english: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

lokele: Limɔ imi loenyela baoi ebaongaka Ngɛnɛ mbo— Yoane nd’alufiaka la balia, nde ino bolufiomoko la Bolimo Botanu.
english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

lokele: ¿Eya to mbo Mungu afaka end’iyo ko lifaefi-ao eliafak’Inde imɔ ko iso ani aimelak’iso Ngɛnɛ Yesu Masiya, ani imi yende to ndai wokɔkɔlɔ ndokufesa Mungu?
english: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”

lokele: Okak’iyö ongoma, iyo loyala tau, iyo loinela Mungu, iyo mbo— Mungu asofaefa imɔ ko bato ba wenda likalangani la loiko elosoya la liao. Liakoli lia Etanda nda Antiokia
english: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”

lokele: Nde ebamelanaka fangi la fangi ko l’eoka ya likongolomu eliayaka loasɔ loa Setefano, iyo lɔkɛkɛ ko nda Foinike la Kupolio la Antiokia, nde batianangolaka wɛndi ende bato, sakolo ngo ko BaYuda kongo.
english: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

lokele: Kongo ko bamɔi bau, bato ba Kupulio la Kulene, iyak’iyo nda Antiokia, iyo loonga imɔ la BaHela, iyo lokambes’iyo Mboli Ilai ya Ngɛnɛ Yesu.
english: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, 11:20 preaching the Lord Jesus.

lokele: La bofoka wa Ngɛnɛ Mungu wayalaka lau la loketi loa bato ebimelaka la ebakikwaka ende Ngɛnɛ loaaka lofi.
english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

lokele: Okomokö e-mboli-bi nda batoi ba Etanda nda Yelusaleme, iyo lotoma Balanaba nda Antiokia,
english: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

lokele: la iyak’inde omao, inde loomala la limɛngɔ finɛ ndwɛnɛ bootaota wa Mungu end’iyo, la inde lofumbes’iyo batotina mbo bakɔkɔmesɛkɛ betema yau ndowatema la Ngɛnɛ,
english: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

lokele: eoka aaka boto bolau oyatumaka la Bolimo Botanu la liimeli, ongoma bikuke wike lowatema la Ngɛnɛ.
english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

lokele: Limɔ Balanaba lɔkɛ nda Talusu okaluka Saulo;
english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

lokele: la oshak’inde, inde loesha Saulo nda Antiokia. Limɔ ko la mwaka bototina iyo losɔngɔkɔmɔ la Etanda, la iyo loekesa bikuke ya bato wike omao. Baeki batomoko lina liko Eba Masiya ko oso nda Antiokia.
english: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

lokele: Nda bacho-ba to batɔndɔli basokwaka nda Yelusaleme, baɛkɛ nda Antiokia,
english: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

lokele: limɔ ɔmɔi wau ako Angabo oyaekesomu la Bolimo ongoma, inde loemala ndotɔndɔlɔ mbo londo lofi loyaka nde nda wenda bototina. Loao loya nde wewe nda mbile ya Kalaudio Kaisala.
english: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

lokele: Baeki losangana to ndotoma bieto, oto la oto kwa akɔkɔlɔkɔ inde, ndosunga beoto ebiyali nda Yelusaleme;
english: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

lokele: la iyo lokela ongoma, iyo lotoma yao ende biange ko la besamba ya Balanaba la Saulo.
english: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

lokele: Nda mbile ena, Bɔkɔta Helodi loundesa bamɔi ba Etanda la olengi.
english: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

lokele: Inde loola Yakobo boloo wa Yoane la chaka,
english: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

lokele: limɔ ɛnɛk’inde mbo BaYuda basoka bolau finɛ nda loasɔ-lo, inde losangana imɔ loasi loko oundes’imɔ ko Petelo; yaaka nde bacho ba lituma eliti la fulo,
english: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

lokele: la aundesak’inde Petelo, inde lokandak’inde bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, la betükä binɛi ya basilikani banɛi banɛi bolambak’inde; inde losanga ndokusol’inde oso wa bato, mbisa ya Elambɔ ya Lieti.
english: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

lokele: Ongoma to Petelo lomachana nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, kongo ko Etanda losombokola Mungu ko la bofiili loasɔ loande. Petelo lokusolomo nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ
english: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

lokele: Nde la bocho ewasangaka Helodi ndokusol’inde, Petelo loingala ilɔ atiteni ya basilikani ambale ani akandomu la bɛnyɔlɔlɔ imbale l’ani basilikani ambale loemala nda biome ndolamba ndakɔ ya bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

lokele: Futuku bokitomo wa Mungu lɔɛnɛlɛ la liangangi loangangela litenya; inde looma Petelo nda likuka, inde losisɔlɔ inde yai, inde mbo— Emalaka mangu! Limɔ bɛnyɔlɔlɔ losɔngwasɔngwa nda besamba yande.
english: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.

lokele: Limɔ bokitomo loonga lande mbo— Wataka bɔkɔli la wataka tokwaka twaɛ. Inde lokela ongoma limɔ bokitomo loonga lande mbo— Wataka imɔ ko kanjo, tutaka’mi!
english: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

lokele: Petelo lokuswa okatut’inde, nde atiaenyelaka mbo loao eloakelaka bokitomo loende wewe, atangaka nde mbo asɔɛnɛ liɛni.
english: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

lokele: Limɔ iyo loeta botükä wa oso, l’ewa imbale wa betingani, iyo loiyela bome wa yeto ewa lousa, wao loliolama wao angɛnɛ mbo beteke; iyo lokuswa nda okenge, la akɛndɛkɛ iyo nda mboka, lamao bokitomo losɛnyana lande.
english: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

lokele: Aluwaka Petelo oluwa loasɔ la wɛlï, inde loonga mbo— Kwani iluwi nde wewe mbo Ngɛnɛ asotoma bokitomo wande la asɔɔnɔkɔlɔ’mi nda besamba ya Helodi la nda loao lototina eloasangaka BaYuda.
english: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”

lokele: Aenyeläk’inde ongoma, inde lɔkɛ nda ndakɔ ya Malia, nyango wa Yoane oyatangomu imɔ mbo Malako, olo asɔngɔmɔkɔ bato wike nda lisomboli.
english: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

lokele: Atitaka Petelo bome wa lilɛlɛ, boseka wa likuwa ako Loda loya oyaaola,
english: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.

lokele: limɔ alembeelaka inde limiki lia Petelo, atitalioelak’inde bome ko l’eoka ya limɛngɔ finɛ, nde inde lokwa mangu okakambes’iyo mbo Petelo aemali nda bome.
english: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

lokele: Nde iyo loonga lande mbo— Osowa loseka! Kongo ko boseka lokɔkɔmɔ ndoonga mbo lole ongoma, nde iyo mbo— Ende bokitomo wande.
english: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

lokele: Ani Petelo atotitaka bome lousa; nde aliolak’iyo, iyo lɔɛnɛ inde, iyo lomwaala finɛ.
english: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.

lokele: Limɔ inde lɔfɛfɛ bosamba wande mbo bayaleke tau, limɔ inde lokambes’iyo ani asokusola Ngɛnɛ okusol’inde nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, inde mbo— Luwesaka Yakobo la beoto loasɔ-lo. Limɔ inde losokwa, inde lotangwa ko elela yasi.
english: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

lokele: Asɔswaka bonyanya, loeyaeyo lofi ende basilikani mbo loni loasɔ losoyela Petelo.
english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

lokele: Alukaka Helodi olukak’inde, angoosh’inde; limɔ inde lokotola basilikani, inde lota ndola mbo bolomoko. Liwa lia Helodi Akulipa
english: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

lokele: Limɔ Helodi losokwa nda Yudea, inde lokayala nda Kaisalia. La inde losoma finɛ la bato ba Tulo la Sidona, eokao iyo losɔngɔkɔmɔ end’inde la asilak’iyo ndɔɔngɔlɔ Bulaseto ako bonyafala wa Helodi, iyo loomb’inde ndotinya lau lilatemi eoka yese yau yalendeloko eya Helodi loasɔ loa bieka.
english: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.

lokele: Eokao ko la lise eliatinyomoko lisho, Helodi lowataka lilɛngɔ lia bɔkɔta la inde loyala se nda kɛka ya likomyi, inde loakola ndonangola end’iyo;
english: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

lokele: limɔ bato ba ekuke loamama la limiki lifi mbo— Limiki lia Mungu, inga elia boto angɛnɛ.
english: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”

lokele: Kwaamao bokitomo wa Mungu looma Helodi, eoka atiainelaka Mungu la lilitesi; nduka yande lolomo la tɔngɔnɔ, inde lokwela se.
english: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

lokele: Kongo ko wɛndi wa Ngɛnɛ losɛngɛ, wao loulwaka finɛ.
english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

lokele: Asilaka Balanaba la Saulo tomo eyatomomoko iyo, limɔ iyo loinwa Yelusaleme, iyo loesha amamwito lau Yoane oyatangomoko Malako.
english: Barnabas and Saul returned to 12:25 Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

lokele: Baaka nde nda Etanda omao nda Antiokia, la batɔndɔli la baekesi, bako Balanaba, la Simona Windo, la Lukio wa Kulene, la Manae oyaaka wana wa nungesa wa Helodi Antipas, la Saulo.
english: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

lokele: Asemolak’iyo Mungu la akilak’iyo bieka nda lisomboli, Bolimo Botanu loonga mbo— Üchelaka’mi Balanaba la Saulo nda likuwa elisotomo iyo lioi.
english: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

lokele: Limɔ mbisa ani bakilaka bieka ko la lisomboli, iyo lotaliel’iyo besamba, iyo lotik’iyo nda lɔkɛndɔ.
english: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

lokele: Atomomoko iyo ongoma ko la Bolimo Botanu, iyo lɔkɛ konda balia nda Selukia, iyo losokwa omao okakɛ la watɔ wa lofofo konda Kupolio.
english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

lokele: Iyakä iyo nda bokenge wa Salami iyo lonangola wɛndi wa Mungu nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ ya BaYuda; baaka imɔ la Yoane Malako bosungak’iyo.
english: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

lokele: Atandelak’iyo bosanga bototina ko nda bokenge wa Pafo, omao iyo loosha WaYuda ɔmɔi ako Baliesu Elima oyaaka kanga la bɔtɔndɔli wa bolimbake,
english: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

lokele: oyayalaka la Bɔkɔmɔnyi wa bosanga ako Selengio Paulo oyaaka boto wa wɛlï finɛ. Inde lota Balanaba la Saulo lioi, inde loluka fofe yoka wɛndi wa Mungu.
english: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

lokele: Kongo ko Elima ako kanga (litina lia lina lile mbo bosinji) inde lofekel’iyo, inde lokota ndokufesa Bɔkɔmɔnyi mbo ataimela.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

lokele: Lamao Saulo oyaaka imɔ la lina liasi liko Paulo, atumak’inde la Bolimo Botanu, inde lowɛlɛ Elima bonono,
english: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him

lokele: inde mbo— Aɛ oyasotuma la yɛnɔ la bolimbakeli, wana wa Satana, oyasoiyela bitotina ebiengani, otiamache ndofinyaka mboka ya liengani ya Mungu?
english: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

lokele: Tɛnɛngɔ, bosamba wa Mungu bosotalema end’aɛ la wayala nde la botuku, otiɛnɛ liso lia use ko mbile bimɔi. Kwaamao liumba la boundundu lokwel’inde, inde lotufatufa okaluke bosamba wa boto wokɛndɛs’inde.
english: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛkɛ Bɔkɔmɔnyi loasɔ elosokelomo, inde loimela, inde lomwaala eoka ya liekesi lia Ngɛnɛ.
english: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

lokele: Limɔ Paulo la ebakɛsɛni lande, iyo loilia owale okakɛ nda Pelenga nda yese ya Pamfulia, nde Yoane Malako losɛnyana lau, inde loinwa nda Yelusaleme;
english: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

lokele: iyo losokwa nda Pelenga, iyo loiya nda bokenge wa Antiokia Pisidia nda yese ya Galatia. Inango sha Paulo nda Antiokia-Pisidia Nda lise lia Yenga, iyo lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ, iyo loyala se omao.
english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

lokele: Mbisa ya litangi lia Lokasa loa Bikela la eloa Batɔndɔli, betoli oso ya ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ lotomel’iyo wɛndi mbo— Beoto, eyambo wende la lioi lia lifumbesi lioonga la bato, ongaka to sumbu.
english: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”

lokele: Limɔ Paulo loemala, inde lofɛfɛl’iyo bosamba mbo bokeke, inde mbo— BaIsalaele la ino ebatolitesa Mungu, okaka to!
english: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

lokele: Mungu wa ebato-ba ba Isalaele loaa batata basu, Inde losɛngɛs’iyo likama nda mbile eyayaelak’iyo nda Ejipeto konda asokolaka iyo omao ko la bofoka finɛ.
english: The God of this people 13:17 chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

lokele: Ko la miaka kama inɛi Inde loles’iyo bieka nda liɔmbɛlɛ;
english: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

lokele: Inde lokakalesa tukela yasi osambale limɔ Inde lofaefa batata basu yese ena yau eko Kanana eyaleke lisango liau ko miaka mia inɛi la kama bɔɔmwi.
english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

lokele: Limɔ mbisa yamao Inde lofaef’iyo Bakomyi konda mbile ya Samwɛlɛ Bɔtɔndɔli.
english: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

lokele: Nde mbisa iyo lofelaka Bɔkɔta, la Mungu lof’iyo Saulo wana wa Kishi, boto wa bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Benyamini, inde loyala bɔkɔta ko miaka kama inɛi.
english: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

lokele: Limɔ asokolaka Inde Saulo, Inde lofaef’iyo Dawidi ndoyala bɔkɔta wau. Mungu losanoela Dawidi mbo— Isoosha Dawidi wana wa Yese, boto oyasamomuku lami finɛ la oyatolitesa lisangi liami litotina.
english: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

lokele: Kwani Mungu asoeshela Isalaele Bouwesi wa bɔkɔ̈kɔ wa Dawidi, ako Yesu kwa atikak’Inde lisakä.
english: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation 13:23 to Israel according to his promise,

lokele: Oso wa loyo loande, Yoane loyataka boekï ende batotina ba Isalaele ko lilufi lia likalangani.
english: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel. 13:24

lokele: Kongo ko asambosilaka Yoane likuwa liande, inde loongaka mbo— ¿Otangi nde mbo yende ndai to? Imi iti Inde ako Masiya, nde Inde Oyatoya liili liami, imi itiengane ango ndofaikola ikulu sha ikwaka shande.
english: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

lokele: Beoto, bana ba bofindi wa Abalayama, l’ebanu ebatolitesa Mungu, e-wɛndi-bo bosotomomo ko end’iso yaatotina.
english: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

lokele: Eokao iyo ana ebayalaka nda Yelusaleme la betoli oso yau batialembeelaka Inde la batialuwaka litina lia baoi ba batɔndɔli ebasotangokomo Yenga la Yenga, nde bakɔchaka bao ani bafak’Inde se,
english: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

lokele: Batiɛnɛk’Inde la loasɔ loengana la liwa, nde iyo lotinjaka Pilato mbo olek’Inde.
english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

lokele: Asilak’iyo ndokɔcha bitotina eyasɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa loasɔ loande, iyo losokol’Inde nda lieka, iyo loinges’Inde nda losai.
english: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

lokele: Kongo ko Mungu nd’akusolak’Inde nda liwa;
english: But God raised him from the dead,

lokele: limɔ mbisa ko la bacho wike Inde lɔɛnɛkɛlɛ ende ebasokwaka lande nda Ngalilai amamwito lande ani bayaka ono nda Yelusaleme, la iyo ana bende kwani ebatokambekesa bato njasɔ yande.
english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

lokele: La iso nd’atoeshel’ino Mboli Ilau eyatikelomoko lisakä ende batata basu,
english: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

lokele: la Mungu asofaef’iso bana bau ko yao, ko ani asokolaka Mungu osokola Yesu nda liwa, kwa atomoko nda Bɔɛlɛ wa imbale mbo— Aɛ wende wana wami, Imi nd’asoot’Aɛ louse-lo.
english: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’ Psalms 2:7

lokele: La nda loasɔ loa likusolomu eliakusolaka Mungu okusola Yesu nda liwa, angofɔndɔkɔ imɔ, Mungu loonga mbo— Itofaef’Aɛ basakä batanu ebolendelomo, ebatikelomoko ende Dawidi.
english: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’ Isaiah 55:3

lokele: La nda Bɔɛlɛ wasi imɔ aongaka mbo— Oitomacha ewaɛ wa botanu mbo ɛnɛkɛ liɔli lia liwa.
english: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’ Psalms 16:10

lokele: Nde Dawidi angɛnɛ akelaka lisangi lia Mungu nda fɛtɔ yande, limɔ inde lokwa ilɔ sha liwa, inde loombomo amamwito la bangau bande, la inde nd’ɛnɛkɛ liɔli lia liwa.
english: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

lokele: Nde Inde ona oyakusolaka Mungu, atiɛnɛkɛ liɔli lia liwa.
english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

lokele: Eokao, beoto, loluwomoko lanu la wewe mbo, ko la e-Yesu-yo, ino nd’asokambesomo mboli ya limɛsɛli lia batwanelo, ko lande imɔ, boto la boto oyatolendelo Inde,
english: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, 13:38 that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;

lokele: asoendolomo nda yao bitotina ebitikɔkɔlɛ inde ndoendelomo ko la Bikela ya Mɔsɛ.
english: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

lokele: Eokao lambaka la wɛlï to mbo lona eloaongaka Batɔndɔli, lotayaka end’ino, loko mbo—
english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, ino ba liolya, mwaalaka, sɛɛsɛlɛkɛ, eoka Yelakelaka loasɔ nda bacho banu elotiaimelak’ino, Ambo ani loao lokambesomoko ino fololo.
english: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’” Habakkuk 1:5

lokele: Akuswak’iyo nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ, bato lofelak’iyo mbo njasɔ-bi bikambesomoko iyo liasi nda Yenga ya mbisa.
english: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

lokele: Amelanaka lisɔngɔmi, BaYuda wike la bandimela amamwito lau, iyo yaatotina lotutaka Paulo la Balanaba, la Batomomu-ba loongana lau ndofumbes’iyo mbo bakɔkɔmɛkɛ nda booto wa Mungu.
english: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

lokele: Ayaka Yenga ya mbisa, tina la bokenge bototina losɔngɔmɔ ndoka wɛndi wa Mungu,
english: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

lokele: nde ɛnɛkɛ BaYuda bikuke ya bato, iyo lotuma la lisiela, iyo lofenyakana baoi ba Paulo, iyo losɛɔlɔ inde.
english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

lokele: Lamao Paulo la Balanaba loonga lau la lotendela mbo— Loengani nde mbo wɛndi wa Mungu bonangolomoko ko end’ino oso, kongo ko kwa asofekel’ino wao la asotang’ino mbo otionde ndoɔ̈lɔ liwawi lia loiko, tɛnɛ ngo tosokakikwa ende bato ba tukela yasi.
english: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

lokele: Eoka Ngɛnɛ asotel’iso ndola ongoma, mbo— Isosɛlɛ aɛ kwa tala ende bato ba tukela yasi, Mbo oyaleke yɛnɛlɔ ya liuwesi ko nda bako ba wenda.
english: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’” Isaiah 49:6

lokele: Okaka to bato ba tukela yasi ongoma, iyo lokaka limɛngɔ, iyo loinakela wɛndi wa Ngɛnɛ la batotina ebüchomokö ndɔɔ̈lɔ liwawi lia loiko, iyo ana loimela.
english: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

lokele: Ongoma wɛndi wa Ngɛnɛ lomelakana nda yese ena etotina.
english: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

lokele: Nde BaYuda angɛnɛ lɔfɔɔlɔ batomali ba lisomboli ebalitesomu la biange ya okenge, mbo bafumbeseke bato ndokongola Paulo la Balanaba, limɔ iyo losaya iyo nda bolelo wa yese yau.
english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

lokele: Limɔ Paulo la Balanaba lofufoel’iyo liunge elisowatema la batindi bau, iyo lɔkɛ nda Ikonio,
english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

lokele: ani baeki lotuma la limɛngɔ la Bolimo Botanu.
english: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

lokele: Limɔ nda Ikonio ko ongoma, Batomomu lɔkɛ nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ ya BaYuda, iyo lonangola omao la ongoma bato wike loimela, la BaYuda la BaHela imɔ.
english: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

lokele: Kongo ko BaYuda ebafekaka oimela, iyo lofumbesa betema ya bato ba tukela yasi mbo bakeelek’eba beoto bobe.
english: But the disbelieving 14:2 Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

lokele: Ongoma to, iyo lotikala yumwa omao ani batonangola la lotendela loasɔ loa Ngɛnɛ, la Inde angɛnɛ lokɔkɔmɛsɛ wɛndi wa booto wande ko la ndembe ya bisisho eyakelomoko ko la besamba yau la isosha shande.
english: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

lokele: Nde bato ba okenge loatana, bamɔi lowatema la BaYuda, bamɔi la Batomomu.
english: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.

lokele: Limɔ asangaka la BaYuda l’eba tukela yasi amamwito la benyafala yau ndosungamel’iyo la ndokushak’iyo batalɛ,
english: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

lokele: Batomomu loluwa loasɔ, la iyo lokwa otili nda bekenge ya Lusetula la Delebe, nda tukela ya Lukaonia, la nda yese bitimbi,
english: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

lokele: la iyo lokanangokole Mboli Ilau omao. Louweso loa boto wa Lusetula
english: There they preached the Good News.

lokele: Nda okenge wa Lusetula boto oyatiaka la bofoka nda bakolo loyalaka se nda mboka, aaka la ekoti ko nda baotelo bande, angokɔkɔlɔ ndokɛndɛ.
english: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.

lokele: Boto-yo lolaila ani atoonga Paulo, Paulo lotichak’inde la ɛnɛk’inde mbo boto ale la liimeli liouwesomo,
english: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

lokele: inde loonga lande la limiki lifi mbo— Emalaka fii nda batindi; limɔ inde loungwa likolo, inde loakola ndɔkɛndɛkɛndɛ.
english: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛkɛ bikuke ya bato lona eloakelaka Paulo, iyo loamama la limiki lifi nda lioi lia Lukaonia mbo— BaMungu basosulwa se end’iso ko la liluku lia balomboki!
english: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”

lokele: Iyo lota Balanaba lina liko Sheu la Paulo lina liko Heleme eoka ayali nde ikomya sha lioi.
english: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.

lokele: Aaka esemoelo ya Sheu tina la okenge, kanga yande loesha mbolo la bangɛlɛtɛ ba fɔtɔtɔ konda biome ya okenge, iyo losanga ndosemola batomomu amamwito la bikuke ya bato.
english: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

lokele: Nde okaka Paulo la Balanaba ongoma, iyo losalaka bisinda yau, iyo loungwela ekuke ya bato, iyo loamama mbo— ¿Bato, monito otokela ani?
english: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

lokele: Iso imɔ twende ko balomboki ko la liluku eliyali lanu la tosoeshel’ino Mboli Ilau mbo bosokweke nda yeka-bi ya likeela ko ende Mungu wa loiko, oyakelaka la use la wenda-bo wa se la balia la bitotina imɔ ebile nda yao.
english: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

lokele: Nda fɛtɔ ya kwala, amachaka bato ba tukela bitotina mbo bakɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ olo alɛmbɛkɛ’iyo;
english: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.

lokele: kongo ko atialenjaka ndosɛlɛ iso boluwesi mbo atokelaka iso ko bolau, wofaef’iso mbula yosokwa nda use la biaa ya biula ya bilanga yokanesela ino la bieka la limɛngɔ imɔ.
english: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you 14:17 rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”

lokele: Nde ko la baoi-ba iyo lɔɛnɛ ko tale ndokufesa bikuke mbo batasemol’iyo la iyongo shau.
english: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

lokele: Lamao BaYuda angɛnɛ losokwa nda Ikonio oyafumbesa bikuke ya bato la iyo lokushaka Paulo batalɛ, limɔ iyo losulia inde nda liko lia okenge ani iyo lotanga nde mbo asowa.
english: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

lokele: Nde mbisa baeki lolingelaka Paulo la inde loemala okainwa nda okenge; lɛlɛngɔ inde lɔkɛ amamwito la Balanaba konda Delebe.
english: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

lokele: Asilaka iyo ndonangoela bato nda okenge ona la ndosɛlɛ baeki wike, iyo loinwa liasi nda Lusetula la Ikonio la Antiokia;
english: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

lokele: ani batokɔkɔmɛsɛ betema ya baeki, iyo lofumbesa mbo baundeke liimeli ngwi, iyo loekes’iyo mbo lole loasu mbo tɔɔtɛkɛ nda Bɔkɔta wa Mungu ko la bifembi wike.
english: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.

lokele: La nda bitanda bitotina, iyo loaa bamɔi ndoyala benyafala yau, limɔ ko la likufi lia bieka la lisombokoli, iyo lotamb’iyo ende Ngɛnɛ oyasolendelo iyo olendelo Inde. Liinwi ende Etanda nda Antiokia
english: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.

lokele: Limɔ iyo loetaka tukela ya Pisidia, iyo loiya nda Pamfulia,
english: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.

lokele: iyo lonangola wɛndi nda okenge wa Pelenga, limɔ iyo lɔkɛ konda Atalia.
english: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

lokele: Lamao iyo lɔkɛ ko la watɔ wa lofofo konda Antiokia, olo üchomokö iyo oso la booto wa Mungu okakelaka likuwa lisɔɔlɔlɔ iyo ko kwani.
english: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

lokele: Iyak’iyo omao, iyo lɔsɔngɔmɛsɛ etanda la iyo lokambesa etanda yao ina ebikeliki Mungu amamwito lau nda kɛndɔ la ani aliolak’Inde bome boko fofe yoimela ende bato ba tukela yasi.
english: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

lokele: Iyo loumwa to omao sumbu amawito la baeki.
english: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

lokele: Lamao beoto bamɔi ba Yudea loakola ndoekesa bato ba etanda mbo— Sakolo ko botenomo totombe kwa boyaeli wa Mɔsɛ ani ino angokɔkɔlɔ ouwesomo.
english: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, 15:1 “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”

lokele: Eokao Paulo la Balanaba lowesana lau, iyo lofenyakana lau finɛ nda loasɔ-lo, limɔ beoto lotoma Paulo la Balanaba la bamɔi basi bau, mbo baɛkɛ ende Batomomu la biange nda Yelusaleme ndokafelana eloasɔ-lo.
english: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

lokele: Eba Etanda lokatik’iyo nda mboka, limɔ iyo lotandela yese ya Foinike la Samalia, iyo lokambesa eba etanda omao mbo bato ba tukela ya wenda basokikwa ende Mungu, la ongoma iyo lofa beoto limɛngɔ finɛ.
english: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

lokele: Iyak’iyo nda Yelusaleme banyangelomoko la etanda la Batomomu la biange, iyo lokambesa bato bitotina ebiakelaka Mungu amamwito lau nda kɛndɔ.
english: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.

lokele: Kongo ko bamɔi ebawatemaka la botükä wa Bafalusi oso, nde kwani baimeli nde, iyo loemesana ndoonga mbo— Loengani mbo batenomoko totombe la mbo bakambesomoko ndolitesa Bikela ya Mɔsɛ.
english: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”

lokele: Limɔ Batomomu la biange lɔɔtɔ ikumbɛ sha eloasɔ-lo
english: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

lokele: limɔ ani basofelakana yumwa, Petelo loemala, inde loonga lau mbo— Beoto ya Etanda, ino nd’aluwi mbo ko oso oso Mungu loaa imi wanu, mbo bato ba tukela yasi, bokeke wɛndi wa Mboli Ilau ko la bɔnɔkɔ wami la mbo bimeleke.
english: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.

lokele: La Mungu oyaluwi nde betema ya bato asofaef’iso ndembe yolembeelesa likulyi, eko mbo asof’imɔ ko iyo Bolimo Botanu kwa asofomo iso,
english: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

lokele: atiatwanes’iso lau, nde asotanesa betema yau imɔ ko la liimeli.
english: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

lokele: ¿Eokao monito otosomesa Mungu ani atokot’ino ndotaka bekuku ya bolito nda kingo ya baeki, bolito ebotikɔkɔlɛ la batata basu la iso imɔ ndotola wao?
english: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

lokele: Kongo ko, ko la booto wa Ngɛnɛ Yesu, tosoimela mbo totouwesomo, la iso lau imɔ lisanga.
english: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, 15:11 just as they are.”

lokele: Ongoma batotina ba lisɔngɔmi loyala ko tau, la iyo lolaila Balanaba la Paulo ani basanoelak’iyo loasɔ loa ndembe ya bisisho ebiakelaka Mungu ende bato ba tukela ya wenda ko lau. Inango sha Yakobo ako Bokomyi wa Ikumbɛ
english: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

lokele: Asilak’iyo ndoonga, limɔ Yakobo lomutola mbo— Beoto, okaka to lioi liami;
english: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

lokele: Simona asokambes’iso ani ayaeli Mungu oso la booto ende bato ba tukela yasi ndoyɔsɛl’iyo botuka botangokomo la lina liande.
english: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

lokele: La baoi-ba basangani nde la bao ebaongaka Batɔndɔli kwala mbo—
english: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

lokele: Mbisa yeinwaka nde liasi, Yeemesaka eyaelo ya Dawidi eyaukwaka; Itowambaka likwɛngwɛ lia yao, ndoswa liao liasi,
english: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up

lokele: Mbo bato ebakasandeloko se balukeke Mungu Ambo bato ba bienda batotina ebatotangomo la lina liami.
english: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’ Amos 9:11-12

lokele: Ngɛnɛ aongaka ongoma, ako Inde oyaluwesaka bato njasɔ-bi ko kwaala.
english: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.

lokele: Eokao, imi nd’atoata loasɔ ko ani, mbo lotiengane lasu ndoeyaeyesa eba tukela yasi ebatokikwaka ende Mungu;
english: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

lokele: kongo ko totomelek’iyo lokasa mbo bakileke yeka ebisoseyama la toongo twa mungu-ya-bɛfɔnɔ, la bafekeke nyongo la bakileke ndola nyama eyolomoko la lokuwamelo loa kingo, la bakila.
english: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

lokele: Eoka konda kwalakwala bikela ya Mɔsɛ lonangolomoko nda bokenge la bokenge olo atangomoko lokasa loande Yenga la Yenga nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ.
english: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”

lokele: Limɔ Batomomu la Biange la bato batotina ba Etanda lokuliana ndoaa bamɔi bau la ndotom’iyo nda Antiokia amamwito la Paulo la Balanaba. Iyo lotoma Yuda oyatangomu Balasaba la Sila bako betoli oso ya beoto ya Etanda,
english: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers. 15:22

lokele: iyo lotom’iyo la lokasa-lo nda besamba yau— Iso Batomomu la Biange ya beoto, tosotoma losamɔ ende beoto ya tukela yasi nda Antiokia, la nda Sulia, la nda Kilikia.
english: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

lokele: Eoka tosooka mbo bato bamɔi basu basookes’ino toloi ko la baoi bau ebasoeyaeyesa betema yanu, (ani iso totit’iyo ndola)
english: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;

lokele: tosokuliana nda ikumbɛ ndoaa bato bamɔi la ndotom’iyo end’ino amamwito l’ebasamomu lasu bako Balanaba la Paulo,
english: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

lokele: bato ebasokulya elikanela ya bawawi bau loasɔ loa Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya.
english: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Eokao tosotoma Yuda la Sila mbo basanoelek’ino loasɔ-lo la bɔnɔkɔ ko iyo angɛnɛ.
english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

lokele: Ko la Bolimo Botanu lasu tosokuliana mbo toitotelak’ino bolito wa baiti basi, sakolo ngo ko eba, bako mbo—
english: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

lokele: bokileke bieka ebisüchomoko ende mungu-ya-bɛfɔnɔ, la bakila, la nyama eyolomo la lokuwamelo loa kingo la nyongo. Bokilaka njasɔ-bi, ino kokelaka ko olau. Kɔkɔmɔmɔ la wɛli!
english: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

lokele: Atomomoko iyo, ongoma iyo lɔkɛ nda Antiokia, iyo losɔngɔmɛsɛ eba Etanda, iyo lofaef’iyo lokasa.
english: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

lokele: Atangak’iyo loao, iyo lookaka limɛngɔ lifi nda tokakanelo twa loao.
english: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

lokele: Limɔ Yuda la Sila ebaaka imɔ batɔndɔli, iyo lofumbes’iyo ko la linangoli lifi, iyo lowangemesa betema yau.
english: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

lokele: Atikalak’iyo sumbu yumwa omao, eba beoto loinol’iyo la lilatemi ende ebatomak’iyo.
english: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

lokele: Kongo ko Paulo la Balanaba lotikala nda Antiokia ndokaekese la ndokanangokole Mboli Ilau ya wɛndi wa Ngɛnɛ Mungu, amamwito la bato basi wike. Lɔkɛndɔ loa imbale
english: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

lokele: Mbisa ya bacho bamɔi Paulo loonga la Balanaba mbo— Toinweke liasi oketaeta fɛtɛti ende eba beoto nda kenge bitotina olo anangolak’iso wɛndi wa Ngɛnɛ mbo twɛnɛkɛ ani ayali iyo.
english: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”

lokele: Balanaba losanga ndokɛsɛnɛ la Yoane oyatangomu Malako amamwito lau,
english: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

lokele: nde Paulo loenyela mbo etiengane ndowatema la oto oyasenyanaka lau nda Pamfulia, oyatiakɛndɛkɛ lau nda likuwa.
english: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.

lokele: Iyo lowesana to, la ongoma iyo losenyana; Balanaba lɔkɛsɛnɛ la Malako, iyo lɔkɛ la watɔ wa lofofo nda bosanga wa Kupolio,
english: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,

lokele: nde Paulo loaa Sila ndɔkɛ lande; limɔ üchomoko iyo nda booto wa Ngɛnɛ ko la beoto ya Etanda,
english: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

lokele: iyo loetaka nda Sulia la Kilikia iyo lowangemesa betema ya eba bitanda.
english: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

lokele: Limɔ Paulo loiyela Delebe la Lusetula imɔ, la omao yaaka la boeki ɔmɔi ako Timoteo, wana wa otomali wa BaYuda wa liimeli, nde sango wande aaka WaHela;
english: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.

lokele: Timoteo lotangomo boto wa lokuku lolau ko l’eba beoto nda Lusetula la Ikonio.
english: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.

lokele: Paulo losanga mbo boto-yo akɛkɛ lande nda lɔkɛndɔ, limɔ inde lɔɔsɔ Timoteo, inde loten’inde itombe loasɔ loa BaYuda ebayalaka nda yese ena, eoka iyo yaatotina loluwa mbo sango wande aaka WaHela.
english: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

lokele: Etak’iyo nda bokenge la bokenge, iyo lofaekefa beoto lokasa loa baiti ebataka Batomomu la Biange nda Yelusaleme, mbo baliteseke bao.
english: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

lokele: Ongoma bitanda lokɔkɔmɔkɔ nda liimeli, la loketi loa yao loulwa lise la lise.
english: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

lokele: Lamao iyo loetaka yese ya Felungia la Galatia, ani batakufesomu la Bolimo Botanu okanangola wɛndi nda yese ya Asia.
english: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

lokele: Iyak’iyo nda liko lia yese ya Misia, bakotaka ndɔkɛ nda Bitunia, kongo ko Bolimo wa Yesu atialɛmbɛk’iyo ongoma,
english: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.

lokele: eokao iyo loetela Misia, iyo lɔkɛ nda Tuloa. Lɔkɛndɔ loa Paulo nda biese ya Poto
english: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

lokele: Limɔ la ocho liɛni lɔɛnɛlɛ ende Paulo, boto wa Makedonia loemala ani atolɔmbɔkɔlɔ Paulo mbo— Lekaka nda Makedonia oyasung’iso!
english: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”

lokele: Enɛkɛ Paulo liɛni, lisasaya iso loluka fofe yɔkɛ nda Makedonia eoka totangiki nde mbo Mungu asotak’iso lioi mbo tokɛokanangokole Mboli Ilau ende bato omao.
english: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

lokele: Ongoma iso loilia owale la watɔ wa lofo, iso lɔkɛsɔmɔ fii la fofo konda bosanga wa Samotulake, la lɛlɛngɔ iso loiya nda Neapoli,
english: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

lokele: osokwa omao konda Filipoi, bokenge woeta wa yese ya Makedonia la olo ayalaka koloni ya BaLoma. Iso loumwaka omao mbile bimɔi.
english: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

lokele: Nda lise lia Yenga, iso lokuswa lousa loa bome wa likula lia okenge tina la liyande olo aenyelak’iso mbo ende esomboelo; iso loyala se omao amamwito la batomali ebasɔngɔmɔkɔ ina.
english: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.

lokele: Otomali ɔmɔi ako Ludia boungesi wa langi ya bisinda ya bokenge wa Tuatila, inde looka wɛndi, la ayalaka botomali wosemokola Mungu; Ngɛnɛ lolioel’inde botema mbo alaileke baoi ebaongaka Paulo.
english: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

lokele: Alufiomoko inde la bofindi wande, inde lofelak’iso mbo— Eyambo botanga mbo imi yende wimeli wa Ngɛnɛ, yauku oyayalaka nda ndakɔ yami, ongoma inde lotinj’iso ndokulya.
english: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.

lokele: Lise limɔi aɛk’iso nda esomboelo, iso lotowana la boseka ɔmɔi wa likuwa oyaɔtɛlɔmɔ la bolimo wa litɔli la oyaɔlɛsɛkɛ bangɛnɛ bande bondanda finɛ ko la baoi ba litɔli,
english: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

lokele: inde lotutak’iso la Paulo, ani atoamama mbo— E-bato-ba bende bɛkɔwa ya Mungu Oyalongeli, ebatonangoel’ino mboka ya liuwesi.
english: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”

lokele: Inde lokelaka ongoma ko bacho wike, nde Paulo lotɛkwa, inde lokikwa okaonga la bolimo mbo— Isotel’aɛ ndola ko la lina lia Yesu Masiya mbo okusweke ende boseka, limɔ wao lokuswa end’inde ko la mbile-ao.
english: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.

lokele: Nde ɛnɛkɛ bangɛnɛ bande mbo bati imɔ la fofe yɔɔ̈lɔ bondanda loasɔ loande, iyo loundesa Paulo la Sila, iyo losulia iyo nda eolo ya liongo ende benyafala ya okenge.
english: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

lokele: Iyo lɔkɛs’iyo ende Bekumi, iyo loonga mbo— E-bato-ba ebatoswanel’iso bosho ono nda bokenge wasu, bende BaYuda,
english: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city

lokele: la batonangokola biyaelo ebitiengane lasu ndokulia kwa ndokela eoka tole BaLoma.
english: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”

lokele: Limɔ eba ekuke losungamel’iyo la Bekumi losalaka bisinda yau, yao losokolomo limɔ iyo loonga mbo banyɔlɔmɔkɔ la tososola.
english: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.

lokele: Asilak’iyo okuchak’iyo la banyɔlɔ wike, iyo lokush’iyo nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, iyo lotela botingani wa bɔnyɔlɔlɔ ndola mbo atinganeke lau ko ngwi.
english: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.

lokele: Limɔ ko l’eoka asotomo ndola ongoma, inde loundes’iyo, inde lokush’iyo nda tindo y’atiteni, inde lokandaka bakolo bau nda bombele ngwi. Paulo la Sila lokusolomo nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ nda Filipoi
english: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.

lokele: Nda ɛsɔkɔ ya ocho, Paulo la Sila losombola Mungu, iyo lochwaka bɛɛlɛ ani basi ebakandomu omao lolaila iyo.
english: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

lokele: Limɔ futuku lotukeso loa nyɛlɛ lolɛlɛsɛ batalɛ ebaswomoko la ndakɔ ya bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, la biome bitotina loliokolomoko futuku la bakala ba ebakandomu lofaikwa.
english: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.

lokele: Asiswaka botingani nda ilɔ, inde lɔɛnɛ oko biome bisoliwaliwa, inde lɔɔmɔlɔ chaka la asiaka owa la yao eoka atangi nde mbo ebakandomu basolɔmwa.
english: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

lokele: Kongo ko Paulo loama la limiki lifi mbo— Obebesëke lokomba loaɛ angɛnɛ, eoka iso yaatotina tole ko eyamaya.
english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”

lokele: Limɔ botingani lotaka faka lioi, inde lɔɔtɔ ko mangu ani anyangaka la bɔwa, inde lokwa se oso wa Paulo la Sila,
english: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

lokele: limɔ inde lümes’iyo lousa, inde mbo— Bwana, ¿Lole loami ndokela to iye mbo yuwesomoko?
english: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

lokele: Iyo loonga to mbo— Imelaka Ngɛnɛ Yesu, limɔ otouwesomo, l’aɛ la bofindi waɛ.
english: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

lokele: Lamao, iyo lokambes’inde la batotina ba bofindi wande, wɛndi wa Mungu.
english: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

lokele: Inde lound’iyo ko la saa ena ya bocho, inde losoolaka bakambili bau, la inde la bato bande batotina lolufiomo lisasaya.
english: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

lokele: Limɔ inde loesh’iyo nda ndakɔ yande, inde lotaka bieka nda mɛsa oso wau, iyo loomalaka finɛ amamwito la ebande batotina eoka basoimela Mungu.
english: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.

lokele: La bonyanya, Bekumi lotoma polisi la wɛndi mbo— Faikolaka bato ana!
english: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”

lokele: Limɔ botingani lokambesa Paulo mbo— Bekumi basotoma polisi mbo bofaikolomoko. Kuswaka to kwani la kɛndɛkɛ eyanu la lilatemi!
english: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”

lokele: Nde Paulo loonga lau mbo— Bakuchik’iso fololo nda baiso ba bato ani totikomyomo loasɔ, iso bato ba Loma, la basokush’iso nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ. ¿Kwani to batokush’iso lousa ko wisakumbo? Mbayɔ, kangä iyo angɛnɛ bayeke oyakusol’iso la wɛlï.
english: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”

lokele: Limɔ polisi lokambesa Bekumi e-baoi-ba, la okak’iyo mbo— Bende BaLoma, iyo lokwelo bɔwa.
english: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

lokele: Lamao iyo loya oyaɔngɔlɔ’iyo, iyo lokusol’iyo la wɛli ani bafelak’iyo mbo basokweke nda okenge.
english: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

lokele: Akuswak’iyo nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ, iyo lokɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya Ludia, limɔ ɛnɛk’iyo wɛnɛ beoto, iyo lɔɔnjɔnj’iyo, limɔ iyo lotangwa.
english: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.

lokele: Akɛndɛk’iyo la mboka ya Amfipoli la Apolonia, iyo loiyela bokenge wa Tesalonika, olo ayalaka ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ ya BaYuda.
english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

lokele: Paulo, kwa aaka boyaeli wande, inde lɔɔtɔ omao ko yenga bisatɔ, inde lofelakana lau eoka ya Kasa ya Mungu,
english: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

lokele: inde losanoel’iyo la baoi boaesa loao se, mbo loengani nde la Masiya mbo okeke tokange la mbo atɛmwɛkɛ liasi nda liwa, la mbo— E-Yesu-yo oyatonangola’mi end’ino, inde nd’ayali Masiya.
english: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”

lokele: Bamɔi bau lokulia baoi bande, iyo lowatema la Paulo la Sila, imɔ ko la BaHela ebasemolaka Mungu wike fafo la batomali wike ba betoli oso.
english: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

lokele: Kongo ko BaYuda lowɛl’iyo lisiela, iyo lɔɔsɔ batolome bamɔi ba baeteti, limɔ iyo losɔngɔmɛs’iyo nda limbilititi, iyo lofɔɔlɔ bimo nda okenge, iyo lokutukana la ndakɔ ya Yasona ndoluka Paulo la Sila mbo basuliek’iyo nda ikumbɛ sha okenge.
english: But the unpersuaded Jews took along 17:5 some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

lokele: Nde atiɛnɛk’iyo, iyo lokasulia Yasona angɛnɛ la beoto bɛmɔi ende Bekumi ya okenge, iyo loulaula baoi ba liwanjeli mbo— Ebasoyombayombesa wenda basoya imɔ onomono,
english: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers 17:6 before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

lokele: la Yasona asof’iyo ndakɔ yande; iyo yaatotina batotefokola baiti ba Kaisala eoka basoonga mbo wasi nd’ayali Bɔkɔta ako Yesu.
english: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

lokele: Okaka Bekumi la ekuke ya bato e-lioi-li, iyo looka betema wale,
english: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

lokele: limɔ ɔsɔkɔ iyo tuka ende Yasona la ebamɔi, iyo lomach’iyo mbo bakɛkɛ. Beloya
english: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

lokele: Limɔ beoto lotoma Paulo la Sila ko la ocho mbo baɛkɛ nda Beloya. Iyak’iyo omao, iyo lokaɔtɔ nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ ya BaYuda.
