english: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

lokele: BaYuda-ba balongaka eba Tesalonika la booto, banyangelaka wɛndi la yɛmɛ finɛ la iyo lotichaka Kasa ya Mungu ndɔɛnɛ kwa mbo bitotina-bi bende ngo ko ani.
english: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

lokele: Ongoma wike wau loimela to, la batomali bamɔi eba lokuku lolau ba BaHela la batolome imɔ sumbu wike.
english: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

lokele: Nde aluwaka BaYuda ba Tesalonika mbo wɛndi wa Mungu bosonangolomo imɔ ko nda Beloya, iyo loya imɔ, iyo lofɔɔlɔ bikuke ya bato mbo baswaneke bosho.
english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

lokele: Limɔ beoto lotoma Paulo lisasaya konda balia ba bokwa l’ani Sila la Timoteo lotikala ko omao.
english: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

lokele: Nde ebaɛkɛ okatika Paulo nda mboka, iyo lɔkɛ lande konda Atenai limɔ afomoko iyo ndola ende Sila la Timoteo mbo bayek’ende inde la mangu finɛ, iyo loinwa. Atenai
english: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

lokele: Aumbakelaka Paulo oumbakel’iyo nda Atenai, inde looka botema wale finɛ ani ɛnɛk’inde mbo bokenge bosotuma la mungu-ya-bɛfɔnɔ.
english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

lokele: Eokao inde lofelakana nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ la BaYuda la bato ebasemolaka Mungu la lise la lise nda eolo ya liöngo imɔ amamwito la bato ebakatowaneke lande omao.
english: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

lokele: Bamɔi ba sukulu ya Epikulio la eba wɛlï bako BaStoa lotowana lande, iyo lofelana mbo— ¿E-boto-bo wa botendelë asosanga ndoonga to iye? Basi mbo— Eluwa ende bonangoli wa balimo ba yese yasi, ko eoka mbo Paulo loluwes’iyo Mboli Ilau ya Yesu la litɛmwi nda liwa.
english: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also 17:18 were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

lokele: Limɔ iyo lounda Paulo okakɛ lande nda eolo eko Aleopago, iyo mbo— ¿Toluweke sumbu litina lia liekesi liyai elitoongak’aɛ?
english: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?

lokele: Eoka osoeshel’iso mboli ebikaluw’iso; eokao tole la yɛmɛ yoluwa litina lia yao.
english: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”

lokele: Eba Atenai la bɛɛnda ebatoyalaka nda bokenge wau, batoetekesa mbile yau bitotina ko ndoongana la ndokaka ko njasɔ biyai. Inango sha Paulo nda Atenai
english: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

lokele: Limɔ Paulo loemala atiteni ya eolo ya Aleopago, inde loonga mbo— Ino bato ba Atenai, im’isɔɛnɛ mbo wende bato woimelaka njasɔ bitotina.
english: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

lokele: Eoka etaka’mi la mboka ya bokenge wanu, la atichakaka’mi yao ebitosemokol’ino, imi loosha litumbo limɔi elitomu la baoi-ba mbo— Lile elia Mungu Oyatiluwane. Eokao, Imi nd’atoluwes’ino Inde oyatosemol’ino ani otiluwe Inde.
english: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.

lokele: Mungu oyakelaka wenda la bitotina ebile nda wao, Inde nd’ayali Ngɛnɛ wa use la nyɛlɛ, aitoyalaka nda esemoelo eyekelomu ko la besamba;
english: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.

lokele: aitokelakomo likuwa la besamba ya balomboki ko l’eoka mbo aenu nde yeka, eoka Inde angɛnɛ atofaekefa bato liwawi la luli la bitoti imɔ.
english: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

lokele: Ko la boto ɔmwito akelaka tukela bitotina ya balomboki mbo bayaleke nda wenda bototina, asokaelel’iyo lisho la belelo ya biyaelo yau.
english: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

lokele: Alɛmbi nde mbo balukeke Mungu mbo akatufatufek’iyo, iyo koosh’Inde, kongo ko ati esika lasu boto la boto;
english: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

lokele: Eoka yande to tole la liwawi la totowawawawa la tokoyali balomboki, kwa asoonga imɔ ɔmɔi wanu angɛnɛ nda bɔɛlɛ mbo— Twende imɔ ko eba lioti liande.
english: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

lokele: Eokao kwa ayal’iso lioti lia Mungu, lotiengane lasu ndoenyela mbo Mungu akwelu nde bɔfɔɔnɔ wa mbela, kwa ewa bieto ya falata, ango kwa litalɛ elikwɛtɔmu ko la liluwani la baenyeli ba bato.
english: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

lokele: Kongo ko Mungu atienyel’imɔ mbile ena ya botutuku wasu, nde kwani asotoma wɛndi ende bato batotina nda biese bitoti mbo bakalanganeke,
english: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

lokele: eoka asotinya lisho elikaatek’Inde wenda bototina la liengani ko la Boto oyasüch’Inde, la asosunga bato ndoimela ko la litɛmwi ndotɛmɔlɔ Inde nda liwa.
english: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”

lokele: Okaka iyo lioi lia litɛmwi lia ebasowa, bamɔi bau lolimbokol’inde, nde basi mbo— Totooka lioi liaɛ nda loasɔ-lo ko mbile yasi.
english: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”

lokele: Ongoma Paulo losokwel’iyo nda ikumbɛ;
english: Thus Paul went out from among them.

lokele: kongo ko batolome bamɔi bau lowatema lande, iyo loimela; Dionusio boto w’ikumbɛ sha Aleopago aaka wau, la botomali ako Damali, bamɔi basi imɔ.
english: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

lokele: Mbisa yamao Paulo losokwa nda Atenai, inde lɔkɛ nda Kolinto,
english: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.

lokele: la omao inde lotowana la ɔmɔi wa BaYuda, lina liande liko Akwila wa yese ya Ponto. Inde la wali wande ako Pulisekila basokwi ko kwani nda Italia, eoka Kaisala Kulaudia lota ndola mbo BaYuda batotina basokweke nda Loma.
english: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

lokele: Paulo lɔkɛ fɛtɛti end’iyo, limɔ eoka bayalaka nde bato ba likuwa ko limwito, inde loyalaka amamwito lau la iyo losangana nda likuwa, eoka baaka basoli ba hema.
english: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

lokele: Nde Yenga la Yenga Paulo loonganaka lau nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ la mbo BaYuda la BaHela imɔ loimela.
english: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

lokele: Asokwaka Sila la Timoteo nda Makedonia la iyak’iyo ende Paulo, inde lokɔkɔmɔ ko nda linangoli lia wɛndi, inde lolongamesela BaYuda mbo Masiya ale ko Yesu.
english: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

lokele: Kongo ko afekaka iyo la limɔli, inde lofufoel’iyo esinda yande, inde loonga lau mbo— Bakila banu basowɛlɛmɛ ngo ko end’ino angɛnɛ, imi iti’mo la loasɔ loanu, kwani itɔkɛ ko ende bato ba tukela yasi.
english: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”

lokele: Eokao Paulo losokwa omao, inde lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya boto ako Tito Yuseto oyasemolaka Mungu. Ndakɔ yande lowatemana la ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ.
english: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

lokele: La Kilisipo, bokumi wa ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ loimela Ngɛnɛ amamwito la bofindi wande, la bato wike ba Kolinto lokaka, iyo loimela, iyo lolufiomo.
english: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

lokele: Limɔ la ocho ɔmɔi, Ngɛnɛ loonga la Paulo ko nda liɛni, mbo— Owangëke, ongaka to ndoonga, oyalëke tau,
english: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;

lokele: eoka Imi nd’ayali amamwito laɛ, angwɛnɛ oto oyatolukak’aɛ bɔfi nde kokeel’aɛ loasɔ lobe, eoka Imi yende la bato wike nda okenge-bo.
english: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”

lokele: Ongoma Paulo lotikalaka ko omao ko tengai liu la bonanɛi, ani aekesak’iyo wɛndi wa Mungu.
english: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

lokele: Nde ayalaka Galio Bokomonyi woeta wa yese ya Akaiya, BaYuda losangana la botema ɔmwito ndoundesa Paulo, la iyo loesh’inde oso wa yatelo ya njasɔ.
english: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

lokele: Iyo loonga mbo— E-boto-yo asofɔɔlɔ bato mbo basemoleke Mungu la lisemoli elitikuliomo la baiti.
english: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”

lokele: Nde aliolaka Paulo bɔnɔkɔ wande, Galio loonga la BaYuda mbo— Yambo lole litwanelo ango ko loasɔ loetela lobe, ani yɛni nde litina liokaka loasɔ loanu, BaYuda;
english: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

lokele: nde eya lole loasɔ loa baoi la baina la bikela eyanu angɛnɛ, ino angɛnɛ komiaka loao; imi angɛnɛ itikulie ndoyala wati wa loao.
english: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”

lokele: Limɔ inde losayak’iyo nda yatelo ya njasɔ.
english: So he drove them from the judgment seat.

lokele: Limɔ iyo yaatotina lokuwamela Sostene botoli oso wa ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ, iyo loomak’inde omao oso wa yatelo. Kongo ko Galio atiakɛsɛlɛkɛ loasɔ iyɛli ango sinyo. Paulo loinwa nda Yelusaleme la Antiokia
english: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

lokele: Ongoma Paulo lotikala omao bacho sumbu wike, limɔ inde losɛnyana la beoto, inde lɔkɛ nda Sulia la watɔ wa lofofo amamwito la Pulisikila la Akwila; inde lotena swee nda Kɛnɛkɛlɛa eoka asotinya ɛkanɔ ongoma.
english: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, 18:18 and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

lokele: Limɔ iyo loiya nda Efeso, la Paulo lotika ebamɔi ko omao, nde inde angɛnɛ lɔɔtɔkɔ ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ okaongakana la BaYuda omao.
english: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

lokele: Limɔ afelak’iyo mbo Paulo umweke kɔni lau, atiakuliaka,
english: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

lokele: kongo ko asenyanaka inde lau, inde lotikel’iyo lisakä mbo— Mungu esanga ongoma, imi koinwa end’ino liasi.
english: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

lokele: Lamao inde losokwa nda Efeso la watɔ wa lofofo; asaowak’inde nda Kaisalia, inde lɔkɛ okaseela Etanda, limɔ inde loinwa ko nda Antiokia. Lɔkɛndɔ loa isatɔ loa Paulo
english: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

lokele: Umwak’inde omao mbile bimɔi, inde lɔkɛ nda yese etotina ya Galatia la eya Pelungia ko la bokenge la bokenge, inde lɔkɔkɔmɛsɛ baeki batotina.
english: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

lokele: Boto wa BaYuda ako Apolo wa bokenge wa Alesandulia loiyela Efeso nda mbile ena; aaka elälä nda lioi la oyaluwaka Kasa ya Mungu la wɛlï finɛ.
english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

lokele: Boto-yo aekesomoko nda njasɔ ya Ngɛnɛ la eoka botema wande bosokimela, inde lokakambese la ndokekese bato njasɔ ya Yesu la wɛlï, nde aluwaka ko lilufi lia Yoane.
english: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

lokele: Inde loakola to ndoonga nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ la lotendela; okaka Pulisikila la Akwila ongoma, iyo lɔɔsɔ’inde eyau, iyo losanoel’inde liekesi lia njasɔ ya Mungu sanosano.
english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

lokele: Asangak’inde okaleka nda Akaiya, beoto lokulia finɛ, iyo lɔsɔnɔ lokasa ende baeki nda Akaiya mbo banyangelek’inde; iyak’inde omao, inde losungaka finɛ ebimelaka ko la booto wa Mungu,
english: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

lokele: eoka inde lolongaka BaYuda fɛɛ ko fololo nda baiso ba bato, inde loaesa loao se ko la baoi ba Kasa ya Mungu mbo Yesu ende Masiya.
english: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

lokele: Ayalaka Apolo nda Kolinto, Paulo loeta ko la yese ya likolö, limɔ inde loiya nda Efeso, omao inde lotowana la baeki bamɔi,
english: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.

lokele: inde lofel’iyo mbo— ¿Waɔlɔkɔ̈ Bolimo Botanu nda mbile eyimelak’ino? Iyo mbo— Mba, la totiokaka mbo Bolimo Botanu ayali nde.
english: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

lokele: Inde mbo— ¿Lini to lilufi elialufiomoko lanu? Iyo loonga to mbo— La lilufi lia Yoane.
english: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”

lokele: Limɔ Paulo mbo— Yoane lolufia bato la lilufi lia likalangani, la inde lokambesa bato ndoimel’Inde oyakayeke mbisa yande ako Yesu.
english: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.” 19:4

lokele: Okakä iyo ongoma, iyo lolufiomo nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ Yesu,
english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

lokele: limɔ ataliakä Paulo otaliel’iyo bangasa, Bolimo Botanu loya end’iyo la iyo loakola ndoonga baoi ba kanda yasi la ndotɔndɔlɔ,
english: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

lokele: baaka bato ango liu la ambale.
english: They were about twelve men in all.

lokele: Limɔ Paulo lɔɔtɔ nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ la ko la tengai isatɔ inde lonangokola la lotendela ndofelakana la ndofumbesa bato loasɔ loa Bɔkɔta wa Mungu.
english: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.

lokele: Kongo ko akweloko bamɔi lotale la litefoli, la atɔngɔk’iyo botuteli-bo nda batoi ba bokamu wa bato omao, inde losokwa end’iyo, inde lɔkɛ amamwito la baeki, limɔ lise la lise inde lokasanokoela njasɔ-bi nda sukulu ya boekesi ako Tulano.
english: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

lokele: Inde lokelaka ani ko miaka imbale, ongoma batotina ebayalaka nda tukela ya Asia looka wɛndi wa Ngɛnɛ, la BaYuda la BaHela lisanga.
english: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

lokele: Mungu lokelaka bisisho yoetela ko la besamba ya Paulo,
english: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,

lokele: eoka ya totambala la befali ya likuwa lia Paulo eyɔsɔmɔkɔ okakɛsɔmɔ ende eba kambo, la ngwo losokwa la belimo ibe lokuswak’end’iyo.
english: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.

lokele: Kongo ko BaYuda bamɔi betetaka nda likusoli lia belimo ibe, iyo loakola ndosingwaka lina lia Ngɛnɛ Yesu ende bato ebaɔtɛlɔmɔkɔ la belimo ibe, iyo mbo— Isotel’ino ekanɔ ko la lina lia Yesu oyatotomo boekï ko la Paulo!
english: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”

lokele: Ebakelaka ongoma baaka batolome bosambale, bana ba Kanga eyeti wa BaYuda ako Sekewa.
english: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

lokele: Nde Bolimo obe loonga lau mbo— Iluwi nde Yesu, la isolembeela Paulo; ¿ino wende to bandai?
english: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”

lokele: Limɔ e-boto-yo oyayali la bolimo obe, inde loungwel’iyo, inde lolonga ndokakales’iyo yaatotina, iyo lokwa otili okasokwa nda ndakɔ ena ko wase l’ani batumaka la bafwa.
english: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

lokele: Loasɔ-lo loluwana la batotina ebayalaka nda Efeso, la BaYuda la BaHela lisanga, la bɔwa lounda iyo yaatotina, nde lina lia Ngɛnɛ Yesu loinakelomo finɛ.
english: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

lokele: Limɔ bato wike ebimelaka loya oyaaola la ndosanokola tinjela eyakelak’iyo,
english: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.

lokele: la wike imɔ ebaluwaka fɔnɔli, iyo losɔnja kasa yau, iyo lofechaka yao nda bösä oso wa bato batotina. Atangak’iyo loketi loa yao, iyo lɔɛnɛ mbo yenganaka ko pata bilɛfu litinda.
english: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver. 19:19

lokele: Ko ongoma Wɛndi wa Ngɛnɛ lɔsɛngɛ la lokuku la bofoka. Kɛndɔ eyasangaka Paulo
english: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.

lokele: Mbisa ya njasɔ-bi, Paulo losanga nda isosha sha Bolimo ndotandela yese ya Makedonia la Akaiya okakɛ konda Yelusaleme; inde mbo— Mbisa ani isɔkɛ ko omao, lole loami okakɛ ndɔɛnɛ imɔ Loma.
english: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”

lokele: Limɔ atomaka Paulo basungi bande bambale, bako Timoteo la Elaseto nda Makedonia, inde angɛnɛ lotatikala kɔni mbile ɛmɔi nda Asia. Bosho bofi nda Efeso
english: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.

lokele: Yaaka nde bosho ofi la mbile ena, ko l’eoka ya Liimeli-li. Liimeli-li, ango ko Botuteli-bo wa Yesu.
english: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.

lokele: Boto ɔmɔi ako Demetulio, botuli wa bieto ya pata, akwelaka bɔfɔnɔ wa Diana ko la bieto ya pata, la likuwa-li lɔɔlɛsɛ betuli ya wɛli ko bieto wike.
english: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,

lokele: Inde lɔsɔngɔmɛsɛ betuli-bi la basi imɔ ebakelaka bakuwa kwa liao; inde loonga mbo— Batolome, oluwi nde mbo bondanda wasu bosolendelo ko likuwa-li,
english: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.

lokele: la osoɛnɛ la osoka mbo e-boto-yo ako Paulo asolonga ndolimbaka bokamu wa bato wike, inga ono nda Efeso kongo, kangä imɔ nda yese ya Asia etotina ani atoongaka’inde mbo mungu ebikelomu la besamba ya bato biti mungu wewe.
english: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.

lokele: Ongoma likuwa liasu lile nda tale, liko mbo litawa sɔni la mbo esemoelo ya mungu efi ako Diana lotangomo mbo wawa la mbo lokuku loande lofi loweke, loko eloande oyasemolomoko nda yese etotina ya Asia.
english: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”

lokele: Okak’iyo baoi-ba, iyo losomasoma finɛ, iyo loamama mbo— Diana wa Efeso oyalongeli!
english: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

lokele: Ongoma bokenge bototina loyombayomba la iyo yaatotina lokwa mangu amamwito nda eolo ya bisha, iyo losuliaka lau, Ngayo la Alisetalako ba Makedonia bako bakɛndɛni ba Paulo.
english: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.

lokele: Limɔ Paulo losanga ndokɔtɔ limbilititi lia bato, kongo ko baeki bakufesak’inde.
english: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.

lokele: Bekumi bimɔi ya yese ya Asia ebaaka baina la Paulo, iyo lotoma wɛndi end’inde ndolombɔkɔl’inde mbo ataɔtɔ nda eolo ya bisha.
english: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.

lokele: Limɔ bamɔi loama la lioi limɔi, basi la lioi liasi, etunda loeyaeya finɛ ani wike angoluwa ango litina eliasɔngɔmɔkɔ lau.
english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.

lokele: Bamɔi ba ekuke lotanga mbo lole loa Alesandelo, eoka BaYuda lotinjak’inde oso ndoonga, nde afɛfɛk’inde la bosamba mbo bokek’inde eoka alɛmbɛkɛ ndoonga lau,
english: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.

lokele: bato lolembeela mbo ende ngo ko WaYuda, iyo loamama ko la saa imbale la limiki limwito mbo— Diana wa Efeso oyalongeli!
english: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

lokele: Asilaka ikomya la botikasa wa okenge ndoyalesa ekuke ya bato tau, inde mbo— ¿Ino bato ba Efeso, boni oto atiluwe mbo bokenge wa Efeso wende botingani wa mungu ofi ako Diana oyakwakwa se nda use?
english: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?

lokele: Eoka mbo njasɔ-bi biti yoanganyomo, loengani lanu ndoyalaka tau, angokela bofaofao.
english: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.

lokele: Eoka osoesha e-bato-ba l’ono ani batibebese esemoelo ya mungu wasu la batisɛɔle mungu otomali wasu.
english: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.

lokele: Eokao eya to mbo Demetulio la ebasangani lande nda likuwa beyala la oto la loasɔ lɔmɔi, tole la baatelo nda lise lia liongo la twende la Bakomi, bawanjelaneke to ko omao.
english: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

lokele: Kongo ko bolɛmbɛ ndokomia loasɔ loasi, loao koongomo nda etunda eyengani la boyaeli wasu;
english: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

lokele: eoka tole nda tale mbo totawanjelomo loasɔ loa loyombayombo louse-lo, eoka toti ango la litina lioengana la loao.
english: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”

lokele: Aongak’inde ongoma, inde lomelesa etunda ya bato.
english: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

lokele: Aɔngɔkɔ bosho, Paulo lota baeki lioi, limɔ aongak’inde baoi bofumbes’iyo, inde losɛnyana lau, inde lɔkɛ konda Makedonia.
english: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.

lokele: Limɔ etetak’inde nda biese bina, inde lofumbekesa bato la tonango wike, limɔ inde loiya nda yese ya Hela,
english: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.

lokele: inde loyala omao ko tengai isatɔ, nde atwanaka BaYuda kuko youndes’inde ani asiakaɔkɛ la watɔ wa lofofo nda Sulia, limɔ inde losanga ndoinwa liasi la mboka ya Makedonia.
english: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.

lokele: Sopatelo wana wa Pulo, boto wa Beloya la Alisitaluko la Sekundu ba Tesalonika, Ngayo wa Delube, la Timoteo la Tukiko la Tulofimo ba Asia, ito yaatotina lɔkɛsɛnɛ lande,
english: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

lokele: iyo loetel’iso oso ndoumbakel’iso nda Tuloa.
english: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.

lokele: Nde iso lokwa nda watɔ wa lofofo nda Filipoi mbisa ya bacho ba Elambɔ ya lituma, la nda bocho wa bɔɔmwi iso lotowana lau nda Tuloa; iso lotikala omao bacho bosambale.
english: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.

lokele: Nda lise lia Yenga, asɔngɔmɔkɔ iso ndouna lituma, Paulo loongana lau eoka inde losanga ndosokwa la nɔngɔ, ongoma inde loumwesa inango ko nda ɛsɔkɔ ya ocho.
english: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.

lokele: Yaaka nde faka wike yoanesa litenya lia likolo olo asɔngɔmɔkɔ iyo.
english: There were many lights in the upper room where we 20:8 were gathered together.

lokele: Isenge simɔi loyala se omao nda lililisa, lina liande liko Eutuku; eoka ya linangoli lia Paulo liumwaka, inde lokwa ilɔ, limɔ eoka ilɔ lolongak’inde, inde lokwa ko nda ekala ya isatɔ ko nda nyɛlɛ, la inde loilomo oko ani asowa.
english: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

lokele: Nde Paulo lɔkɛ se ko end’inde, inde lɔlɔlɔnɔ lande, inde lotukumel’inde, inde mbo— Ofichëke etondo, liwawi likoyali nde lande!
english: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”

lokele: Limɔ Paulo lolila likolo liasi, inde louna lituma, inde lola, inde loongana lau liasi konda yombe, limɔ inde lɔkɛ.
english: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

lokele: Iyo lɔkɛsɛ wana eyau oko la liwawi, la betema yau lɔɔngɔ hɔngila.
english: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.

lokele: Iso loetel’iyo oso ndɔkɛ ko la watɔ nda Aso, eoka iso losanga ndota Paulo nda watɔ omao, eoka inde lokomia ongoma, mbo inde angɛnɛ loeta la boili.
english: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

lokele: Limɔ atowanak’inde lasu nda Aso, iso lot’inde nda watɔ, iso loiyela Mitulene.
english: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.

lokele: Asokwak’iso omao la watɔ, lɛlɛngɔ iso loiya nda Kio, limɔ yose iso loleka nda Samo, la yose yambale iso loiya nda Mileto.
english: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.

lokele: eoka Paulo losanga ndoeta Efeso fwa eoka atialɛmbɛkɛ ndoumwaka nda yese ya Asia, kangä ndoendesa, mbo ɛkɔkɔlɔ, inde koiya nda Yelusaleme la lise lia Elambɔ ya Pentekosete. Inango sha Paulo ende eba Efeso
english: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

lokele: Nda Mileto Paulo lotoma wɛndi ende biange ya Etanda nda Efeso, mbo bayeke,
english: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

lokele: limɔ ayak’iyo end’inde, inde loonga lau mbo— Ino nd’aluwi mbo konda lise lia oso eliatelaka’mi litindi nda yese-ye ya Asia boyaeli ewayalaka’mi sisi yanu ko mbile bitotina;
english: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,

lokele: yakuwelaka Ngɛnɛ la liikami se, la foo nda baiso, la biale eyayaka ende’mi eoka ya tɔɔlɛ twa BaYuda;
english: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;

lokele: itiakufaka ndokambes’ino loasɔ ango lɔmɔi losungak’ino, la itiamachaka ndoekekes’ino fololo nda baiso ba bato, la nda ndakɔ la ndakɔ yanu,
english: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,

lokele: la ndosanokoela la BaYuda la BaHela likalangani ende Mungu la liimeli lioimela Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu.
english: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus. 20:21

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, kwani isoundomo la Bolimo mbo ikɛkɛ nda Yelusaleme, la itiluwe elokakelomoko ende’mi omao;
english: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

lokele: sakolo ko mbo nda kenge bitotina Bolimo Botanu asoluwesa’mi mbo bɔnyɔlɔlɔ la tokange bikoumbakela’mi.
english: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

lokele: Kongo ko, eya mbo yekɔkɔlɔ ndosilesa lɔkɛndɔ loami la ndɔɔlɔlɔ likuwa eliafaefaka Ngɛnɛ Yesu ofa’mi, liko ndokanangokole Mboli Ilau ya booto wa Mungu, ongoma ani iitotanga liwawi liami mbo liende la loketi mbo ikɛsɛlɛkɛ liao iyɛli.
english: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, kwani imi angɛnɛ nd’aluwi mbo ino ba bekenge eyakɛndɛlɛkɛ’mi ndotaka boekï wa Bɔkɔta wa Mungu, otiɛnɛkɛ imɔ bɔmbɔ wami liasi.
english: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.

lokele: Eokao, isotel’ino tele louse-lo mbo iti ango la loasɔ loa liwawi lia boto ango ɔmɔi wanu,
english: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,

lokele: eoka itiakufaka ndokambes’ino lisangi litotina lia Mungu.
english: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

lokele: Tinganaka la betema yanu angɛnɛ la wɛli, imɔ la batotina ba liyasa elisɛli Bolimo Botanu ɛsɛl’ino betingani mbo ino boleseke Etanda ya Mungu bieka, Etanda eyaɔlɔkɔ Inde ko la bakila ba Ewande angɛnɛ.
english: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and 20:28 God which he purchased with his own blood.

lokele: Imi nd’aluwi mbo mbisa ya losokwo loami, ngɔi ya funo bitɔɔtɔkɔ sisi yanu angökela liyasa ngandi,
english: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

lokele: la bamɔi banu angɛnɛ bemalaka ndoonga tofenya toengolesa baeki mbo batutelek’iyo.
english: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

lokele: Eokao, lambaka; enyelaka mbo ko la miaka isatɔ, itiamachaka ndofumbes’ino oto la oto la ocho la löwa ko la foo nda baiso.
english: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.

lokele: Kwani to isotik’ino ende Ngɛnɛ Mungu la nda lioi lia booto wande, elitokɔkɔlɔ ndokɔkɔmɛs’ino la ndosangoles’ino botiko amamwito la batotina ebasoüchomo ende Mungu.
english: Now, brothers, 20:32 I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

lokele: Itialolaka kwa pata kwa falanga kwa bisinda ya boto ango ɔmɔi;
english: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.

lokele: ino angɛnɛ nd’aluwi mbo bangasa-ba bami bakuwelaka beeno yami la yao ya ebayalaka lami.
english: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

lokele: Nda bitotina yɛnɛsɛk’ino mbo ko la likuwa angɛnɛ lole lasu ndosungaka eba bɛlɛmbu, ndoenyakela baoi ba Ngɛnɛ Yesu ani aongaka Inde mbo— Limɛngɔ liofaka yeka, litolongakela elioɔlɔkɔ.
english: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’

lokele: Aongaka Paulo ongoma, inde loswa balui se, inde losombola amamwito lau batotina.
english: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

lokele: Limɔ iyo yaatotina lolela finɛ, iyo lokusamela Paulo kingo, iyo loumb’inde bɔnɔkɔ la losamɔ,
english: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,

lokele: nde loasɔ eloafak’iyo ikɛnɛnɛ shoeta, loaka lioi eliaongak’inde mbo batiɛnɛk’imɔ bɔmbɔ wande liasi. Limɔ iyo lɔkɛ okatik’inde nda watɔ.
english: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

lokele: Asɛnyanak’iso lau, iso lokwa nda watɔ wa lofofo okaila lɔkɛndɔ ko fii nda Kosa, limɔ lɛlɛngɔ iso loiyela Lode, okasokwa omao okakɛ nda Patala.
english: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

lokele: Limɔ oshak’iso watɔ wɔkɛ nda Foinike, iso lokwa nda wao, iso loilia owale.
english: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

lokele: Lamao ɛnɛk’iso bosanga wa Kupolio, iso lomacha wao nda bosamba wa wali, iso loeta okakɛ nda Sulia, iso loelama nda ngɔngɛ ya Tula, eoka watɔ wasaolomoko biengo ko omao.
english: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.

lokele: Oshak’iso baeki, iso loyala lau becho osambale la baeki ana loonga la Paulo ko la Bolimo mbo atakɛk’imɔ nda Yelusaleme.
english: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

lokele: Nde asilaka bacho basu botikala, iso losokwa omao okaila lɔkɛndɔ, la baeki batotina amamwito la bali la bana bau, iyo loyatik’iso lousa loa bokenge; limɔ iso loswa balul se nda ngɔngɛ, iso losombola.
english: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

lokele: Limɔ iso losenyana lau, iso lokwa nda watɔ nde iyo loinwa olo eyau.
english: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

lokele: Asokwak’iso nda Tula, iso loila lɔkɛndɔ liasi, iso loiyela Petolemai, iso loseela beoto, iso loyala lau ko bocho ɔmɔi.
english: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ iso losokwa omao okakɛ nda Kaisalia. Omao iso lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya Filipo, ewa Bonangoli la ɔmɔi wa Basungi osambale, iso loyalaka lande.
english: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.

lokele: Inde aaka la baseka banɛi ebatɔndɔlɔkɔ.
english: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

lokele: Umwak’iso omao bacho bamɔi, bɔtɔndɔli ɔmɔi ako Agabo wa Yudea loya,
english: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

lokele: inde loyaɔsɔ bɔkɔli wa Paulo, inde lokandaka bakolo la besamba yande angɛnɛ la wao, inde loonga mbo— Bolimo Botanu asoonga ani, mbo— Ko ongoma BaYuda batokandaka botolome oyale ngɛnɛ wa bɔkɔli-bo nda Yelusaleme, la batokɛs’inde ko nda besamba ya bato ba tukela yasi.
english: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”

lokele: Okak’iso la beoto omao, ebaoi-ba, iso lolɔmbɔkɔlɔ Paulo mbo ataɛk’imɔ nda Yelusaleme.
english: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

lokele: Limɔ Paulo lomutola mbo— ¿Litina moni elitoleel’ino liosɛlɛ botema wami l’ibɛɛli ani? Imi nd’aengani nde, inga ko ndokandomo kongo, kangä ndowa imɔ nda Yelusaleme, ko l’eoka ya lina lia Ngɛnɛ Yesu.
english: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”

lokele: Eoka atikulie ndokufesomo, ongoma iso loyala tau, iso mbo— Lisangi lia Ngɛnɛ likelomoko!
english: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”

lokele: Mbisa ya bacho ana, iso lokomia lɔkɛndɔ, limɔ iso lɔkɛ ko nda Yelusaleme.
english: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

lokele: Bamɔi ba baeki ba Kaisalia lɔkɛsɛnɛ lasu, iyo lokatik’iso nda ndakɔ ya Menasona wa Kupolio, ɔmɔi wa baeki ba oso, olo akayaleke iso.
english: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

lokele: Iyak’iso nda Yelusaleme, beoto lonyangel’iso la limɛngɔ. Paulo lotowana la Yakobo la Biange ya Etanda
english: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ Paulo lɔɔtɔ amamwito lasu olo ende Yakobo ani Biange ya Etanda loyala imɔ ko omao.
english: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

lokele: Aseelak’iso beoto, inde lokambes’iyo, tunya la tunya ya bitotina eyakelaka Mungu ende bato ba tukela yasi ko la tomo yande.
english: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

lokele: Okak’iyo mboli-bi, iyo loinela Mungu; iyo loonga lande mbo— Osoɛnɛ to, booto, aina bilɛfu ya BaYuda ebatoimela, la iyo yaatotina batolitesa Bikela la bofiili;
english: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

lokele: la basoluwesomo loasɔ loaɛ mbo otoekekesa BaYuda ebatoyalaka la eba tukela yasi mbo bamacheke Bikela ya Mɔsɛ, la mbo batatena bana bau totombe la batatutaka biyaelo ya kwala.
english: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.

lokele: ¿Totokela to moni? Wewe, batokaka mbo osoya.
english: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.

lokele: Eokao, wakela lona elosoonga iso laɛ. Tole la bato banɛi onomono ebasotinya ekanɔ,
english: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.

lokele: Kɛndɛkɛ lau okasaesa iyo la bosalu amamwito laɛ angɛnɛ, kambelak’iyo bieto mbo bamwomoko swee ya otö, limɔ batotina batoluwa mbo ebisoluwesomo iyo loasɔ loaɛ biti to wewe, kangä mbo aɛ angɛnɛ wengani nde wolitesaka Bikela.
english: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

lokele: Kongo ko nda loasɔ loa bato ba tukela yasi ebasoimela, twatomelak’iyo lokasa la likomyi liasu mbo bakileke yeka ebisüchomoko ende mungu-ya-bɛfɔnɔ, la bakila, la nyama eyolomo la lokuwamelo loa kingo, la nyongo.
english: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”

lokele: Ongoma Paulo lɔkɛ la bato ana la lɛlɛngɔ inde lokasaesaka iyo la bosalu, limɔ inde lɔɔtɔ nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu ndoluwesa mbo bacho ba ekanɔ yau basosila, la lisho elikatambomoko bafaefi ba oto la oto, liko mbisa ya bacho osambale. Bosho nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu nda Yelusaleme
english: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

lokele: Asambosilaka bacho osambale bana, BaYuda ebasokwaka nda yese ya Asia, ɛnɛkɛ̈ iyo Paulo nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu iyo loyombayombesa batotina ba ekuke, iyo lokusamel’inde la besamba yau,
english: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

lokele: iyo loamama mbo— Batolome ba Isalaele, sung’iso! Ale ko boto-yo oyatoekekesa bato nda wenda bototina mbo batefoleke BaYuda la Bikela la Ndakɔ-ye, la asoesha imɔ BaHela ono nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu; ongoma asobebesa elela-ye etanu.
english: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”

lokele: Eoka batangaka mbo Paulo asɔɔtɛsɛ Tulofimo wa Efeso nda ndakɔ ya Mungu, oyɛnɛk’iyo wɛn’inde amamwito la Paulo nda okenge.
english: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

lokele: Ongoma bokenge bototina loyombayomba la bokamu losɔngɔkɔmɔ mangumangu, iyo loundesa Paulo, iyo losuliak’inde lousa loa Ndakɔ ya Mungu; limɔ lisasaya biome bifi ya Ndakɔ loliakomo.
english: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

lokele: Akotaka iyo ndoola Paulo, wɛndi lɔkɛ ende Komanda wa basilikani mbo bokenge bototina wa Yelusaleme bososwana bosho.
english: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

lokele: Lisasaya inde lɔɔsɔ basilikani la betoli oso yau, inde lɔkɛ lau mangu ende eba Paulo. Limɔ ɛnɛk’iyo Komanda la basilikani, iyo lomacha ndokuchaka Paulo.
english: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

lokele: Lamao, ayaka Komanda tina, inde loundesa Paulo, inde lotoma bato bande mbo bakandeke Paulo la bɛnyɔlɔlɔ bimbale, limɔ inde lofela mbo— ¿Ende to ndai? ¿End’iye eyekel’inde?
english: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

lokele: Kongo ko bamɔi ba ekuke loamama lioi limɔi, basi nde lioi liasi, ongoma inde angokɔkɔlɔ ndoluwa loasɔ chaa eoka ya bosho, inde loonga la basilikani mbo bakɛsɛkɛ Paulo nda ndakɔ ya basilikani.
english: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.

lokele: Iyak’inde nda kili, Paulo lotolomo la basilikani eoka ya bolengi wa limbilititi,
english: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

lokele: la eoka mbo bokamu wa bato lotutak’inde ani iyo loamama mbo— Sokola inde, bola!
english: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”

lokele: Asambokɛsɔmɔkɔ Paulo nda ndakɔ ya basilikani, inde loonga la Komanda mbo— ¿Yongeke sumbu laɛ? Komanda mbo— ¿Oluwi nde lioi lia BaHela?
english: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?

lokele: ¿Oti ango ewa Ejipeto oyayombayombesaka bato nda mwaka wa oso la oyakɛndɛkɛ la baoni bilefu binɛi nda liɔmbɛlɛ?
english: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”

lokele: Paulo loonga mbo— Imi yende boto wa BaYuda, wa bokenge boko Talusu nda yese ya Kilikia; yende wa bokenge wa lokuku. Itoomb’aɛ mbo omacheke sumbu imi yongeke la e-bato-ba.
english: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”

lokele: Afomoko Paulo isosha, inde loemala nda kili, inde lɔfɛfɛlɛ bato bosamba, lamao ayalak’iyo ko hai, inde loonga lau nda lioi lia BaYuda—
english: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,

lokele: mbo— Beoto la Batata, okaka kwani sumbu inango shami shotungelesa liwanjeli lianu.
english: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

lokele: Okak’iyo mbo atoonga lau nda lioi lia BaYuda, iyo loyala hai ko bii.
english: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,

lokele: Paulo mbo— Imi yende otolome wa BaYuda, yaotomokö nda Talusu nda yese ya Kilikia, nde yakɔswaka ono nda bokenge-bo, nda bakolo ba Ngamaliele, yaekesomokö Bikela ya batata basu hɛlɛ, yende la bofiili finɛ nda njasɔ ya Mungu kwa ayali imɔ ko ino yaatotina louse.
english: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.

lokele: Yakongolaka eba liimeli-li konda lioli lia bato, yakandaka la yatomaka nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ la batolome la batomali lisanga;
english: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,

lokele: Kanga eyeti la biange bitotina baluwi nde loasɔ-lo loami mbo wewe, eoka yaɔlɔkɔ kasa y’isosha ende beoto bako BaYuda nda Damaseke la yakɛkɛ ko omao okaundesa ebayalaka omao la okaya lau nda bɛnyɔlɔlɔ nda Yelusaleme mbo bakuchomoko.
english: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.

lokele: Nde aɛkɛ’mi lɔkɛndɔ lona, la iyaka’mi tina la Damaseke la ifitika, liangangi lifi lia use loangangela’mi, imi lokwa se kwu nda nyɛlɛ;
english: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.

lokele: imi looka limiki elitoonga lami mbo— ¿Saulo, Saulo, otokongokola’mi monito?
english: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’

lokele: Limɔ imi lomutola mbo— ¿Bwana, wende to ndai? Inde loonga lami mbo— Imi yende Yesu wa Nasaleta oyatokongolomo laɛ.
english: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’

lokele: Nde bato ebayalaka lami bɛnɛkɛ liangangi, kongo ko batiokaka limiki lia oyaongaka lami.
english: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.

lokele: Imi loonga mbo— ¿Ikeleke to moni, Bwana? Ngɛnɛ loonga lami mbo— Emalaka, kɛndɛkɛ nda Damaseke, limɔ aɛ kokambesomo loasɔ loa bitotina ebisokomielomo aɛ yokela.
english: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’

lokele: Ongoma itiakɔkɔlɔkɔ ndwɛnɛ eoka ya liangangi lia tɔngɛlingɛli, eokao ebayalaka lami loundaka’mi bosamba, imi loiya nda Dameseke.
english: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.

lokele: Boto ɔmɔi ako Anania, boto oyasemolaka Mungu kwa asoonga Bikela, boto wa lokuku lolau ende BaYuda batotina ebayali nda okenge ona,
english: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,

lokele: inde loya ende’mi la aemalak’inde tina, inde loonga lami mbo— Booto Saulo, ɔlɔkɔ liɛni liaɛ liasi! Ko la mbile-ao imi loila baiso likolo la imi lɔɛnɛ inde.
english: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.

lokele: Limɔ inde loonga lami mbo— Mungu wa batata basu loaa aɛ mbo oluweke lisangi liande la mbo wɛnɛkɛ Wengani la mbo wokeke lioi lia bɔnɔkɔ wande angɛnɛ;
english: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.

lokele: eoka boyalaka boekï wande ende balomboki batotina nda yao bitotina ebisɔɛnɛ la ebisok’aɛ.
english: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.

lokele: ¿Kwani, okoumbakela to iye? Emalaka, lufiomoko, soolomoko batwanelo baɛ, ani otosingwa lina liande liko Yesu.
english: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’

lokele: Ainwaka’mi nda Yelusaleme la asombolaka’mi nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, imi lokwa ilɔ shoɛnɛ liɛnɛ,
english: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance

lokele: imi lɔɛnɛ Inde ani atoonga lami mbo— Endesa, sokwaka lisasaya nda Yelusaleme, eoka baitokulia inango shaɛ loasɔ loami.
english: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’

lokele: Imi loonga mbo— Ngɛnɛ, simbi to iyo nd’aluwi imi nd’akuchaka ebaimelak’Aɛ la mbo yakandak’iyo bɔnyɔlɔlɔ ko ndoetaka ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ la ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ.
english: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.

lokele: Limɔ asondwesak’iyo bakila ba bonangoli waɛ ako Setefano, imi angɛnɛ nd’aemali omao ndokulia la ndotingana la bisinda ya ebolak’inde.
english: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’

lokele: Nde Yesu loonga lami mbo— Kɛndɛkɛ, itotoma nde aɛ ko esika ende bato ba tukela yasi. Paulo loundomo la Komanda wa Loma
english: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’

lokele: Ko nd’asoonga Paulo lioi-li bato lolaila inango, limɔ iyo loama likama mbo— Sokola bɔfɔnɔ-bo wa oto nda wenda, lotiengane mbo atikaleke la liwawi ono!
english: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”

lokele: Iyo loamama, iyo loumbokola bisinda yau, iyo lokushaka liunge nda use;
english: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,

lokele: limɔ Komanda lota ndola mbo baɔtɛsɛkɛ Paulo nda ndakɔ ya basilikani, inde loonga mbo bakɔtɔlɛk’inde ko la liomi lia sikɔtɛ mbo aluweke litina elisoamamel’iyo wamamela Paulo.
english: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.

lokele: Nde akandomoko inde la bekulu, Paulo loonga la bosilikani oyaemali tina mbo— ¿Engani nde lanu ndoomaka boto sikɔtɛ oyale iote sha Loma l’ani akafomu se la wati?
english: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”

lokele: Okaka bosilikani e-lioi-li, inde lɔkɛ okakambesa Komanda, inde mbo— ¿Osambokela nde moni? E-boto-yo ende iote sha Loma.
english: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”

lokele: Limɔ Komanda loya oyaonga la Paulo mbo— Ongaka lami, wende to iote sha Loma? Paulo mbo— Eingo!
english: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”

lokele: Komanda lomutola mbo— Imi nd’asombaka isosha sha iote ko la loketi lofi. Nde Paulo mbo— Imi nd’aotomoko ko iote.
english: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”

lokele: Kwaamao ebasiakoomak’inde sikɔtɛ, iyo lot’inde se; la Komanda imɔ lokwelo bɔwa ani aluwak’inde mbo Paulo ale iote sha Loma la mbo asokandak’inde.
english: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.

lokele: Nde lɛlɛngɔ eoka Komanda alɛmbɛkɛ ndoluwaka fololo litina lia liwanjeli lia BaYuda owanjela Paulo, inde lofaikol’inde, inde lotela kanga ebieti la ikumbɛ sha BaYuda lioi mbo basɔngɔmɛkɛ, limɔ inde loesha Paulo, inde loemes’inde oso wau.
english: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.

lokele: Limɔ Paulo lotichaka eba Ikumbɛ, inde mbo— Bitungani yami, botema bosolembeelesa’mi angɛnɛ mbo isolitesaka Mungu la wɛli konda louse-lo.
english: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”

lokele: Nde Kanga eyeti ako Anania lotel’ebemali tina lande mbo bomeke Paulo nda bɔnɔkɔ.
english: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

lokele: Lamao Paulo loonga lande mbo— Mungu nd’atom’aɛ, ako etutu eyesiomu fɛmbɛ! ¿Oyali nde se omao ko ndoataka loasɔ loami ko la Bikela ani aɛ angɛnɛ ototwanelo Bikela ko ndoonga mbo yomomoko?
english: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”

lokele: Ebemali tina loonga la Paulo mbo— ¿Otomɔlɔkɔ nde Kanga Eyeti ya Mungu?
english: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

lokele: Paulo loonga mbo— Bitungani, itiluweke mbo ende Kanga Eyeti eoka loatomoko nda Lokasa mbo— Osɛolɔ̈kɔ bokomi wa bato baɛ.
english: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’” Exodus 22:28

lokele: Limɔ aluwaka Paulo mbo bamɔi ba Ikumbɛ bale BaSadoke la bamɔi bale BaFalusi, inde loamama mbo— Bitungani, imi yende WaFalusi, la wana wa WaFalusi, isoemala ono ndokomiomo ko loasɔ loa iyɛli sha litɛmwi nda liwa.
english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

lokele: Aongaka Paulo ongoma, BaFalusi la BaSadoke lofenyakana la Ikumbɛ loatakana.
english: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

lokele: Basadoke nde baongaka mbo angwɛnɛ imɔ litɛmwi nda liwa, la angwɛnɛ bokitomo, angwɛnɛ ango bolimo, kongo ko BaFalusi baongaka mbo iyo yaatotina biyali.
english: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

lokele: Limɔ etondo efi lookana la batikasa bamɔi ba botuka wa BaFalusi loemakala, iyo lofenyana mbo— Totiɛnɛ litwanelo ango limɔi ende e-boto-yo; eluwa ende bolimo oyasoonga lande, ango ko bokitomo.
english: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”

lokele: Limɔ akɛkɛ tofenya la bosho la oso, Komanda lowanga mbo batasalaka Paulo la bolengi, inde loonga la basilikani mbo bakɛkɛ okaɔnɔkɔlɔ Paulo end’iyo la mbo bayeke lande nda ndakɔ ya basilikani.
english: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.

lokele: Limɔ la bocho wa mbisa, Ngɛnɛ loemala tina la Paulo, inde loonga mbo— Sambolaka botema waɛ, kwa asokambes’aɛ okambesa bato loasɔ loami ono nda Yelusaleme, ongoma otokambesa bato imɔ ko yao nda Loma.
english: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”

lokele: Asɔswaka bonyanya, limɔ BaYuda lotwana kuko, iyo lotana tele mbo angola bieka, angomwa ani bakoli ko Paulo;
english: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

lokele: ebatwanaka kuko baaka bato boeta kama inɛi.
english: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.

lokele: Iyo ana lɔkɛ ende Kanga ebieti la biange, iyo loonga mbo— Tosotinya ekanɔ ko la tele mbo iso angolɛtɛ yeka ani tokoli ko Paulo.
english: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.

lokele: Eokao to ino angɛnɛ amamwito la Ikumbɛ luwesaka kwani Komanda mbo aeshaka Paulo oso wanu kwa mbo bokomielek’inde e-loasɔ-lo liasi la wɛli, la iso toengani nde ndool’inde ani akayi ango tina.
english: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”

lokele: Kongo ko wana wa welo wa Paulo looka loasɔ loa iɔlɛ-si, ongoma inde lɔɔtɔ nda ndakɔ ya basilikani okaluwesa Paulo,
english: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.

lokele: la Paulo lota ɔmɔi wa betoli oso wa basilikani lioi, inde mbo— Kɛsɛkɛ isenge-si ende Komanda, eoka ale la lioi lioonga lande.
english: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”

lokele: Ongoma to, inde lɔkɛ lande ende Komanda, inde mbo— Oyakandomu ako Paulo, asota’mi lioi, asofela’mi mbo yesheke isenge-si end’aɛ, ale la lioi lioonga laɛ.
english: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”

lokele: Komanda lounda to isenge la bosamba, inde lɔkɛ lande sumbu wisakumbo, inde lofel’inde mbo— ¿Iye to eyetokambes’aɛ okambesa’mi?
english: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”

lokele: Isenge mbo— BaYuda basotwana kuko yofelak’aɛ mbo wesheke Paulo ende Ikumbɛ lɛlɛngɔ mbo bakomielek’inde nda loasɔ-lo liasi la wɛli.
english: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

lokele: Nde aɛ angoimelel’iyo, eoka bato boeta kama inɛi bakolamba iɔlɛ la basotinyana bikanɔ mbo angola yeka, angomwa ani bakoli ko Paulo; la basoengana kwani, basoumbakela ko lisakä liaɛ.
english: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”

lokele: Ongoma Komanda lomach’isenge akɛkɛ ani asoim’inde mbo— Okambesëke oto loasɔ elosois’aɛ ende’mi! Paulo lɔkɛsɔmɔ ende Felika nda Kaisalia
english: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”

lokele: Limɔ inde lota betoli oso ya basilikani, bato ambale lioi, inde mbo— Komiaka basilikani mia imbale amamwito la bato kama bosambale ebatalekemi nda funda la bato mia imbale ba bakonga mbo bakɛkɛ ko la ocho,
english: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.” 23:23

lokele: la funda yotola Paulo mbo biiyesek’inde la wɛli ko ende Felika ako Gouverneur.
english: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

lokele: Inde losɔnɔ lokasa la ebaoi-ba, mbo—
english: He wrote a letter like this:

lokele: Imi Kalaudio Lusia, isoseela Gouverneur Oyalongeli ako Felika.
english: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.

lokele: E-boto-yo ako Paulo akuwamelomökö ko la BaYuda ebasiakool’inde ani iso la basilikani bami loyaomana lau, iso loɔnɔkɔl’inde atiteni yau ani yokakä mbo ende iote sha Loma.
english: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.

lokele: La eoka yalɛmbɛkɛ ndoluwa litina lia liwanjeli liau owanjela Paulo, imi lɔkɛ lande nda Ikumbɛ shau.
english: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.

lokele: Imi loluwa mbo awanjelomökö loasɔ loa tofenya twa Bikela yau angɛnɛ, inga eoka ya loasɔ loengani la liwa angoko bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.

lokele: Limɔ aluwesomokö’mi mbo basotwana kuko yool’inde, lisasaya isotom’inde end’aɛ la isokambesa bawanjeli bande mbo baongeke loasɔ loande ko end’aɛ.
english: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”

lokele: Ongoma basilikani lounda Paulo, iyo lɔkɛsɛ inde, kwa akambesomokö iyo, ko la ocho nda Antipatuli;
english: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.

lokele: limɔ lɛlɛngɔ basilikani ebakɛndɛkɛ la bakolo, iyo loinwa nda ndakɔ yau nda Yelusaleme, iyo lomacha ebatalemi nda funda mbo bakɛsɛnɛkɛ lande,
english: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.

lokele: limɔ iyo ana loiyela Kaisalia, iyo lofaefaka Gouverneur lokasa, iyo loemesa Paulo oso wande.
english: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.

lokele: Atangak’inde lokasa, Felika lofela Paulo yese yande la aluwesomokö inde mbo ende wa Kilikia, inde mbo—
english: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,

lokele: Itooka loasɔ loaɛ la wɛli eyakiyeleke ebatowanjel’aɛ. Inde lokambesa basilikani ndotingana lande nda ndakɔ ya Bɔkɔta Helodi.
english: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.

lokele: Mbisa ya bacho bɔɔmwi, Kanga Eyeti ako Anania loya amamwito la biange la ikomya ako Telutulo, iyo lokambesa Gouverneur loasɔ loa Paulo.
english: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.

lokele: Limɔ atomoko Paulo lioi nda likomyi, Telutulo loakola ndowanjel’inde, inde mbo— Bwana Felika Oyalongeli, eoka ya lokele lofi elosokokɔmɛs’aɛ la mbo tosokomielomo njasɔ wike ko la wɛli waɛ nda yese-ye,
english: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,

lokele: tosoaolela yao la kelekëlë ya likama mbile bitotina la nda yese etotina.
english: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.

lokele: Kongo ko mbo itaokes’aɛ esole, itosombol’aɛ kwa ayali aɛ la bɔfɔɔmu, mbo wokeke sumbu sinyo sha inango nda loasɔ-lo.
english: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.

lokele: Tosɔɛnɛ to e-boto-yo wa bɔfɛnɔa, mbo ende bɔfɔɔli wa liyombayombesi lia BaYuda nda wenda bototina la botoli oso wa botuka wa eba Nasaleta,
english: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.

lokele: oyakotaka ango ndobebesa Ndakɔ ya Mungu, nde iso loundes’inde,
english: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him. 24:6

lokele: mbo tokomielek’inde ko la bikela yasu; kongo ko Komanda Lusia loyaɔnɔkɔl’inde nda besamba yasu la bofoka, inde loonga mbo loasɔ loyeke oso waɛ,
nde akakɔtɔlɛkɛ aɛ inde angɛnɛ; aɛ kokɔkɔlɔ ndoluwa loasɔ loande lototina elosoesh’iso end’aɛ.
english: 24:8 By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”

lokele: La BaYuda imɔ lokuliana lande nda baoi batotina mbo lole ango ko ani.
english: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.

lokele: Limɔ amekulaka Gouverneur mbo aongeke, Paulo lomutola liwanjeli, inde mbo— Ko la limɛngɔ itotungelesa liwanjeli lia loasɔ loami eoka isolembeela mbo ko la miaka wike aɛ nd’asoyala wati wa eba yese-ye.
english: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,

lokele: Otokɔkɔlɔ ndofela la boluwaka mbo bacho baketi ango liu la ambale, ani aiki’mi ndosemola Mungu nda Yelusaleme,
english: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.

lokele: la batiosheke’mi ani isofenyakana la boto, ango ani isofɔɔlɔ limbilititi lia bato, kwa nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, kwa nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ, kwa nda bokenge,
english: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.

lokele: la batikɔkɔlɛ ndokɔcha nda batoi baɛ liwanjeli liau owanjela’mi kwani.
english: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.

lokele: Nde itoaola oso waɛ mbo itosemokola Mungu wa batata basu ko la Mboka eyetotang’iyo mbo botuka wa tofenya; isoimela bitotina eyaekesomoko nda Bikela la eyatomoko nda Kasa ya Batɔndɔli;
english: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;

lokele: yende la iyɛli sha Mungu esile imɔ ko l’ebatowanjela’mi, siko mbo lilayalaka nde litɛmwi nda liwa lia ebengani l’ebatiengane.
english: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

lokele: Eokao, isotakela bolenda mbo iyaleke la botema wa esaela ende Mungu la ende bato lisanga ko mbile bitotina.
english: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.

lokele: Imi yayaka, ani isoetesa miaka bimɔi, ndoyakusola lifaefi la bakaɔ ende bato ba tukela yami;
english: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;

lokele: nde akelaka’mi ongoma, iyo loosha’mi nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu ani yende la bosalu, itiyaleke la limbilititi lia bato, itiyaleke la bosho;
english: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.

lokele: kongo ko BaYuda bamɔi ba Asia omao-beyala nde lami la loasɔ ani lole loau mbo bemesaneke oso waɛ ndowanjela’mi.
english: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.

lokele: Eya loti ani, ebato-ba angɛnɛ baongeke litwanelo eliɛnɛk’iyo wɛnɛ lami ani ayalaka’mi oso wa Ikumbɛ; sakolo ngo ko liolo limwito eliaongaka’mi,
english: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,

lokele: ani amamaka’mi eyemalaka’mi sisi yau, liko mbo— Loende ko loasɔ loa litɛmwi nda liwa elosokomielomo’mi louse oso wanu.
english: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”

lokele: Nde Felika, oyaluwaka sumbu la wɛli, njasɔ-bi ya botuteli wa Yesu, inde lotaombakeles’iyo, inde mbo— Akayeke Komanda Lusia ko ono, itoaesa loasɔ loaɛ se la wɛli.
english: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”

lokele: Inde lota botoli oso wa basilikani ndola mbo batinganeke la Paulo la wɛli la booto imɔ, angokufesa bato bande ndoyasung’inde.
english: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.

lokele: Mbisa ya bacho bamɔi, Felika loya amamwito la wali wande ako Dulusila, boseka wa BaYuda; inde lota Paulo lioi, limɔ inde looka inango shande loasɔ loa liimeli lioimela Yesu Masiya.
english: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.

lokele: Kongo ko anangolaka Paulo njasɔ ya liengani la likakalesi lia yɛmɛ la likomyi elikayeke, limɔ Felika lotalimwa la bɔwa, inde mbo— Takɛndɛkɛ kwani, yɛnɛ fofe, itot’aɛ lioi liasi.
english: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”

lokele: Felika akɛsɛkɛ imɔ iyɛli mbo Paulo efaka nda inde bosömbo, eokao inde lotak’inde lioi mbile la mbile mbo ayeke oyaongana lande.
english: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.

lokele: Kongoko mbisa ya miaka imbale, Polokio Feseto lofomo isosha nda lifa lia Felika; limɔ Felika angɛnɛ lomacha Paulo nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ eoka ya iyambacha shookesa BaYuda bolau.
english: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.

lokele: Afomokö to Feseto isosha likolo lia yese, la asilak’inde ko becho isatɔ, inde losokwa nda Kaisalia okakɛ nda Yelusaleme.
english: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

lokele: Omao kanga ebieti la betoli oso ya BaYuda lokambesa Feseto loasɔ loa Paulo, iyo losombola Feseto,
english: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,

lokele: mbo akeelek’iyo booto boko mbo atomek’inde nda Yelusaleme, nde iyo angɛnɛ lokomya ndolamba iɔlɛ shool’inde nda mboka.
english: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem, plotting to kill him on the way.

lokele: Nde Feseto lomutola mbo Paulo akandomu bɔnyɔlɔlɔ nda Kaisalia la mbo inde ako Feseto asosanga okakɛ omao mbisa ya mbile ko sinyo.
english: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.

lokele: Inde mbo— Bamɔi banu ba isosha bakɛsɛnɛkɛ lami, eya mbo boto-yo eyala la litwanelo, iyo kowanjel’inde ko omao.
english: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”

lokele: Inde lotikala lau bacho bonanɛi ango ko liu, limɔ inde loinwa nda Kaisalia. Lɛlɛngɔ Feseto loyala se nda kɛka ya likomonyi, inde loonga mbo Paulo eshomoko nda likomyi.
english: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.

lokele: Ayak’inde BaYuda ebasokwaka nda Yelusaleme lolingel’inde, iyo lowanjel’inde bawanjeli wike bawaü, nde batiakɔkɔlɔkɔ ndokɔcha bau.
english: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,

lokele: Paulo lomutola la baoi-ba mbo atungeseleke bawanjeli mbo— Ititwanelo litwanelo ango limwito nda Bikela ya BaYuda, kwa loasɔ loa Ndakɔ ya Mungu, kwa ende Kaisala.
english: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”

lokele: Nde Feseto lolɛmbɛ ndoetela BaYuda liambilo, eokao inde lofela Paulo mbo— ¿Olɛmbi nde ndɔkɛ nda Yelusaleme ndokakomielomo ko lami omao? Paulo angolɛmbɛ Likomyi lia BaYuda kangä elia Kaisala nda Loma
english: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things?”

lokele: Limɔ Paulo loonga mbo— Yemali nde kwani nda ekomyelo ya Kaisala, olo engani nde mbo ikomielomoko loasɔ-lo; ititwaneloko litwanelo ango limɔi ende BaYuda, kwa aluwi nd’aɛ la wɛli la wɛli.
english: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.

lokele: Nde eya to mbo yakela loasɔ lobe kwa litwanelo lioengana la liwa, iitoluka mboka yofeka liwa, kongo ko eya mbo bewanjelaka’mi ko wawa, ani angwɛnɛ boto wokɔkɔlɔ ndofa’mi end’iyo lifaefela. Isotela Kaisala bosakɔ, akomieleke’mi loasɔ.
english: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”

lokele: Limɔ Feseto lofelana la Ikumbɛ shande, limɔ inde lomutola la Paulo mbo— Osotela Kaisala bosakɔ, waɛkɛ ngo end’inde. Bɔkɔta Akulipa la Belunike lokambesomo loasɔ loa Paulo
english: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”

lokele: Etaka bacho bamɔi, Bɔkɔta Akulipa la Belunike loya fɛtɛti yoseela Feseto nda Kaisalia;
english: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.

lokele: umwak’iyo omao bacho wike, Feseto lokambesa Bɔkɔta loasɔ loa Paulo, inde mbo— Boto ɔmɔi ale eya, oyamachaka Felika nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ,
english: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul’s case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;

lokele: la ayalaka’mi nda Yelusaleme, Kanga ebieti la biange ya BaYuda lowanjel’inde oso wami mbo ifek’inde se,
english: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.

lokele: la imi lokambes’iyo mbo etiengane la boyaeli wa BaLoma ndofa oto se wawa ani akatowani l’ɔmbɔ l’ɔmbɔ l’ebatowanjel’inde la fofe yomutoela bawanjeli ebasowanjelomo inde.
english: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.

lokele: Eokao ayak’iyo eyamaya, itiaumbakelaka, nde lɛlɛngɔ imi loyala se nda kɛka ya likomonyi, imi loonga mbo boto-yo aeshomoko nda likomyi.
english: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.

lokele: Emalaka bawanjeli, batiawanjel’inde la njasɔ ibe eyaenyelaka’mi;
english: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;

lokele: kongo ko bafenyakanaka loasɔ loa yao ebisoimelomo lau angɛnɛ la loasɔ loa ɔmɔi ako Yesu oyawaka, oyaongaka Paulo mbo akoyala la liwawi.
english: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

lokele: Alefaka’mi mboka yooshaka batina ba loasɔ mbo ikomyele loao, imi lofel’inde kwa mbo atolɛmbɛ ndɔkɛ nda Yelusaleme, ndokakomielomo loao ko omao.
english: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.

lokele: Nde afelaka Paulo mbo atatikala ko ndokakomielomo ko la Kaisala, imi lota ndola mbo aundomoko nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ konda mbile eyekatomeke’mi otom’inde ende Kaisala.
english: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”

lokele: Akulipa loonga la Feseto mbo— Imi angɛnɛ ilɛmbi ndok’inde. Feseto mbo— Lɛlɛngɔ kongo, wokak’inde.
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”

lokele: Ongoma lɛlɛngɔ Agulipa la Belunike loya la balɛngɔ la bɔfɛkɔ finɛ amamwito la eba Komanda la biange ya okenge, iyo lɔɔtɔ nda eatelo ya njasɔ; limɔ Feseto loonga mbo baesheke Paulo.
