english: So on the next day, when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city, at the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.

lokele: Limɔ Feseto loonga mbo— Bɔkɔta Agulipa la ino batolome batotina ebayali amamwito lasu, bosɔɛnɛ e-boto-yo; BaYuda batotina basofelaka’mi loasɔ loande, la nda Yelusaleme la ono imɔ, basoanjanja mbo lotiengane mbo atikaleke ango la liwawi imɔ.
english: Festus said, “King Agrippa, and all men who are here present with us, you see this man about whom all the multitude of the Jews petitioned me, both at Jerusalem and here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

lokele: Nde imi angɛnɛ yɛnɛkɛ̈ mbo atikele loasɔ ango lɔmɔi loengana la liwa, kongo ko inde angɛnɛ asofela ndokakomyomo la Kaisala, eokao isosanga ndotom’inde nda Loma.
english: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor, I determined to send him,

lokele: Nde itiɛnɛ loasɔ angɛnɛ losɔnɛlɛ nda lokasa lotɔkɛ ende Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Kaisala, eokao isoesh’inde oso wanu, simbi to oso waɛ Bɔkɔta Agulipa, litina mbo akakɔtɔlɔmɔk’inde, yɛnɛ to lioi liosɔnɔ nda lokasa,
english: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him out before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination I may have something to write.

lokele: eoka itangi nde mbo ende efinole ndotoma boto nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ angoluwesa loasɔ elotowanjelomo inde.
english: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him.”

lokele: Limɔ Agulipa loonga la Paulo mbo— Wende la yose yota inango shaɛ. Limɔ Paulo loninɔlɔ bosamba wande, inde loakola ndotungesela bawanjeli ko la limutoli liande,
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand, and made his defense.

lokele: inde mbo— Bɔkɔta Agulipa, yende la limɛngɔ finɛ louse ndota inango shami oso waɛ shotungelesa bawanjeli ba BaYuda owanjela’mi,
english: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things the Jews accuse me of,

lokele: simbi to eoka mbo beyaeli la tofenya twa BaYuda bisoluwomo laɛ fololo; eokao itolɔmbɔkɔl’aɛmbo olaileke’mi ko la boliliya.
english: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.

lokele: Ongoma to, boyaeli wami ko nda isenge shami, kwa ayaläka’mi sisi ya ebami angɛnɛ ko nda liotomu, la nda Yelusaleme, bosoluwana la BaYuda batotina.
english: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;

lokele: Basotaluwa ko oso, bekulia ndoluwes’aɛ ongoma, mbo isolitesa boyaeli wa BaFalusi ebole botükä eboeti la finɛ nda liimeli la lilitesi lia Mungu.
english: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

lokele: La kwani isoemala ono nda likomyi lia liwanjeli ko l’eoka ya iyɛli sha lisakä eliatikaka Mungu ende batata basu,
english: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,

lokele: lisakä elisosemokola tukela yasi liu la imbale la löwa la ocho mbo bosheke liao. E Bɔkɔta, isowanjelomo la BaYuda ko l’eoka ya iyɛli-si.
english: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!

lokele: ¿Monito ino otangi nde mbo lotiloimelomo mbo Mungu atokusola ebasowa nda liwa?
english: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

lokele: Ongoma to imi angɛnɛ loenyela nda botema wami mbo loengani mbo ikeleke njasɔ wike yotwana la lina lia Yesu wa Nasaleta. Yakelaka ko ani nda Yelusaleme;
english: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

lokele: imi nd’akandaka wike wa ebaimeli nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ ko la isosha eshafomoko’mi ende Kanga ebieti, la nda Ikumbɛ imɔ yakuliaka mbo baolomoko.
english: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.

lokele: Yakuchakak’iyo nda bisɔngɔmɛlɔ bitotina, imi lokota ndosɛɔlɛs’iyo lina lia Yesu, yawɛlɛk’iyo luno loa likama, yakongolak’iyo imɔ ko nda bekenge ya yese yasi.
english: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.

lokele: Akɛndɛkɛ’mi ongoma nda mboka ya Damaseke, ko la isosha sha Kanga ebieti ebatomaka’mi,
english: “Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,

lokele: la ifitika, Bɔkɔta, nda mboka imi lɔɛnɛ liangangi elisolongela elia liso lia use, elisosokwa imɔ nda use, liao loangangela’mi fangi la fangi imɔ ko ebakɛndɛnɛkɛ amamwito lami.
english: at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled with me.

lokele: Akwak’iso yatotina kwu nda nyɛlɛ, imi looka limiki litoonga lami la lioi lia BaEbele mbo— ¿Saulo, Saulo, otokongokola’mi monito? Oisoka lobaba ndosibiaka bokolo nda bosiki?
english: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’

lokele: Limɔ imi loonga mbo— ¿Bwana, wende ndai? Limɔ Ngɛnɛ loonga mbo— Imi yende Yesu oyatokongolomo laɛ.
english: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “He said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

lokele: Kongo ko emalaka nda bakolo baɛ, eoka isɔɛnɛlɛ end’aɛ litina lia mbo isɛlɛk’aɛ bokuwi wami la bonangoli wa yao ebisɔɛnɛ aɛ la yao imɔ ebikɛnɛsɛkɛ’mi wɛnɛs’aɛ mbisa;
english: But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will reveal to you;

lokele: itosokol’aɛ nda besamba ya bato baɛ angɛnɛ la ende eba biese yasi, olo akatomeke’mi otom’aɛ,
english: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,

lokele: mbo olioleke baiso bau, la mbo basokweke nda lilima ndokɛnɛ liangangi lia löwa, mbo basokweke nda bofoka wa Satana ndokakwa nda bofoka wa Mungu mbo bamɛsɛlɔmɔkɔ batwanelo, bafomoko botiko amamwito l’ebasotanesomo ko la liimeli lioimela’mi.
english: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’

lokele: Eokao, Bɔkɔta Agulipa, itiafekaka ndolitesa liɛni eliɛnɛlɛkɛ nda use,
english: “Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,

lokele: nde oso imi lotanangola ende bato ba Damaseke la mbisa ende eba Yelusaleme la nda yese ya Yudea etotina la ende eba biese yasi mbo bakalanganeke ndokikwa ende Mungu la mbo bakelakeke ko yao ebiengani la likalangani liau.
english: but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.

lokele: Eoka ya njasɔ-bi, BaYuda lokuwamela’mi nda Ndakɔ ya Mungu, la iyo lokota ndoola’mi.
english: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.

lokele: Konda eweuse isosungomo la Mungu, eokao ikoemala eyamaya ndonangoela bato, l’ebafi l’ebakɛkɛ, nde iitoonga lioi angolimɔi, sakolo ngo ko eyaongaka Mɔsɛ la batɔndɔli mbo yao bilayaka mbisa,
english: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen,

lokele: biko mbo, loengani nde la Masiya mbo okeke tokange, limɔ eoka Inde atɛmwaka oso nda liwa, Inde akoluwesa la BaYuda la bato ba biese yasi mbo löwa losoangangel’iyo.
english: how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles.”

lokele: Anangolaka Paulo inango shande, Feseto loamama la limiki lifi mbo— Paulo osowa loseka! Wɛli wa kasa bosoola’aɛ loseka!
english: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”

lokele: Nde Paulo mbo— Itiwe loseka, aɛ Feseto Oyalongeli, nde baolo ebakoonga’mi bende ko wewe la wɛli;
english: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.

lokele: eoka Bɔkɔta nd’aluwi njasɔ-bi, itoonga oso wande la lotendela, eoka itienyele mbo njasɔ-bi bisoisomo end’inde, eoka bitiakelomoko wisisa.
english: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.

lokele: ¿Bɔkɔta Agulipa, oisoimela Batɔndɔli? Iluwi nde mbo osoimela!
english: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”

lokele: Limɔ Agulipa loonga la Paulo mbo— Ko la sinyo sha lioi osotinja’mi mbo iyaleke boto wa Masiya?
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”

lokele: Paulo mbo— Ango la sinyo ango ko la yumwa, imi kosombokola Mungu mbo inga aɛ angɛnɛ kongo, kanga imɔ ko batotina-ba ebatoka’mi louse, bayaleke kwa ayali nde’mi, sakolo ngo ko bɛnyɔlɔlɔ-bi.
english: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds.”

lokele: Lamao Akulipa loemala amamwito la Gouverneur la Belenike l’ebayalaka se amamwito lau.
english: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice, and those who sat with them.

lokele: Iyo lɔkɛ okaongana mbo— E-boto-yo atikeleke loasɔ loengana la liwa, ango ko bɔnyɔlɔlɔ.
english: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”

lokele: Agulipa loonga la Feseto mbo— Aenaka e-boto-yo afelaka mbo akomyomoko la Kaisala, ani asofaikolomo.
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”

lokele: Akomyak’iyo mbo tɔkɛkɛ ko la watɔ wa lofofo ko nda yese ya Italia iyo lota Paulo la ebakandomu basi nda besamba ya botoli oso wa basilikani, ako Yulio wa botuka wa basilikani ebotangomu mbo Wa Auguseto.
english: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.

lokele: Iso lokwa nda watɔ wa okenge wa Adulamutio ewasangaka ndoetaeta bekenge ebile nda boili wa Asia, limɔ iso loilia owale; Alisitalako, boto wa bokenge wa Tesaloniko nda Makedonia, inde lɔkɛsɛnɛ lasu nda watɔ.
english: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.

lokele: Lɛlɛngɔ iso loelama nda Sidona, lamao Yulio lookela Paulo booto, inde lomacha Paulo mbo aɛkɛ baina mbo bakukyeke inde sumbu.
english: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.

lokele: Iliak’iso owale liasi, iso loeta fangi eyemɔi ya bosanga wa Kupolio, eoka lofofo lokufesak’iso ndoleka ko la fangi ya wali.
english: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

lokele: Alekak’iso eliya eyele owale wa Kilikia la Pamfulia, iso loiyela bokenge ɔmɔi wa Lukia boko Mula.
english: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

lokele: Omao botoli oso wa basilikani loosha ɛɛndɔ ya watɔ wa okenge boko Alesandulia eyetɔkɛ nda Italia, inde lot’iso nda wao.
english: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.

lokele: Aɛk’iso la lofofo ko tenenetenene, bacho bamɔi, iso loiya ko la tale nda Kinido, limɔ eoka mbo lofofo lokufesak’iso ɔkɛ ko fii, iso loeta fangi ya bɔlɔkɔ wa bosanga boko Kulete, tina la kolo eko Salomone.
english: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

lokele: Ko la bowau, iso lotakela bosanga se, la ongoma iso loiyela elela eyatangomoko mbo Bɛlɔkɔ-belau tina la bokenge boko Lasea.
english: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.

lokele: Etaka mbile yumwa ongoma, lɔkɛndɔ loa watɔ loya la tale finɛ eoka bolanga (nda mbile ya Lokufo-loa-yeka) bosoeta la fomba bitoyala,
english: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them

lokele: ongoma Paulo lofaef’iyo likakanelo mbo— Batolome, isoɛnɛ mbo lɔkɛndɔ-lo lotoyala nde la tale la bifembi finɛ, inga nda biengo la watɔ angɛnɛ kongo, kanga imɔ ko nda komba yasu bato.
english: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”

lokele: Nde Yulio ɛtɛmɛlɛkɛ baoi ba kapitɛni la ngɛnɛ wa watɔ, inga baoi ba Paulo.
english: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.

lokele: Limɔ eoka bɔlɔkɔ botiengane wotikala ko la tengai ya bɔfɛfyɔ, bato ebalongeli basangaka ndoiliaka owale liasi, mbo bakoteke eluwa bɛkɔkɔlɔ ndoiyela Foinike eko lifɔtɔ elile nda bosanga wa Kulete la elitoɛnɛlɛ fangi eyetofofa fofo imbale, mbo batayalaka omao la mbile ya bɔfɛfyɔ. Watɔ wa lofofo lowa la lomba loa likama
english: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.

lokele: Limɔ afofaka lofofo lolau loa fangi ya Afilika, iyo loenyela mbo basɔɔlɔ fofe eyelɛmb’iyo, eokao iyo losɔmbɔlɔ tondo, iyo lokatakele ngɔngɛ ya Kulete se.
english: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

lokele: Nde mbisa ya mbile ko sinyo, lomba loa likama loko elotosokwa nda föngo ya bosanga, loao loomanel’iyo, lototangomo lina mbo Eulakulo.
english: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon. 27:14

lokele: Limɔ eoka watɔ lokɔkɔmɔ, angokɔkɔlɔ otambak’imɔ bɔmbɔ nda lofofo, iso lomacha watɔ ndotinjomo la lofofo;
english: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.

lokele: limɔ iso lɔɔtɔ bɔlɔkɔ wa bosanga bɔkɛkɛ boko Kauda, limɔ iso losulia etumbe ya watɔ ko la owau.
english: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.

lokele: Ilak’iyo etumbe nda balia, iyo lɔsɔ bangwändä ba bekulu, iyo lokandakana watɔ la bao, buu ko la bɔkɔngɔ. Limɔ eoka mbo iyo lowanga mbo watɔ botaswama se nda boke boko Sulutisi, iyo losulola hema ya lofofo se, iyo lochaa ko ongoma.
english: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.

lokele: Nde kwa aomanelo iso batutu finɛ, lɛlɛngɔ iso loakola ndɔwɛlɛ biengo ebisoaa watɔ se nda balia;
english: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.

lokele: limɔ nda lise lia asatɔ iyo lɔwɛlɛkɛ hema la bekulu ya watɔ se nda balia.
english: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.

lokele: Ko la bacho wike liso-lia-use la tolonge angɔɛnɛlɛ la ngumba loetela likama, yao loomakana lasu, ongoma totiakɛsɛk’imɔ iyɛli liasi mbo touwesomoko nde.
english: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.

lokele: Lamao, eoka batialaka imɔ bieka ko la mbile yumwa, Paulo loemala sisi yau la inde loonga mbo— Batolome, wakuliaka kwa aongaka’mi mbo iso angotasokwa nda Kulete, ani totiweke efembi la e-lituwami-li.
english: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.

lokele: Nde yaimwesaka kwani betema yanu, eoka angwɛnɛ angɔmɔi wanu wɔsɛɛsɛlɛ, sakolo ngo ko watɔ kongo,
english: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.

lokele: eoka la ocho-bo bokitomo wa Mungu, oyale Ngɛnɛ wami la oyatosemokola’mi osemol’Inde, inde loemala tina lami,
english: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,

lokele: inde mbo— Owangëke, Paulo, lole loaɛ ndoemala oso wa Kaisala, tɛnɛ ngo Mungu asofaef’aɛ bawawi ba batotina ebasɔkɛsɛnɛ laɛ nda watɔ.
english: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

lokele: Ko l’eokao, Batolome, yaimwesaka betema yanu, isoimela nde Mungu mbo lotoyak’end’iso oko ani akambesomoko’mi,
english: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.

lokele: Kongo ko iso la watɔ toomelaka nde nda bosanga ɔmɔi.
english: But we must run aground on a certain island.”

lokele: Bocho ona waaka ewa liu la anɛi ewasokwak’iso nda Bɛlɔkɔ, la iso lochacha nda eliya ya Adelia, limɔ tina la ɛsɔkɔ ya ocho, basali ba watɔ lotanga nde mbo boili bokoya oko tina;
english: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.

lokele: eokao iyo lokweela bolundu wa balia, iyo lota yiso litinda limɔi. Limɔ mbisa sumbu, iyo lokweela liasi, iyo lota yiso liu la bɔɔmwi.
english: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. 27:28 After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms. 27:28

lokele: Limɔ awangak’iyo mbo watɔ botaomela ko nda ngɔngɛ ya batalɛ, iyo lokushaka tondo binɛi nda wendo, iyo losombola mbo bonyanya boyeke.
english: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.

lokele: Nde basali ba watɔ loluka fofe yokwa botili, iyo lota etumbe nda balia liasi, iyo lokwela la bolimbake mbo batokakusha tondo yasi nda bɔmbɔ wa watɔ.
english: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,

lokele: Kongo ko Paulo loonga la Komanda Yulio la basilikani mbo— Sakolo ko e-bato-ba kotikala nda watɔ, ani ino angokɔkɔlɔ ndouwesomo.
english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”

lokele: Kwaamao basilikani lotenaka bekulu ya etumbe, iyo lomacha yao ndokwa se nda balia.
english: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.

lokele: Oso wa bonyanya sumbu, Paulo lɔɔnjɔnj’iyo yaatotina mbo baleke bieka, inde mbo— Ko la becho liu la inɛi ino osoumwaka ndoombakela, angola bieka;
english: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.

lokele: eokao itolɔmbɔkɔlɔk’ino mbo boleke sumbu bieka, eoka louweso loanu losolendelo ngo ko yao, eoka angwɛnɛ loswee ango lɔmɔi loa botö wa ɔmɔi wanu kosɛɛsɛlɛ.
english: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”

lokele: Aongaka Paulo ongoma, inde lounda lituma, inde lofaefa Mungu kelekëlë oso wau yaatotina, limɔ inde louna liao, inde loakola ndola liao.
english: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.

lokele: Limɔ iyo batotina loyaima betema, iyo imɔ lola bieka.
english: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.

lokele: Iso yaatotina nda watɔ twaaka bato mia imbale la kama bosambale la bato liambɛ.
english: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.

lokele: Okaneloko iyo bieka, iyo lokushaka bofonga nda balia eoka ndolɛfɛsɛ watɔ. Watɔ wa lofofo loomela nda bosanga, wao lowa
english: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

lokele: Asɔswaka bonyanya, batialembeelaka boili, nde iyo lɔɛnɛ bɔnɔkɔ wa botima la ngɔngɛ ya boke, iyo losanga mbo, bekɔkɔlɔ, iyo koswamesa watɔ se ko omao;
english: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.

lokele: limɔ iyo lotenaka bekulu ya tondo, iyo lomacha yao nda balia, la mbile-ao iyo lofaikola bikandelo ya bowacheli. Limɔ iyo loemesa hema ya lofofo ya bɔmbɔ fii, iyo lotamba watɔ boomaneke nda ngɔngɛ.
english: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

lokele: Nde iyo loiyela nda nyɛlɛ atiteni ya bɔɛsɔ la botalangu, iyo loswamesa watɔ se la bɔmbɔ loundana angokɔkɔlɔ ndosɔngwa omao, nde wendo loakola ndoachaacha eoka ya batutu ebasoomakana la wao.
english: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.

lokele: Limɔ basilikani losanga mbo boleke bato ba bɔnyɔlɔlɔ mbo bataungwa nda balia nde kokwa otili.
english: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.

lokele: Kongo ko Komanda Yulio lokufesa lisangi liau eoka alɛmbɛkɛ ndouwesa Paulo. Inde lota ndola mbo ebaluwi balia, bungweke nda bao oso ndokakɛ nda boili,
english: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;

lokele: limɔ ebatikali batalemeke nda baonga la biengo yasi ya watɔ. Ongoma batotina loiya nda boili la louweso.
english: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.

lokele: Uwak’iso yaatotina ongoma, iso loluwa bosanga mbo bosotomo lina liko Melita.
english: When we had escaped, then they 28:1 learned that the island was called Malta.

lokele: Bato ba yese ena ebatiaongaka baoi basu, iyo lokeel’iso booto wa likama, iyo loanesa bösä, iyo lonyangel’iso batotina eoka ya bɔtɔkɔ wa mbula la bɔfɛfyɔ.
english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

lokele: Paulo losɔnjaka bangbokale ba tokolokolo la atak’inde twao nda bösä, njɔ lokuswa nda twao eoka ya etao la yao loundana la lingasa liande.
english: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

lokele: Limɔ ɛnɛkɛ bato ba bosanga njɔ esokakema nda lingasa liande, iyo angɛnɛ loongana mbo— Eingo nde, botolome-yo ende booli wa bato, asouwa nda balia, kongo ko Oyengani atimach’inde ndoika imɔ!
english: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”

lokele: Kongo ko Paulo lɔfɛfɛ njɔ nda bösä, atiokaka lobaba;
english: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

lokele: nde bato lowɛlɛ Paulo baiso mbo atotɛmɛtɛmɛ ango atokwa se kwu la losingo. Limɔ awɛlɛkɛ iyo baiso ko yumwa batiɛnɛkɛ ango loasɔ lowau losoya end’inde, iyo lokikola lienyeli, iyo loonga mbo Paulo ende mungu.
english: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

lokele: Nda fangi ena ya bosanga yaaka la bilanga bifi ya Gouverneur ya bosanga ako Pubelio, inde lonyangel’iso nda ndakɔ yande, inde lofaef’iso bɛɛnda bieka bacho basatɔ ko la booto finɛ.
english: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

lokele: Loaaka nde mbo sango wa Pubelio loingalaka se la etao la bokolö wa bakila, Paulo lɔkɛ okɛnɛ inde, inde losomboel’inde, la ataliak’inde besamba yande, inde louwes’inde.
english: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

lokele: Lamao eba ngwo basi nda bosanga loyaka, iyo losäsesomo.
english: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.

lokele: Iyo loinakel’iso la besombo wike limɔ asokwak’iso liasi la watɔ wa lofofo, iyo lotaka nda watɔ bieka ebisoeno iso.
english: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

lokele: Yaaka nde mbisa ya tengai isatɔ eyailak’iso lɔkɛndɔ nda watɔ wa lofofo wa Alesandulia ewayalaka nda bosanga nda mbile ya bɔfɛfyɔ, lina lia watɔ liko Batolome Baasa.
english: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”

lokele: Iso loelama nda bokenge wa Sulakuse, iso loumwa omao ko bacho basatɔ;
english: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

lokele: asokwak’iso omao, iso lotimbela sumbu ndokaiyela Legio, limɔ lɛlɛngɔ lofofo loa fangi ya Afilika lofofa, loao loiyes’iso lɛlɛngɔ nda elamelo ya Puteoli,
english: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

lokele: olo atowanak’iso la beoto bɛmɔi ebafelak’iso ndotikala lau bacho bosambale. Paulo nda Bɔnyɔlɔlɔ nda Loma
english: where we found brothers, 28:14 and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

lokele: Ongoma iso loiya nda Loma la boili. Beoto ba omao, okak’iyo mboli yasu, iyo loya oyatowana lasu nda eolo ya Liongo lia Apio, nda elela eko Kumbo isatɔ. Limɔ ɛnɛkɛ Paulo wɛn’iyo, inde lofaefa Mungu kelekëlë, inde loyaimwesa botema.
english: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.

lokele: Iyak’iso nda bokenge wa Loma, Paulo lomachomo ndoyalaka eyande angɛnɛ amamwito la bosilikani oyalambak’inde.
english: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

lokele: Mbisa ya bacho basatɔ Paulo lota betoli oso ya BaYuda lioi mbo bayeke end’inde, limɔ asɔngɔmɔk’iyo, inde loonga lau mbo— Beoto, ani ititefole bato basu angoko beyaeli ya batata basu, imi nd’akɛsɔmɔkɔ nda besamba ya BaLoma nda bɔnyɔlɔlɔ nda Yelusaleme;
english: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,

lokele: iyo ana lokɔtɔlɔ’mi la basangaka ndofaikola’mi eoka batiɛnɛkɛ’mi la litwanelo lioengana la liwa.
english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

lokele: Nde eoka BaYuda batiakuliaka, ongoma yatinjomoko ndotela Kaisala bosakɔ, nde itiaaka la loasɔ lowanjela eba yese yami angɛnɛ.
english: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

lokele: Eoka ya litina-li to, isot’ino lioi mbo yɛnɛk’ino la mbo iongeke lanu, eoka isokandomo la e-bɔnyɔlɔlɔ-bo ko la loasɔ loa iyɛli sha Isalaele.
english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

lokele: Limɔ iyo loonga lande mbo— Iso totiɔlɛ lokasa ango lɔmɔi loa Yudea loasɔ loaɛ, la angwɛnɛ ɔmɔi wa beoto yasu woya ono ndotel’iso mboli kwa ndoongana lasu loasɔ lobe loaɛ.
english: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

lokele: Kongo ko tolɛmbi nde ndooka ko end’aɛ ko yao ebisoenyakel’aɛ; eoka nda loasɔ loa e-botuka-bo toluwi nde mbo bosotangokomo obe nda wenda bototina.
english: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”

lokele: Iyo lokuliana lande lisho lia lise elikayek’iyo la iyo loya bato wike end’inde nda ndakɔ eyayal’inde; ko la nɔngɔ buse tuu inde losanoel’iyo, la inde lonangoel’iyo loasɔ loa Bɔkɔta wa Mungu, inde lokota ndoimeles’iyo loasɔ loa Yesu ko la Bikela ya Mɔsɛ la Kasa ya Batɔndɔli.
english: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

lokele: Bamɔi loimela inangɔ shande nde bamɔi angoimela.
english: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

lokele: Ongoma iyo lofenyakana la iyo loakola ndomelana, ani Paulo loonga lau ko liolo-li limɔi mbo— Baoi ebaongaka Bolimo Botanu ende batata banu ko la Yesaya ewa Bɔtɔndɔli bende ko wewe, bako mbo—
english: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,

lokele: Kɛndɛkɛ ende e-bato-ba, ongaka lau mbo— La batoi ino bokaka, nde angolüwa litina; La baiso, ino botichaka, nde angotɛnɛ swa.
english: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.

lokele: Eoka betema ya e-tukela-ye bisokwelo itɔka, La batoi bau batooka ko ilao kongo; La basolinja baiso bau ndi, Mbo batɛnɛ la baiso la mbo batoka la batoi, Batalüwaka batina la betema la batakalangana, La mbo itauwes’iyo.
english: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’ Isaiah 6:9-10

lokele: Eokao luwaka to mbo liuwesi-li lia Mungu lisotomomo ende bato ba tukela yasi, la iyo nd’atokaka liao.
english: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

lokele: Aongak’inde ongoma, BaYuda losokwa okafelakana iyo angɛnɛ nda yao.
english: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves. 28:29

lokele: Paulo loyalaka ko miaka imbale nda ndakɔ eyakambak’inde angɛnɛ la inde lonyangela batotina ebayaka fɛtɛti end’inde,
english: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,

lokele: inde lotaka boeki wa loyo loa Bɔkɔta wa Mungu la inde loekekesa njasɔ ya Ngɛnɛ Yesu Masiya ko fololo angokufesomo.
english: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.
